duas.title: Dua for Salah (At the beginning of the prayer)
duas.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَـدَيْكَ، وَالشَّـرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْـكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhee fataras-samawaati wal-arda haneefan wa maa ana minal-mushrikeen, inna salaatee wa nusukee wa mahyaaya wa mamaatee lillaahi rabbil-’alameen, laa shareeka lahu wabi dhaalika umirtu wa-ana minal-muslimeen. Allaahumma antal-maliku laa ilaaha illaa anta. anta rabbee wa-anaa ‘abduka, dhalamtu nafsee wa’taraftu bidhanbee faghfir lee dhunoobee jamee’an innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa anta. wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaaqi laa yahdee li-ahsaniha illaa anta, wasrif ‘annee sayyiaha laa yasrifu ‘annee sayyiaha illaa anta, Labbayka wa sa’dayka, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadayka, washsharru laysa ilayka, ana bika wa-ilayka, tabarakta wa ta’alayta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk
duas.translation: I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth and I am not of those who associate (others with Allah). Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ الْمَاجِشُونُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مِنْ آخِرِ مَا يَقُولُ بَيْنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night for prayer he would say: I turn my face in complete devotion to One Who is the Originator of the heaven and the earth and I am not of the polytheists. Verily my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds; There is no partner with Him and this is what I have been commanded (to profess and believe) and I am of the believers. O Allah, Thou art the King, there is no god but Thee, Thou art my Lord, and I am Thy bondman. I wronged myself and make a confession of my Sin. Forgive all my sins, for no one forgives the sins but Thee, and guide me in the best of conduct for none but Thee guideth anyone (in) good conduct. Remove sins from me, for none else but Thou can remove sins from me. Here I am at Thy service, and Grace is to Thee and the whole of good is in Thine hand, and one cannot get nearneststo Thee through evil. My (power as well as existence) is due to Thee (Thine grace) and I turn to Thee (for supplication). Thou art blessed and Thou art exalted. I seek forgiveness from Thee and turn to Thee in repentance: and when he would bow, he would say: O Allah, it is for Thee that I bowed. I affirm my faith in Thee and I submit to Thee, and submit humbly before Thee my hearing, my eyesight, my marrow, my bone, my sinew; and when he would raise his head, he would say: O Allah, our Lord, praise is due to Thee, (the praise) with which is filled the heavens and the earth, and with which is filled that (space) which exists between them, and filled with anything that Thou desireth afterward. And when he prostrated himself, he (the Holy Prophet) would say: O Allah, it is to Thee that I prostrate myself and it is in Thee that I affirm my faith, and I submit to Thee. My face is submitted before One Who created it, and shaped it, and opened his faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the best of Creators; and he would then say between Tashahhud and the pronouncing of salutation: Forgive me of the earlier and later open and secret (sins) and that where I made transgression and that Thou knowest better than I. Thou art the First and the Last. There is no god, but Thee. [Muslim: 771]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Salah (At the Beginning of the Prayer)
benefits.description: This dua before salah helps a Muslim focus on Allah alone, making every prayer start with pure intention and a heart full of Iman and hope for forgiveness and guidance.
points: Wajjahtu wajhiya in namaz brings the heart close to Rabbil Alamin with full niyat.
La ilaha illa anta in this dua for salah keeps shirk away and grows true Iman.
Astaghfirullah in dua before prayer helps a Muslim get Allah’s forgiveness for sins.
Before namaz dua asks Allah to guide towards best Akhlaq and keep away bad habits.
Takbiratul ihram with this masnoon dua makes every Amal in salah more accepted by Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Salah
when_to_recite.description: This dua for salah is recited at the start of prayer, turning your heart to Allah, asking for forgiveness, Barakah, and the best Akhlaq before you begin your namaz with full Iman and hope.
points: At the very start of your prayer, recite the dua for salah after takbiratul ihram.
Before reading Surah Fatiha, use the dua before salah to set your niyat for Rabbil Alamin.
When you want to clean your heart before namaz, say wajjahtu wajhiya for forgiveness.
If you feel weak in Amal, make the dua before salat to ask Allah for best Akhlaq and Barakah.
While starting any fard or sunnah prayer, remember the dua before prayer for pure Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Salah at the Beginning
how_to_perform.description: Starting your salah with this dua for salah brings your heart close to Rabbil Alamin and fills your namaz with Barakah. This dua before salah helps you focus, ask for forgiveness, and make your niyat strong before every prayer.
steps: Stand facing the qiblah and after takbiratul ihram, softly recite wajjahtu wajhiya.
Before reading surah Fatiha, say this dua before salah to set your niyat and ask for help.
When you feel weak in Iman, use this dua for forgiveness and ask la ilaha illa anta for mercy.
If you want better Amal, recite this dua before prayer to ask Allah for good character.
While making your niyat for namaz, remember to say astaghfirullah and seek Allah’s guidance.

duas.title: Dua after Takbeer in Salah
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اَللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِيْ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma baa'id baynee wa bayna khataayaaya kamaa baa'adta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, Allaahumma naqqinee minal khataayaa kamaa yunaqqath-thawbul-'abyadhu minad-danas, Allaahummaghsil khataayaaya, bil maa'i wath-thalji wal-barad
duas.translation:
O Allah! separate me from my sins as You have separated the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my transgressions as the white garment is cleansed of stains. O Allah! wash away my sins with ice and water and frost.

Narrated by Abu Huraira (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to keep silent between the Takbir and the recitation of Qur'an and that interval of silence used to be a short one. I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "May my parents be sacrificed for you! What do you say in the pause between Takbir and recitation?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I say, (The dua is Mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْكُتُ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَبَيْنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ إِسْكَاتَةً ـ قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ هُنَيَّةً ـ فَقُلْتُ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِسْكَاتُكَ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ مَا تَقُولُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَاىَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to keep silent between the Takbir and the recitation of Qur'an and that interval of silence used to be a short one. I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "May my parents be sacrificed for you! What do you say in the pause between Takbir and recitation?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I say, 'Allahumma, baa`id baini wa baina khatayaya kama baa`adta baina l-mashriqi wa l-maghrib. Allahumma, naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqa th-thawbu l-abyadu mina d-danas. Allahumma, ighsil khatayaya bi l-maa'i wa th-thalji wa l-barad (O Allah! Set me apart from my sins (faults) as the East and West are set apart from each other and clean me from sins as a white garment is cleaned of dirt (after thorough washing). O Allah! Wash off my sins with water, snow and hail.)" [Bukhari: 744]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua after Takbeer in Salah
benefits.description: This dua after takbeer in salah helps a Muslim start prayer with a clean heart, asking Allah to keep sins far away and make every namaz pure and full of Barakah and forgiveness.
points: Allahumma baid in dua al istiftah keeps sins far like east and west in namaz.
This dua for salah makes the heart clean like a white cloth free from stains.
Allahumma baid baini brings Allah’s Rahmah to wash away all old and new mistakes.
Sana in namaz with this masnoon dua helps a Muslim get more focus in every Salah.
Before namaz dua with these words brings more Barakah and peace in daily Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Takbeer in Salah
when_to_recite.description: This dua after takbeer in salah is a beautiful way to ask Allah for forgiveness and purity, helping your heart feel clean and your namaz full of Barakah and Iman right from the start.
points: After saying takbeer in salah, begin with this dua after takbeer in salah for a clean heart.
When you stand for fard prayer, use the dua before salah to ask Allah for forgiveness.
Before starting your first surah, recite dua al istiftah to make your namaz ki niyat strong.
At the start of every salah, remember to say allahumma baid baini for Barakah and purity.
If you want your prayer for forgiveness to be accepted, read this before namaz dua with hope.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Takbeer in Salah
how_to_perform.description: This dua after takbeer in salah is called dua al istiftah and helps clean your heart before you start reading surah Fatiha. It is a strong prayer for forgiveness and brings Barakah to your namaz and Amal.
steps: After saying takbeer in salah, quietly recite allahumma baid baini with full hope.
Before you start surah Fatiha, use this dua before salah to ask Allah for a clean heart.
If you want your sins washed away, say this prayer for forgiveness with deep feeling.
When making niyat for namaz, remember to include this sana in namaz for more purity.
While standing in prayer, let this dua al istiftah help you focus on zikr allah and forgiveness.

duas.title: Dua When Starting Tahajjud Prayer
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيْلَ وَمِيْكَائِيْلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اِهْدِنِيْ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma rabba jibraa-eel, wameekaa-eel, wa-israafeel faatiras-samawaati wal-ardi, ‘Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, anta tahkumu bayna ‘ibaadika feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdee man tasha-o ilaa siratin mustaqeem
duas.translation:
O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel (great angles), Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.

Ayesha said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite this dua at the beginning of the night (tahajjud) prayer.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْتَتِحُ صَلاَتَهُ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَتْ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ افْتَتَحَ صَلاَتَهُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported: I asked 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, (to tell me) the words with which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. She said: When he got up at night he would commence his prayer with these words: O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, and Michael, and Israfil, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who knowest the unseen and the seen; Thou decidest amongst Thy servants concerning their differences. Guide me with Thy permission in the divergent views (which the people) hold about Truth, for it is Thou Who guidest whom Thou wilt to the Straight Path. [Muslim: 770]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Tahajjud with Barakah and Iman
benefits.description: This dua for tahajjud prayer before salah brings a Muslim closer to Allah, filling the heart with Barakah and Iman, and helps guide to sirat al mustaqim in the quiet of night.
points: Allah gives Barakah to the one who makes this dua for tahajjud prayer.
This dua before salah helps a Muslim find guidance to sirat al mustaqim.
Tahajjud prayer dua brings hope and Iman strong in the darkness of night.
Dua for tahajjud before salah makes the heart soft and full of zikr allah.
Using this dua in night prayer islam helps a Muslim praise Allah and ask for help.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Tahajjud
when_to_recite.description: This dua for tahajjud is recited in the quiet night, asking Allah for guidance, Barakah, and help to find the straight path when hearts are soft and Iman grows strong in the darkness.
points: After waking up for night prayer islam, begin with this dua for tahajjud for guidance.
When you stand for tahajjud ki namaz, use the tahajjud prayer dua before your first rakah.
Before starting your salah, recite dua before salah to ask Allah for sirat al mustaqim.
In the last part of the night, make dua praising Allah for Barakah and tahajjud ki fazilat.
If you feel lost, use this prayer for guidance during tahajjud namaz ka tarika for help.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Tahajjud
how_to_perform.description: This dua for tahajjud is a special way to ask Allah for guidance and truth during the night prayer. It is a beautiful dua praising Allah and seeking His help before salah, making your tahajjud prayer more blessed and full of Barakah. Every Muslim should try to use this dua for salah to get closer to sirat al mustaqim and feel the keutamaan sholat tahajud.
steps: Wake up in the last part of night and make fresh wudu before starting tahajjud prayer.
Stand for tahajjud ki namaz and quietly recite this dua for tahajjud before your salah.
Raise your hands and say this dua for guidance, asking Allah to show you the right path.
After reading the dua, begin your tahajjud prayer with full Iman and hope for Allah’s mercy.
When you finish tahajjud, thank Allah for giving you the chance to pray this night prayer islam.

duas.title: Dua for Tahajjud Prayer (At Beginning)
duas.introduction: Ibn 'Abbas (RA) said: when The Prophet (ﷺ) was standing at night to pray Tahajjud, he used to recite:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وَقَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ (لَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu. Anta qaiyyimus-samawaati wal-ardi wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamdu, Laka mulkus-samawaati wal-ardi wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamdu, anta nurus-samawaati wal-ardi. Walakal-hamdu, antal-haqqu wa wa'dukal-haqqu, wa liqaa'uka Haqqun, wa qauluka Haqqun, wal-jannatu Haqqun wan-naaru Haqqun wannabiyuna Haqqun. Wa Muhammadun (ﷺ) Haqqun, was-sa'atu Haqqun. Allaahumma Laka aslamtu wabika amantu, wa 'Alaika tawakkaltu, wa ilaika anabtu wa bika khaasamtu, wa ilaika ‘haakamtu faghfir li maa qaddamtu wamaa akh-khartu wamaa as-rartu wamaa a’lantu, antal-muqaddimu wa antal muakh-khiru, laa ilaaha illaa anta (in another narration there is laa ilaaha ghairuka instead of laa ilaaha illaa anta)
duas.translation: O Allah! All the praises are for you, You are the Holder of the Heavens and the Earth, And whatever is in them. All the praises are for You; You have the possession of the Heavens and the Earth And whatever is in them. All the praises are for You; You are the Light of the Heavens and the Earth And all the praises are for You; You are the King of the Heavens and the Earth; And all the praises are for You; You are the Truth and Your Promise is the truth, And to meet You is true, Your Word is the truth And Paradise is true And Hell is true And all the Prophets (Peace be upon them) are true; And Muhammad (ﷺ) is true, And the Day of Resurrection is true. O Allah ! I surrender (my will) to You; I believe in You and depend on You. And repent to You, And with Your help I argue (with my opponents, the non-believers) And I take You as a judge (to judge between us). Please forgive me my previous And future sins; And whatever I concealed or revealed And You are the One who make (some people) forward And (some) backward. There is none to be worshipped but you.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَتَهَجَّدُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وَقَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ـ أَوْ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ ـ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَزَادَ عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو أُمَيَّةَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ سَمِعَهُ مِنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night to offer the Tahajjud prayer, he used to say: Allahumma lakal-hamd. Anta qaiyyimus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamd, Laka mulkus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Walakal-hamd, anta nurus-samawati wal-ard. Wa lakal-hamd, anta-l-haq wa wa'duka-lhaq, wa liqa'uka Haq, wa qauluka Haq, wal-jannatu Han wan-naru Haq wannabiyuna Haq. Wa Muhammadun, sallal-lahu'alaihi wasallam, Haq, was-sa'atu Haq. Allahumma aslamtu Laka wabika amantu, wa 'Alaika tawakkaltu, wa ilaika anabtu wa bika khasamtu, wa ilaika hakamtu faghfir li ma qaddamtu wama akh-khartu wama as-rartu wama'a lantu, anta-l-muqaddim wa anta-l-mu akh-khir, la ilaha illa anta (or la ilaha ghairuka). (O Allah! All the praises are for you, You are the Holder of the Heavens and the Earth, And whatever is in them. All the praises are for You; You have the possession of the Heavens and the Earth And whatever is in them. All the praises are for You; You are the Light of the Heavens and the Earth And all the praises are for You; You are the King of the Heavens and the Earth; And all the praises are for You; You are the Truth and Your Promise is the truth, And to meet You is true, Your Word is the truth And Paradise is true And Hell is true And all the Prophets (Peace be upon them) are true; And Muhammad is true, And the Day of Resurrection is true. O Allah ! I surrender (my will) to You; I believe in You and depend on You. And repent to You, And with Your help I argue (with my opponents, the non-believers) And I take You as a judge (to judge between us). Please forgive me my previous And future sins; And whatever I concealed or revealed And You are the One who make (some people) forward And (some) backward. There is none to be worshipped but you . Sufyan said that `Abdul Karim Abu Umaiya added to the above, 'Wala haula Wala quwata illa billah' (There is neither might nor power except with Allah). [Bukhari: 1120]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Tahajjud Prayer (At Beginning)
benefits.description: This dua for tahajjud prayer brings a muslim closer to Allah’s mercy and forgiveness, filling the heart with Iman and hope before starting tahajjud prayer in the quiet of night.
points: Allah’s help comes to the one who makes dua for tahajjud prayer with Iman.
This dua before salah brings Barakah and peace in tahajjud prayer every night.
Before namaz dua helps muslims get forgiveness for old and new sins from Allah.
Tahajjud prayer dua makes the heart strong with tawakkaltu alallah and hope.
La ilaha illa anta in tahajjud ki namaz ki dua keeps a muslim’s Amal pure and clean.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Tahajjud Prayer
when_to_recite.description: This dua for tahajjud prayer fills your heart with Iman and Barakah, praising Allah’s greatness and asking for forgiveness, making your tahajjud namaz shine with hope and tawakkul every night.
points: At the start of tahajjud prayer, recite dua for tahajjud prayer to praise Allah’s power.
When you stand for tahajjud ki namaz ki dua, use this before namaz dua for Barakah.
After making niyat for tahajjud, begin with tahajjud prayer dua to seek forgiveness.
Before your first rakah in tahajjud, say la ilaha illa anta for strong Iman and tawakkaltu alallah.
In the quiet of night, use this dua for tahajjud to fill your tahajjud namaz with hope and Amal.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Tahajjud Prayer
how_to_perform.description: This dua for tahajjud prayer is a strong way to praise Allah and ask for forgiveness at the start of your night prayer. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and helps you remember Allah’s power and mercy before salah. Using this dua for tahajjud makes your tahajjud prayer more special and fills your heart with Iman and hope.
steps: Wake up in the quiet night and make wudu with the niyyah for tahajjud prayer.
Stand for tahajjud and softly recite this dua for tahajjud prayer before your salah.
With your hands raised, say la ilaha illa anta and ask Allah for forgiveness and mercy.
Begin your tahajjud namaz with full trust in Allah, saying tawakkaltu alallah in your heart.
After finishing your tahajjud, thank Allah for letting you pray and use this dua for namaz again.

duas.title: Dua at Tahajjud (At Beginning)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma antal-maliku laa ilaaha illaa anta. anta rabbee wa-anaa ‘abduka, dhalamtu nafsee wa’taraftu bidhanbee faghfir lee dhunoobee jamee'aan innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa anta. wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaaqi laa yahdee li-ahsanihaa illaa anta, wasrif 'annee sayyi-ahaa laa yasrifu 'annee sayyi-ahaa illaa anta
duas.translation: O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ الْمَاجِشُونُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مِنْ آخِرِ مَا يَقُولُ بَيْنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night for prayer he would say: I turn my face in complete devotion to One Who is the Originator of the heaven and the earth and I am not of the polytheists. Verily my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds; There is no partner with Him and this is what I have been commanded (to profess and believe) and I am of the believers. O Allah, Thou art the King, there is no god but Thee, Thou art my Lord, and I am Thy bondman. I wronged myself and make a confession of my Sin. Forgive all my sins, for no one forgives the sins but Thee, and guide me in the best of conduct for none but Thee guideth anyone (in) good conduct. Remove sins from me, for none else but Thou can remove sins from me. Here I am at Thy service, and Grace is to Thee and the whole of good is in Thine hand, and one cannot get nearneststo Thee through evil. My (power as well as existence) is due to Thee (Thine grace) and I turn to Thee (for supplication). Thou art blessed and Thou art exalted. I seek forgiveness from Thee and turn to Thee in repentance: and when he would bow, he would say: O Allah, it is for Thee that I bowed. I affirm my faith in Thee and I submit to Thee, and submit humbly before Thee my hearing, my eyesight, my marrow, my bone, my sinew; and when he would raise his head, he would say: O Allah, our Lord, praise is due to Thee, (the praise) with which is filled the heavens and the earth, and with which is filled that (space) which exists between them, and filled with anything that Thou desireth afterward. And when he prostrated himself, he (the Holy Prophet) would say: O Allah, it is to Thee that I prostrate myself and it is in Thee that I affirm my faith, and I submit to Thee. My face is submitted before One Who created it, and shaped it, and opened his faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the best of Creators; and he would then say between Tashahhud and the pronouncing of salutation: Forgive me of the earlier and later open and secret (sins) and that where I made transgression and that Thou knowest better than I. Thou art the First and the Last. There is no god, but Thee. [Muslim: 771]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua at Tahajjud (At Beginning)
benefits.description: This dua at tahajjud helps a muslim ask Allah for forgiveness and good character, making the night prayer more blessed and full of hope for those who seek Allah’s mercy and guidance.
points: Allahumma in this dua at tahajjud brings true repentance in islam to the heart.
La ilaha illa anta in tahajjud prayer helps muslims get forgiveness for all sins.
Dua for guidance at night prayer islam leads to best Akhlaq and pure Amal.
Before namaz dua in tahajjud keeps a muslim safe from bad habits and wrong ways.
Tahajjud ki namaz with this dua for repentance brings Barakah and Allah’s help.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua At Tahajjud
when_to_recite.description: This dua at tahajjud is a way to ask Allah for forgiveness, good character, and Barakah, making your tahajjud prayer full of Iman and hope when the night is quiet and hearts turn to Allah.
points: At the very start of tahajjud prayer, recite dua at tahajjud to seek Allah’s mercy.
When you stand for night prayer islam, use this dua for forgiveness and repentance in islam.
After making niyat for tahajjud, begin with dua before salah to ask for guidance and good akhlaq.
Before your first rakah in salat al layl, say la ilaha illa anta for Barakah and strong Iman.
In the calm of night, use this dua for tahajjud prayer to clean your heart and ask for maghfirat.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua at Tahajjud
how_to_perform.description: This dua at tahajjud is a heartfelt way to ask Allah for forgiveness and good character during the night prayer. It is a masnoon dua that helps you remember your mistakes and seek Allah’s mercy before salah. Using this dua for tahajjud prayer brings Barakah and makes your tahajjud ki namaz more blessed and full of Iman.
steps: Wake up for tahajjud prayer and make wudu with the pure niyyah for night prayer islam.
Stand for salat al layl and start your dua at tahajjud by saying allahumma with full focus.
Admit your mistakes and ask Allah for forgiveness using la ilaha illa anta in your dua.
Ask Allah to guide you to the best character and keep you away from bad actions.
After finishing your tahajjud dua, thank Allah for His mercy and hope for more Barakah.

duas.title: Dua at the start of the prayer (after takbeer)
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَـدَيْكَ، وَالشَّـرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْـكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayka wa sa'dayka, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadaika, washsharru laysa ilayka, anaa bika wa-ilayka, tabaarakta wa ta'Aalayta, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk
duas.translation: Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Before Salat (After Takbeer)
benefits.description: This dua before salat after takbeer reminds a muslim to start salah with a clean heart, seeking Allah’s forgiveness and Barakah before every prayer for better Amal and Iman.
points: Dua before salat helps muslims begin salah with istighfar and pure niyyah.
Auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem keeps shaitan away before namaz dua starts.
Dua for repentance after takbiratul ihram brings Barakah in every muslim prayer.
Istighfar in dua before salah makes the heart soft and ready for Allah’s mercy.
Before namaz dua connects a muslim to Allah with hope and tawbah in every salah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Before Salat
when_to_recite.description: This dua before salat is a way to show your heart is ready for Allah, asking for forgiveness, Barakah, and help to keep your Iman strong as you begin your salah with hope and tawbah.
points: After takbiratul ihram, start with dua before salat to seek Allah’s mercy and Barakah.
When you stand for salah, use this dua before salah to ask for forgiveness and istighfar.
Before reciting any surah, begin with before namaz dua to show your need for Allah’s help.
At the start of every prayer, remember to say this dua for repentance and strong Iman.
If you want your salah to be full of khushu, use this dua for salah after auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua before Salat
how_to_perform.description: This dua before salat is a simple way to start your prayer with praise and repentance after takbiratul ihram. It reminds you to seek Allah’s forgiveness and remember that all good comes from Him. Using this dua before salah brings Barakah and helps you focus on your namaz dua with a clean heart.
steps: After saying takbiratul ihram, softly recite this dua before salat with full attention.
Remember to say auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem before starting your prayer for protection.
Admit your need for Allah’s help and say astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk for istighfar.
Think about all good coming from Allah and keep your heart humble during this dua.
End your before namaz dua by praising Allah and hoping for His mercy in your salah.

duas.title: Dua at the Beginning of Salah (Allahu Akbar Kabira)
duas.introduction: Say three times:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar Kabeera, Allahu 'Akbar Kabeera, Allahu 'Akbar Kabeera, walhamdu lillaahi katheera, walhamdu lillaahi katheera, walhamdu lillaahi katheera, wa SubhaanAllahi bukratan wa'aseela
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Most Great. Allah is the Greatest, Most Great. Allah is the Greatest, Most Great. Praise is to Allah, abundantly. Praise is to Allah, abundantly. Praise is to Allah, abundantly. Glory is to Allah, at the break of day and at its end.
duas.reference: Hasan li gairihi (Shu'aib Al-Arnaut). Abu Dawud: 764

benefits.title: Benefits of Before Namaz Dua (Allahu Akbar Kabira)
benefits.description: This before namaz dua with allahu akbar kabira fills the heart with praise and thanks, helping a muslim start salah with strong Iman and Barakah from the first takbeer to the last.
points: Allahu akbar in dua before salah lifts the heart with praise and true tawheed.
Alhamdulillah in before namaz dua brings shukr and Barakah in every muslim prayer.
Subhanallah in dua before salat keeps the tongue busy with zikr allah day and night.
Eid takbeer style dua for salah makes the start of namaz full of joy and hope.
Auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem in dua before salah keeps shaitan away from Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua at the Beginning of Salah (Allahu Akbar Kabira)
when_to_recite.description: This before namaz dua fills your heart with praise for Allah, making your salah start with Barakah and Iman, and helps you remember Allah’s greatness and mercy in every prayer you do.
points: At the start of your salah, begin with allahu akbar kabira as a before namaz dua.
When you stand for Eid prayer, use this eid takbeer to praise Allah in your salah.
After saying auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem, recite this dua before salah for focus.
Before your first takbeer in any fard prayer, say this dua for salah to bring alhamdulillah.
While teaching kids about masnoon dua, share this dua before salat for easy learning.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Before Namaz Dua (Allahu Akbar Kabira)
how_to_perform.description: This before namaz dua with allahu akbar kabira fills your salah with praise and thanks to Allah. It is a masnoon dua that reminds you to start your prayer with takbeer, alhamdulillah, and subhanallah, making your heart ready for salah and bringing more Barakah to your muslim prayer.
steps: After saying auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem, begin your salah with allahu akbar kabira.
Repeat allahu akbar three times, feeling the greatness of Allah in your heart.
Say alhamdulillah katheera three times, showing thanks to Allah for all His gifts.
Recite subhanallah bukratan wa aseela, praising Allah in morning and evening.
Use this dua before salah to make your namaz dua more strong and full of zikr allah.

duas.title: Sana Dua (Subhanaka Allahumma Wa Bihamdika)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa ta'aalaa jadduka, wa laa 'ilaaha ghayruk.
duas.translation: Glory is to You O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your Name and Exalted is Your Majesty. There is none worthy of worship but You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ غُنْدَرٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ أَحَدًا مِنْهُمْ يَقْرَأُ ‏ {‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ‏} ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Anas reported: I observed prayer along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and with Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthman (may Allah be pleased with all of them), but I never heard any one of them reciting Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim loudly. [Muslim: 399]

subcategories.title: If afflicted by whisperings in prayer or recitation

duas.title: Dua for Whisperings in Prayer (Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem)
duas.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
duas.translation:
I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

Uthman bin Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the Satan intervenes between me and my prayer and my reciting of the Qur'an and he confounds me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:, That is (the doing of a) Satan (devil) who is known as Khinzab, and when you perceive its effect, seek refuge with Allah from it and spit three times to your left. Uthman (RA) said: I did that and Allah dispelled that from me.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، الْعَلاَءِ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ صَلاَتِي وَقِرَاءَتِي يَلْبِسُهَا عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ذَاكَ شَيْطَانٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ خِنْزِبٌ فَإِذَا أَحْسَسْتَهُ فَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ وَاتْفِلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ ثَلاَثًا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ فَأَذْهَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَنِّي ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, the Satan intervenes between me and my prayer and my reciting of the Qur'an and he confounds me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:, That is (the doing of a) Satan (devil) who is known as Khinzab, and when you perceive its effect, seek refuge with Allah from it and spit three times to your left. I did that and Allah dispelled that from me. [Muslim: 2203]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Whisperings in Prayer (Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem)
benefits.description: This dua for whisperings in prayer helps a muslim keep shaitan away from salah, making the heart calm and focused so every namaz is full of Barakah and true zikr allah.
points: Auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem in dua for salah keeps shaitan’s tricks away.
Dua before salat with audhubillah brings peace and focus in every muslim prayer.
Dua for protection in namaz helps the mind stay clean from bad thoughts always.
Auzubillah in dua before salah makes Amal strong and keeps Iman safe in salah.
Dua for namaz with this masnoon dua lets a muslim remember Allah without worry.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Whisperings in Prayer (Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem)
when_to_recite.description: This dua for whisperings in prayer helps you keep your mind clear from shaitan’s tricks, bringing more khushu and Barakah in your salah, and making your heart strong with Iman every time you pray.
points: Before starting your salah, recite auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem as dua for protection.
If shaitan brings waswasah during namaz, use this dua for whisperings in prayer for help.
When you feel distracted in salah, quietly say audhubillah to focus your heart on Allah.
After making intention for prayer, use this dua before salah to keep shaitan away.
While teaching kids about dua for salah, share this dua for namaz to help them remember.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Whisperings in Prayer
how_to_perform.description: This dua for whisperings in prayer is a strong shield for Muslims, helping to keep the mind clear and the heart focused during salah. Reciting auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem before starting your prayer brings peace and keeps Shaytan’s tricks away from your namaz.
steps: Start by making wudu and then quietly say auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem before your salah.
When you feel your mind wandering in namaz, softly recite this dua for protection.
If you forget your place in prayer, pause and say this masnoon dua to bring back focus.
Before reading any quranic dua in salah, use this dua before salat to keep your zikr allah strong.
After finishing your muslim prayer, repeat audhubillah to keep Shaytan’s whispers away from your Amal.

duas.title: Dua in Ruku (Hadith)
duas.introduction: Narrated by Shaqiq (RA): Hudhaifa (RA) saw a person who was not performing the Ruqu and Sijdah perfectly. He said to him, "You have not prayed and if you die then you would die on a religion other than that of Muhammad (ﷺ)." [1] Qatadah (RA) said, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, the worst thief is the one who steals the salat. Sahabis said, how to steal salat? The Prophet (ﷺ) said: He who does not complete his Ruqu and Sijdah. [2]

duas.title: Dua in Ruku (Subhana Rabbiyal Azeem)
duas.introduction: Say this tasbeeh at least three times:
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Adheem
duas.translation:
Glory to my Lord the Exalted.

The dua will be repeated with the emotions of the mind. Reciting this Tasbeeh at least three times is the conduct and instruction of Rasulullah (ﷺ). Most of the narrations have "Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Adheem" and some of the hadiths have "Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Adheem wa Bihamdihi".

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ، عَنْ صِلَةَ بْنِ زُفَرَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي سُجُودِهِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمَا أَتَى عَلَى آيَةِ رَحْمَةٍ إِلاَّ وَقَفَ وَسَأَلَ وَمَا أَتَى عَلَى آيَةِ عَذَابٍ إِلاَّ وَقَفَ وَتَعَوَّذَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَهَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Hudhaifah narrated that : he performed Salat with the Prophet, and that while he was bowing he would say: (Subhana Rabbiyal Azim); "Glorious is my Lord the Magnificent" and while prostrating: (Subhana Rabbiyal A'la) 'Glorious is my Lord the Most High.' And he would not recite an Ayah mentioning mercy, except that he would stop and ask (for mercy), and he would not recite an Ayah mentioning punishment, except that he would stop and seek refuge (with Allah from it). [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 262]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua in Ruku (Subhana Rabbiyal Azeem)
benefits.description: This dua in ruku brings a muslim closer to Allah, showing respect and praise, and helps keep the heart humble during every step of salah and muslim prayer.
points: Subhana rabbiyal azeem in ruku shows true respect for Allah’s greatness.
Ruku ki dua helps a muslim gain more khushu and focus in every salah.
Saying this tasbeeh in ruku brings more Barakah and reward in namaz.
Ruku dua is a way to follow the sunnah and steps of salah as taught by Prophet.
Zikr Allah in ruku keeps the heart soft and Iman strong during muslim prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua in Ruku (Subhana Rabbiyal Azeem)
when_to_recite.description: This dua in ruku fills your salah with Barakah and reminds you to praise Allah’s greatness, making every ruku a time to show your Iman and love for your Lord in the steps of salah.
points: While bowing in ruku, say subhana rabbiyal azeem as the main dua in ruku.
During every fard or sunnah prayer, use ruku ki dua to praise Allah’s power.
When teaching kids how to pray in islam, show them ruku dua for easy learning.
In long salah, repeat ruku ki tasbeeh to keep your heart close to Allah.
After joining jamaat, follow imam and recite this dua for ruku with full focus.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua in Ruku
how_to_perform.description: Reciting the dua in ruku, Subhana Rabbiyal Azeem, is a key part of salah that shows respect and praise to Allah. This ruku ki dua helps Muslims remember Allah’s greatness and brings more Barakah to every rakah.
steps: Enter ruku by bending at the waist and say subhana rabbiyal azeem with full respect.
While holding the ruku position, repeat this ruku dua three times for more reward.
If you forget what to say in ruku, quietly recite this masnoon dua to complete your tasbeeh.
Before rising from ruku, finish your zikr allah and make sure your back is straight.
In every rakah, use this dua for ruku to keep your muslim prayer strong and full of Iman.

duas.title: Dua For Ruku (Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem Wa Bihamdihi)
duas.introduction: Say this tasbeeh at least three times:
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Adheem wa bihamdihi
duas.translation: Glory and praise be to my mighty Lord.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، - أَوْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ قَوْمِهِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، بِمَعْنَاهُ زَادَ قَالَ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَهَذِهِ الزِّيَادَةُ نَخَافُ أَنْ لاَ تَكُونَ مَحْفُوظَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ انْفَرَدَ أَهْلُ مِصْرَ بِإِسْنَادِ هَذَيْنِ الْحَدِيثَيْنِ حَدِيثِ الرَّبِيعِ وَحَدِيثِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Uqbah ibn Amir: The above (No 868) tradition has also been reported through a different chain of narrators by Uqbah ibn Amir to the same effect. This version adds: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bowed, he said: "Glory and praise be to my mighty Lord" three times, and when he prostrated himself, he said: "Glory and praise be to my most high Lord" three times. Abu Dawud said: We are afraid the addition of the word "praise" is not guarded. [Hasan Sanad (Shu'aib Al-Arnaut). Abu Dawud: 870]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua For Ruku (Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem Wa Bihamdihi)
benefits.description: This dua for ruku helps a muslim praise Allah with both words and heart, making every ruku in salah more meaningful and full of Barakah for those who follow the sunnah.
points: Subhana rabbiyal azeem wa bihamdihi in ruku brings double reward and praise.
Ruku ki dua helps a muslim remember Allah’s greatness and thank Him together.
Using this tasbeeh in ruku adds more Amal and reward in every muslim prayer.
Ruku dua is a sunnah way to make salah steps stronger and more accepted.
Zikr Allah with this dua in ruku keeps the heart soft and Iman fresh in namaz.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Ruku (Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem Wa Bihamdihi)
when_to_recite.description: This dua for ruku brings more Barakah and praise to your salah, letting you honor Allah’s greatness and thank Him with every bow, making your Iman stronger in every prayer step.
points: While bowing in ruku, recite dua for ruku to praise Allah with subhana rabbiyal azeem.
In every rakah, use ruku dua to add more tasbeeh and thank Allah in your muslim prayer.
When learning how to pray, practice this dua in ruku for better prayer steps and focus.
After joining jamaat, follow imam and say ruku ki dua with full heart and Iman.
While teaching kids islamic supplication, show them this dua for ruku for easy learning.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Ruku
how_to_perform.description: Saying the dua for ruku, Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem Wa Bihamdihi, brings more praise and thanks to Allah during your muslim prayer. This ruku dua is a simple way to add Barakah and keep your heart close to Allah in every rakah.
steps: Move into ruku and softly say subhana rabbiyal azeem wa bihamdihi with full focus.
Stay in the ruku position and repeat this dua for ruku at least three times for more reward.
If you feel lost in prayer steps, quietly use this ruku ki dua to keep your zikr allah strong.
Before standing up from ruku, finish your tasbeeh and make sure your back is straight.
In every muslim prayer, add this islamic supplication to bring more Iman and peace to your Amal.

duas.title: Dua in Ruku (Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul Mala Ikati War Ruh)
duas.arabic: سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوْحِ
duas.transliteration: Subboohun, Quddoosun, Rabbul-malaa'ikati warrooh
duas.translation:
Glory (to You), Most Holy (are You), Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

Ayesha (RA) said that Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to recite it in rukoo and sujood.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَسُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ ‘
hadith.translation: Aishah said that the prophet (ﷺ) used to say when bowing and prostrating, “All-Glorious, All-Holy, Lord of the angels and spirit. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 872]

benefits.title: Benefits of Ruku Dua (Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul Mala Ikati War Ruh)
benefits.description: This ruku dua helps a muslim praise Allah as the Lord of angels and the Spirit, making every ruku in salah more special and full of respect for Allah’s greatness.
points: Subbuhun quddusun in ruku shows deep respect for Allah’s pure and holy names.
Ruku ki dua helps a muslim remember Allah’s power over angels and all creation.
Saying this ruku dua brings more Barakah and reward in every muslim prayer.
Using this dua in ruku follows the sunnah and steps of salah as taught by Prophet.
Zikr Allah with this ruku dua keeps the heart clean and Iman strong in namaz.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Ruku Dua (Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul Mala Ikati War Ruh)
when_to_recite.description: This ruku dua fills your prayer with Barakah and reminds you of Allah’s holiness, making every ruku a time to praise the Lord of the angels and the Spirit with strong Iman and love.
points: While bowing in ruku, recite subbuhun quddusun as a special ruku dua for praise.
In long salah, use this dua in ruku after subhana rabbiyal azeem for more zikr allah.
When teaching kids what to say in ruku, show them this ruku ki dua for easy learning.
After joining jamaat, follow imam and say this dua for ruku with full heart and focus.
During night prayers, add this ruku dua to your salah for more Barakah and closeness.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Ruku Dua
how_to_perform.description: Reciting the ruku dua Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul Mala Ikati War Ruh in salah helps Muslims praise Allah as the Lord of all angels and the Spirit. This dua in ruku brings more khushu and keeps your heart soft in every muslim prayer.
steps: Enter ruku and say subbuhun quddusun rabbul mala ikati war ruh with deep respect.
While in ruku, repeat this dua for ruku to remember Allah’s greatness and mercy.
If you forget what to say in ruku, quietly use this ruku ki dua to keep your zikr allah strong.
Before rising from ruku, finish your tasbeeh and make sure your back is straight.
In every rakah, add this islamic dua to your muslim prayer for more Barakah and Iman.

duas.title: Dua For Ruku (Allahumma Laka Rakatu Wa Bika Amantu)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِيْ وَبَصَرِيْ وَمُخِّيْ وَعِظَامِيْ وَعَصَبِيْ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma laka raka'tu, wa bika 'aamantu, wa laka 'aslamtu khasha'a laka sam'ee, wa basaree, wa mukhkhee, wa 'idhaamee, wa 'asabee
duas.translation:
O Allah, to You I bow (in prayer) and in You I believe and to You I have submitted. Before You my hearing is humbled, as is my sight, my mind, my bones, my nerves.

Ali (RA) said, Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to say these words in rukoo.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ الْمَاجِشُونِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ كَبَّرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ لِي إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لاَ يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعِظَامِي وَعَصَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ فَأَحْسَنَ صُورَتَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ وَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَلَّمَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَالْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ‘
hadith.translation: Ali b. Ali Talib said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up for prayer, he uttered the takbir (Allah is most great), then said: I have turned my face, breaking with all others, towards Him Who created the heavens and the earth, and I am not a polytheist. My prayer and my devotion, my life and my death belong to Allah, the Lord of the Universe, Who has no partner. That is what I have been commanded, and I am first of Muslims (those who surrender themselves). O Allah, Thou art the King. There is no God but Thee. Thou art my Lord and I am Thy servant. I have wronged myself, but I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me all my sins; Thou Who alone canst forgive sins; and guide me to the best qualities. Thou Who alone canst guide to the best of them; and turn me from evil ones. Thou who alone canst turn from evil qualities. I come to serve and please Thee. All good is in Thy Hands, and evil does not pertain to Thee. I seek refuge in Thee and turn to Thee, Who art blessed and exalted. I ask Thy forgiveness and turn to thee in repentance. When he bowed, he said: O Allah, to Thee I bow, in Thee I trust, and to Thee I submit myself. My hearing, my sight, my brain, my bone and my sinews humble themselves before Thee. When he raised his head, he said: Allah listens to him who praises Him. O our lord, and all praises be to Thee in the whole of the heavens and the earth, and what is between them, and in whatever Thou creates afterwards. When he prostrated himself, he said: O Allah, to Thee I prostrate myself, to Thee I trust, and to Thee I submit myself. My face prostrated itself before Him Who created it, fashioned it, and fashioned it in the best shape, and brought forth its hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the best of creators. When he saluted at the end of the prayer, he said: O Allah, forgive me my former and my latter sins, my open and secret sins, my sins in exceeding the limits, and what Thou knowest better than I. Thou art He Who puts forward and puts back. There is deity but Thee. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 760]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua For Ruku (Allahumma Laka Rakatu Wa Bika Amantu)
benefits.description: This dua for ruku helps a muslim show full trust and surrender to Allah, making every ruku in salah a time of true belief and respect for the Creator in every part of the body.
points: Allahumma laka rakatu in ruku shows full Amal and trust in Allah’s power.
Ruku ki dua helps a muslim submit hearing, sight, and mind to Allah alone.
Using this ruku dua brings more Barakah and reward in every muslim prayer.
Ruku dua is a sunnah way to make salah steps more humble and accepted.
Zikr Allah with this dua in ruku keeps the heart soft and Iman strong in namaz.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Ruku
when_to_recite.description: This dua for ruku is said in salah to show full submission to Allah, bringing your heart, mind, and body together in true humility and Iman during every bowing in prayer.
points: During every ruku in salah, recite the dua for ruku to show your full submission.
After saying subhana rabbiyal azeem three times, add this ruku dua for more khushu.
When learning what to say in ruku, teach children this ruku ki dua for their islamic prayer guide.
In extra nawafil or sunnah prayers, use this dua in ruku to increase your zikr allah.
If you want to follow masnoon dua in ruku islam, recite this muslim dua after your main tasbih.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Ruku
how_to_perform.description: This dua for ruku, Allahumma Laka Rakatu Wa Bika Amantu, helps Muslims show full trust and surrender to Allah in every rakah. Saying this ruku dua in salah brings more khushu and keeps your heart soft in every muslim prayer.
steps: Step into ruku and say this dua for ruku with your heart full of Iman and hope.
While in ruku, repeat the words slowly to feel the meaning and show your trust in Allah.
If you forget what to say in ruku, quietly use this ruku ki dua to keep your zikr allah strong.
Before standing up, finish your tasbeeh and make sure your back is straight for proper Amal.
In every muslim prayer, add this islamic prayer guide to bring more Barakah and peace to your namaz.

duas.title: Dua at Ruku
duas.introduction: It is narrated on the authority of Auf Ibn Malik Ashja'i (RA) that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in ruku:
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوْتِ وَالْمَلَكُوْتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ
duas.transliteration: Subhaana dhil-jabarooti, wal-malakooti, wal-kibriyaa'i, wal-'adhamah
duas.translation:
Glory is to You, Master of power, of dominion, of majesty and greatness.

Then he prostrated and paused as long as he stood and recited Surat Aal Imran and then recited other surahs one after another.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ قُمْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً فَقَامَ فَقَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ لاَ يَمُرُّ بِآيَةِ رَحْمَةٍ إِلاَّ وَقَفَ فَسَأَلَ وَلاَ يَمُرُّ بِآيَةِ عَذَابٍ إِلاَّ وَقَفَ فَتَعَوَّذَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ رَكَعَ بِقَدْرِ قِيَامِهِ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ بِقَدْرِ قِيَامِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ فِي سُجُودِهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ - ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَرَأَ بِآلِ عِمْرَانَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ سُورَةً سُورَةً ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i: I stood up to pray along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ); he got up and recited Surat al-Baqarah (Surah 2). When he came to a verse which spoke of mercy, he stopped and made supplication, and when he came to verse which spoke of punishment, he stopped and sought refuge in Allah, then he bowed and paused as long as he stood (reciting Surah al-Baqarah), and said while bowing, "Glory be to the Possessor of greatness, the Kingdom, grandeur and majesty." :Then he prostrated himself and paused as long as he stood up and recited Surat Aal Imran (Surah 3) and then recited many surahs one after another. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 873]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua in Ruku (Subhaana Dhil-Jabarooti Wal-Malakooti Wal-Kibriyaa'i Wal-'Adhamah)

Ruku ki dua helps a Muslim remember Allah’s greatness and high position always.
Using this ruku dua brings more Barakah and reward in every Muslim prayer.
Ruku dua is a sunnah way to make salah steps full of respect and praise for Allah.
Zikr Allah with this dua in ruku keeps the heart humble and Iman strong in namaz.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua In Ruku

points: While bowing in ruku, use this dua in ruku to praise Allah’s greatness and power.
