how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua in Ruku
how_to_perform.description: This ruku dua is said while bowing in Salah, showing praise to Allah’s greatness and power. It helps every Muslim remember Allah’s might and brings more Barakah to your namaz and daily Amal.
steps: Stand in Salah and after reciting Surah, bow down for ruku and say the ruku dua with full heart.
While in ruku, keep your back straight and say this dua in ruku to praise Allah’s power.
Use the ruku ki dua softly, thinking about all praise due to Allah and His greatness.
Before rising from ruku, repeat the ruku Islam dua to make your zikr Allah strong.
In every rakah, remember to use this Muslim prayer for ruku to get more closeness to Allah.

duas.title: Dua in Rukoo (Subhanaka wa Bihamdika Astaghfiruka)
duas.introduction: ‘Abdullah ibn Mas’ud (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in bowing and prostration:
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوْبُ اِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanaka wa bihamdika, 'astaghfiruka wa 'atoobu 'ilayk
duas.translation: Glory is to You O Allah, and praise. I ask you for forgiveness and I turn to you (from sinning).

benefits.title: Benefits of Ruku Dua (Subhanaka wa Bihamdika Astaghfiruka)
benefits.description: This ruku dua brings a Muslim closer to Allah’s mercy and forgiveness, making every ruku in Salah a time for praise, repentance, and seeking Barakah from the Most Forgiving.
points: Allah forgives sins when a Muslim says ruku dua with a heart full of Iman.
Ruku ki dua helps Muslims remember Allah’s greatness and stay humble in Salah.
Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika in ruku brings Barakah and peace in namaz.
Astaghfirullah in ruku Islam wipes away mistakes and brings hope for forgiveness.
Dua for repentance in ruku makes a Muslim’s Amal and Salah more strong and pure.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Ruku Dua
when_to_recite.description: This ruku dua is a way to ask Allah for forgiveness and praise Him, bringing Barakah and mercy to your salah and helping your heart turn back to Allah with Iman and hope.
points: During every ruku in salah, recite this ruku dua for forgiveness and Barakah.
After saying subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika, add this dua in ruku for repentance.
In times you feel you made mistakes, use this dua for forgiveness of sins in ruku Islam.
When teaching what to say in ruku, show kids this ruku ki dua as a prayer for forgiveness.
If you want to follow masnoon dua, say this Muslim dua after your main tasbih in ruku.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Ruku Dua for Forgiveness
how_to_perform.description: This ruku dua is recited while bowing in Salah, asking Allah for forgiveness and turning to Him with praise. It is a simple way to seek mercy and Barakah in your namaz and daily Amal.
steps: Enter ruku after Surah and say subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika with full focus.
In the bowing position, recite this ruku dua for forgiveness and mean every word.
Ask Allah for forgiveness of sins by saying astaghfirullah with a soft heart.
Before standing up, repeat the dua for repentance to make your zikr Allah strong.
In every rakah, use this Muslim prayer for ruku to get more closeness to Allah.

duas.title: Dua in Ruku (Dua for forgiveness)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma Rabbanaa wa bihamdika Allahum-maghfir lee
duas.translation:
Glory is to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise is Yours. O Allah, forgive me. [1]

Narrated from Aisha (RA), she said that according to the instructions of the Qur'an, [2] the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this dua more and more in bowing down and prostration - (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَسُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in his bowing and prostrations, "Subhanaka l-lahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika; Allahumma ghfir li.' (Exalted [from unbecoming attributes] Are you O Allah our Lord, and by Your praise [do I exalt you]. O Allah! Forgive me). [[1] Bukhari: 794 [2] Sura Nasr 110:3]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua in Ruku
benefits.description: This dua in ruku brings a Muslim closer to Allah’s mercy and forgiveness, helping hearts stay humble and pure while bowing in Salah and asking for Allah’s kindness and Barakah in every prayer.
points: Allah’s mercy comes close when a Muslim says subhanakallahumma in ruku.
Ruku dua helps wipe away old sins and brings hope for forgiveness from Allah.
Saying allahummaghfirli in ruku makes the heart soft and full of Iman.
Dua for forgiveness in ruku brings Barakah and peace in every Salah.
Using this dua e maghfirat in namaz helps a Muslim remember Allah’s greatness.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua In Ruku
when_to_recite.description: This dua in ruku is a simple way to ask Allah for forgiveness and praise Him, filling your salah with Barakah and making your heart soft with Iman and hope for maghfirat.
points: While bowing in ruku, recite this dua in ruku for forgiveness and Barakah.
After saying subhanakallahumma wabihamdika, add this ruku dua for allahummaghfirli.
In times you feel sorry for sins, use this dua for forgiveness of all sins in ruku.
When teaching kids what to say in ruku, show them this ruku ki dua as a forgiveness prayer Islam.
If you want to follow masnoon dua, say this dua e maghfirat after your main tasbih in ruku.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua in Ruku for Forgiveness
how_to_perform.description: This dua in ruku is said while bowing in Salah, asking Allah for forgiveness and praising Him. It is a simple way to seek Allah’s mercy and bring Barakah to your namaz and daily Amal.
steps: After reciting Surah, bow for ruku and say subhanakallahumma wabihamdika with full heart.
In ruku, recite allahummaghfirli dua for forgiveness and mean every word you say.
Ask Allah for forgiveness of all sins by saying this dua maghfirat with a soft voice.
Before rising from ruku, repeat the forgiveness prayer Islam to make your zikr Allah strong.
In every rakah, use this Muslim prayer for ruku to get more closeness to Allah and more Iman.

duas.title: Dua in Rukoo
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي وَمَا اِسْتَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma laka raka’tu wa bika amantu wa laka aslamtu, anta rabbi khasha’a laka sam’i wa basari wa mukh-khi wa ‘azmi wa ‘asabi wa ma istaqallat bihi qadami lillahi rabbil ‘alamin
duas.translation: O Allah, I have bowed down to You, I have believed, I have surrendered. You are my Rabb, my ear-eye, my brain, my bones, my spine and my legs, all that you are carrying (i.e. my existence) have been humbled before Allah Almighty.

duas.title: Dua for Ruku
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanaka allahumma wa bihamdika, laa ilaaha illaa anta.
duas.translation: O Allah glory is to You; there is no worthy of worship except You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْمِصِّيصِيُّ الْمِقْسَمِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ فَقَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ ذَهَبَ إِلَى بَعْضِ نِسَائِهِ فَتَحَسَّسْتُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ رَاكِعٌ أَوْ سَاجِدٌ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي إِنِّي لَفِي شَأْنٍ وَإِنَّكَ لَفِي آخَرَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that 'Aishah said: "I noticed that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was missing one night, and I thought he had gone to one of his other wives. I tried to feel for him, and I found him bowing or prostrating and saying: 'SubhanakAllahumma wa bihamdika la ilaha ila ant (Glory and praise be to You, O Allah, there is none worthy of worship but You.)'" She said: "May my father and mother be ransomed for you. I thought you were doing one thing and you were doing something else altogether." [Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 1131]

duas.title: Dua After Ruku (Sami Allahu Liman Hamidah)
duas.introduction: Dua for rising from rukoo:
duas.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Sami'Allahu liman hamidah
duas.translation: Allah hears whoever praises Him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam says, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah," you should say, "Allahumma Rabbana laka l-hamd." And if the saying of any one of you coincides with that of the angels, all his past sins will be forgiven." [Bukhari: 796]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Ruku
benefits.description: This dua after ruku reminds Muslims that Allah listens to every word of praise, making Salah more meaningful and filling the heart with thankfulness and hope for Allah’s Barakah and kindness.
points: Allah listens to the one who says sami allahu liman hamidah after ruku.
Praising Allah in ruku dua brings more Barakah and blessings in Salah.
This dua after ruku helps a Muslim feel close to Allah in every namaz step.
Saying rabbana lakal hamd after ruku fills the heart with shukr and Iman.
Using this dua in salah teaches Muslims to thank Allah in every prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Ruku
when_to_recite.description: This dua after ruku reminds us Allah hears every praise, bringing Barakah and Iman to your salah and making your heart feel close to Him with every step in namaz.
points: Right after rising from ruku, recite sami allahu liman hamidah as dua after ruku.
When teaching salah steps, show kids this dua praising Allah after ruku in namaz ka tarika.
In every fard or sunnah prayer, use this ruku dua after bowing to follow masnoon dua.
While learning how to pray namaz, remember to say this dua in salah after every ruku.
If you want to increase zikr Allah, say sami allahu liman hamidah with full heart after ruku.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua After Ruku
how_to_perform.description: This dua after ruku is said when rising from bowing in Salah, showing that Allah hears all praise. It is a key part of namaz steps and helps every Muslim remember to praise Allah with a full heart.
steps: When you rise from ruku, say sami allahu liman hamidah with clear voice and focus.
Stand straight and recite this dua after ruku to show all praise is for Allah.
Use this ruku dua in every rakah to make your salah steps correct and full of Barakah.
After saying sami allahu liman hamidah, pause a bit and feel the praise in your heart.
In every prayer, remember this Muslim prayer to keep your zikr Allah strong and Iman high.

duas.title: Dua After Ruku (Allahumma Rabbana Wa Lakal-Hamd)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ، أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbanaa lakal-hamdu mil'as-samawaati wa mil’al-ardi, wa mil'a maa shi'ta min shay'in ba'du, ahlath-thanaa'i wal-majdi, ahaqqu maa qaalal 'abdu, wa kullunaa laka 'abdun. Allaahumma laa maani'a limaa a'taita, wa laa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta, wa laa yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jaddu
duas.translation: O Allah, our Rabb (Lord), to You is praise in all the heavens and all the earth, and all that You Will (to create) afterwards, O You, Who are worthy of praise and glory, the most worthy of what a slave says - and we are all Your slaves: no one can withhold what You give, or give what You withhold, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person against You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ قَزْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his head after bowing, he said: O Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill all the heavens and the earth, and all that it pleases Thee besides (them). O, thou art worthy of praise and glory, most worthy of what a servant says, and we all are Thy servants, no one can withhold what Thou givest or give what Thou withholdest, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person against Thee. [Muslim: 477]

In every prayer, use this Muslim prayer for ruku to keep your zikr Allah and Iman strong.

subcategories.title: Duas while in a state of rukoo

duas.title: Rabbana Lakal Hamd (Dua After Ruku)
duas.introduction: The duas of rukoo' are narrated in different sahih hadiths in four ways:
duas.arabic: (اَللَّهُمَّ) رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
duas.transliteration: (1) Rabbanaa lakal-hamd (2) Allaahumma Rabbanaa lakal-hamd
duas.translation: [1] Our Lord, to You be the praise. [2] O Allah, our Lord, to You be the praise.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Imam says, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah," you should say, "Allahumma Rabbana laka l-hamd." And if the saying of any one of you coincides with that of the angels, all his past sins will be forgiven." [Bukhari: 796]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Ruku (Rabbana Lakal Hamd)
benefits.description: This short dua after ruku fills Salah with thankfulness, helping Muslims remember Allah’s gifts and making every prayer more full of Barakah and Iman for those who say it with a true heart.
points: Allah’s praise grows in the heart when a Muslim says rabbana lakal hamd after ruku.
This dua after ruku brings more Barakah and shukr in every namaz for Muslims.
Saying rabbana wa lakal hamd in prayer helps a Muslim remember Allah’s gifts.
Rabbana lakal hamd meaning teaches Muslims to thank Allah in every Amal.
Using this ruku dua in Salah makes the heart soft and full of Iman and peace.

when_to_recite.description: This dua after ruku is short but full of Barakah, giving thanks to Allah in every salah, helping us remember His gifts and keep our Iman strong in every rakah of namaz.
points: Right after rising from ruku, recite the dua after ruku in every rakah of salah.
In Fard and Sunnah prayers, use rabbana lakal hamd to praise Allah for His gifts.
While teaching kids salah, help them say the ruku dua after ruku for their namaz.
During taraweeh or tahajjud, remember to say rabbana wa lakal hamd after ruku.
When you want to feel more khushu in prayer, use this dua after ruku with full heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Ruku
how_to_perform.description: This dua after ruku is said in every Salah to praise Allah and show thanks for His gifts. Saying rabbana lakal hamd brings Barakah and keeps your heart close to Allah during namaz, making your Amal better.
steps: After rising from ruku in Salah, say rabbana lakal hamd with full focus and Iman.
Stand straight and recite this ruku dua softly, feeling the meaning of rabbana lakal hamd.
Let your heart fill with thanks as you say this dua praising Allah in every rakah.
Use the words rabbana wa lakal hamd or rabbana lakal hamdu as taught in masnoon dua.
In every namaz, remember the meaning of rabbana lakal hamd and keep your zikr Allah strong.

duas.title: Rabbana Wa Lakal Hamd (Dua After Rukoo)
duas.arabic: (اَللَّهُمَّ) رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
duas.transliteration: (1) Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamd (2) Allaahumma Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamd
duas.translation:
[1] Our Lord and to You be the praise. [2] O Allah, our Lord and to You be the praise.

After rukoo' one should stand straight for a while. It is obligatory upon all. If anyone goes to prostration before stand straight (for a while) then it will invalidate his salaah. In the state of rukoo' one should say one of these four duas. It is recommended to say these supplications alternatively.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَكَعَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ يُكَبِّرُ، وَإِذَا قَامَ مِنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: When the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah," (Allah heard those who sent praises to Him), he would say, "Rabbana wa laka l-hamd." On bowing and raising his head from it the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say Takbir. He also used to say Takbir on rising after the two prostrations. (See Hadith No. 656). [Bukhari: 795]

This dua after ruku helps a Muslim remember to praise Allah in every namaz.
Saying rabbana lakal hamd in prayer fills the heart with shukr and Iman.
Rabbana walakal hamd in Salah teaches Muslims to thank Allah for His gifts.
Using this dua in every Salah step brings more peace and Amal to a Muslim’s life.

points: After standing up from rukoo, recite dua after rukoo in each rakah of your salah.
In both Fard and Sunnah namaz, use rabbana wa lakal hamd to praise Allah.
While teaching children how to pray namaz, help them learn this dua after rukoo.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua After Rukoo
how_to_perform.description: This dua after rukoo is said right after you rise from ruku in Salah, showing thanks and praise to Allah. Saying rabbana wa lakal hamd in every rakah helps your heart stay close to Allah and brings more Barakah in your namaz.
steps: When you stand up from ruku, recite rabbana wa lakal hamd with a calm heart and mind.
Stand still and say this dua after ruku softly, thinking about the praise for Allah.
In every rakah, use this dua praising Allah to make your salah prayer more strong.

Let your zikr Allah grow by saying this Muslim prayer in every salah and feel the Barakah.

duas.title: Dua When Raising from Ruku #1
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamd, hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh
duas.translation: Our Lord, praise is Yours, abundant, holy and blessed praise.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُجْمِرِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، قَالَ كُنَّا يَوْمًا نُصَلِّي وَرَاءَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ وَرَاءَهُ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنِ الْمُتَكَلِّمُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ رَأَيْتُ بِضْعَةً وَثَلاَثِينَ مَلَكًا يَبْتَدِرُونَهَا، أَيُّهُمْ يَكْتُبُهَا أَوَّلُ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Rifa`a bin Rafi` Az-Zuraqi: One day we were praying behind the Prophet. When he raised his head from bowing, he said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah." A man behind him said, "Rabbana wa laka l-hamdu, hamdan kathiran taiyiban mubarakan fihi" (O our Lord! All the praises are for You, many good and blessed praises). When the Prophet completed the prayer, he asked, "Who has said these words?" The man replied, "I." The Prophet said, "I saw over thirty angels competing to write it first." Prophet rose (from bowing) and stood straight till all the vertebrae of his spinal column came to a natural position. Sahih al-Bukhari 799 [Bukhari: 799]

duas.title: Dua After Raising from Ruku
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ
duas.transliteration: Alla-humma Rabbanaa lakal ‘hamdu mil-as samawaati wa mil-al ardi wa mil-aa maa baina humaa, wa mil-aa maa shi’ta min shayin ba’du
duas.translation:
Praise be to You, O Allah, our Lord! Praise be to You, it fills the heavens, fills the earth, completes all that is in between them, and then it completes whatever You will.

Ibn Abi Aufa (R), Ibn Abbas (RA), Ali (RA) and other Companions said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say these words when he stand up from rukoo'.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ ظَهْرَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: ('Abdullah b ) Ibn Abi Aufa reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his back from the rukd' he pronounced: Allah listened to him who praised Him. O Allah! our Lord! unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides them. Sahih Muslim 476a [Muslim: 476]

duas.title: Dua When Raising From Ruku #2
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيءٍ بَعْدُ أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ، لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma, rabbanaa lakal ‘hamdu, mil-as samawaati wa mil-al ardi wamaa bainahumaa, wa mil-aa maa shi’ta min shayin ba’du, ahlath thanaa’i wal majdi. Laa- maani'a limaa a'taita, walaa mut'ia limaa mana'ta, walaa yanfa'u dhal jaddi minkal jaddu
duas.translation: Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and that which is between them, and that which will please Thee besides (them). Worthy art Thou of all praise and glory. No one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest. And the greatness O! the great availeth not against Thee.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ibn Abbas reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his head after bowing, he said: Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and that which is between them, and that which will please Thee besides (them). Worthy art Thou of all praise and glory. No one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest. And the greatness O! the great availeth not against Thee. [Muslim: 478]

duas.title: Dua Praising Allah (Dua After Ruku)
duas.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ مُبَارَكًا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضَى
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fihi mubarakan ‘alaihi kamaa yuhibbu rabbunaa wa yardaa
duas.translation:
Praise be to Allah, much good and blessed praise as our Lord loves and is pleased with

Rifa'ah bin Rafi' (RA) said that: "I prayed behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and I sneezed and said: (the dua is mentioned above) When he finished praying, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Who is the one who spoke during the prayer?' But no one said anything. Then he said it a second time: 'Who is the one who spoke during the prayer?' So Rifa'ah bin Rafi bin Afrah (RA) said: 'It was me, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'I said: (the dua is mentioned above)' The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'By the One in Whose hand is my soul, thirty-odd angels hastened to see which of them would take it up.'

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَمِّ، أَبِيهِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَطَسْتُ فَقُلْتُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ مُبَارَكًا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضَى ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنِ الْمُتَكَلِّمُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يُكَلِّمْهُ أَحَدٌ ثُمَّ قَالَهَا الثَّانِيَةَ ‏"‏ مَنِ الْمُتَكَلِّمُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ رَافِعِ بْنِ عَفْرَاءَ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ قُلْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ مُبَارَكًا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضَى ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدِ ابْتَدَرَهَا بِضْعَةٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ مَلَكًا أَيُّهُمْ يَصْعَدُ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from Mu'adh bin Rifa'ah bin Rafi' that : His father said: "I prayed behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and I sneezed and said: 'Al-hamdu lillahi, hamdan kathiran tayiban mubarakan fih, mubarakan'alaihi, kama yuhibbu rabbuna wa yarda (Praise be to Allah, much good and blessed praise as our Lord loves and is pleased with.)' When he finished praying, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Who is the one who spoke during the prayer?' But no one said anything. Then he said it a second time: 'Who is the one who spoke during the prayer?' So Rifa'ah bin Rafi bin Afrah said: 'It was me, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'I said: "Praise be to Allah, much good and blessed praise as our Lord loves and is pleased with.'" The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'By the One in Whose hand is my soul, thirty-odd angels hastened to see which of them would take it up.'" [Hasan (Albani). Sunan Nasai: 931]
