duas.title: Dua after Ruku in Namaz
duas.arabic: لِرَبِّيَ الْحَمْدُ
duas.transliteration: li-rabbi-al hamd
duas.translation: To my Lord belongs all praise

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، مَوْلَى الأَنْصَارِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ بَنِي عَبْسٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ - ثَلاَثًا - ذُو الْمَلَكُوتِ وَالْجَبَرُوتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اسْتَفْتَحَ فَقَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَكَانَ رُكُوعُهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ قِيَامِهِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَكَانَ قِيَامُهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ رُكُوعِهِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لِرَبِّيَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَكَانَ سُجُودُهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ قِيَامِهِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِهِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ وَكَانَ يَقْعُدُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ نَحْوًا مِنْ سُجُودِهِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَقَرَأَ فِيهِنَّ الْبَقَرَةَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ وَالنِّسَاءَ وَالْمَائِدَةَ أَوِ الأَنْعَامَ شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Hudhayfah: Hudhayfah saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) praying at night. He said: Allah is most great" three times, "Possessor of kingdom, grandeur, greatness and majesty." He then began (his prayer) and recited Surah al-Baqarah; then he bowed and he paused in bowing as long as he stood up; he said while bowing, "Glory be to my mighty Lord," "Glory be to my mighty Lord" ; then he raised his head, after bowing: then he stood up and he paused as long as he paused in bowing and said, "Praise be to my Lord" ; then he prostrated and paused in prostration as long as he paused in the standing position; he said while prostrating: "Glory be to my most high Lord"; then he raised his head after prostration, and sat as long as he prostrated, and said while sitting: "O my Lord forgive me." He offered four rak'ahs of prayer and recited in them Surah al-Baqarah, Aal Imran, an-Nisa, al-Ma'idah, or al-An'am. The narrator Shu'bah doubted. [Sahih (Al-Albani). Abu Dawud: 874]

duas.title: Dua After Ruku
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ، اَللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ اَللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْوَسَخِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma, rabbanaa lakal ‘hamdu, mil-as samawaati wa mil-al ardi wa mil-aa maa shi’ta min shayin ba’du, Allaahumma tah-hirni bith-thalji wal baaradi wal ma-il baarad, Allaahumma tah-hirni minadh dhunubi wal khataaya kamaa yunakkath thawbul abyadu minal wasakh.
duas.translation: O Allah! our Lord, unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides (them). O Allah! purify me with snow, (water of) hail and with cold water; O Allah. cleanse me from the sins and errors just as a white garment is cleansed from dirt.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ ظَهْرَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: ('Abdullah b ) Ibn Abi Aufa reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his back from the rukd' he pronounced: Allah listened to him who praised Him. O Allah! our Lord! unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides them. [Muslim: 476]

duas.title: Dua during Sujood (Hadith)
duas.introduction: Abu Hurairah (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said that man is most close to his Lord in prostration. Therefore, do dua more and more in sujood.

duas.title: Sujood Dua (Hadith)
duas.introduction: Ibn 'Abbas (RA) said, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, I am forbidden to read the Qur'an in bowing and prostration. But in ruku 'you describe the greatness of Allah. And do more and more Dua in sujood. Sujood is a suitable place for accepting your Dua. [1] It is evident from the above-mentioned hadiths that, one should supplicate more and more in the state of prostration. And in this state, the dua is answered. So, one can supplicate any dua mentioned in authentic hadiths except quranic duas. Cause it is prohibited to supplicate by quranic dua in the state of bowing down and prostration.

duas.title: Dua for Ruku and Sujood
duas.introduction: Qatadah (RA) said, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, the worst thief is the one who steals the prayer. The Companions said, how do you steal the prayer? The Prophet (ﷺ) said: He who does not complete his bowing and prostration.

duas.title: Dua in Sujood (Subhana Rabbiyal Ala)
duas.introduction: Say at least three times:
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A'laa
duas.translation:
Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.

This dua should be repeat again and again with the emotion of the mind. Reciting this tasbeeh at least three times is the conduct and instruction of Rasulullah (ﷺ). Most of the narrations mention "Subhaana Rabbiyal-A 'laa" and some of the hadiths describe "Subhana Rabbiyal-A 'laa wa bihamdihi". After reciting every verse of mercy, he stopped and asked Allah for it, and after reciting every verse of punishment, he stopped and asked Allah for refuge from it.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ بْنِ الأَحْنَفِ، عَنْ صِلَةَ بْنِ زُفَرَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَافْتَتَحَ الْبَقَرَةَ فَقُلْتُ يَرْكَعُ عِنْدَ الْمِائَةِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَضَى فَقُلْتُ يُصَلِّي بِهَا فِي رَكْعَةٍ فَمَضَى فَقُلْتُ يَرْكَعُ بِهَا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ افْتَتَحَ النِّسَاءَ فَقَرَأَهَا ثُمَّ افْتَتَحَ آلَ عِمْرَانَ فَقَرَأَهَا يَقْرَأُ مُتَرَسِّلاً إِذَا مَرَّ بِآيَةٍ فِيهَا تَسْبِيحٌ سَبَّحَ وَإِذَا مَرَّ بِسُؤَالٍ سَأَلَ وَإِذَا مَرَّ بِتَعَوُّذٍ تَعَوَّذَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَانَ رُكُوعُهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ قِيَامِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ طَوِيلاً قَرِيبًا مِمَّا رَكَعَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَانَ سُجُودُهُ قَرِيبًا مِنْ قِيَامِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Hudhaifa reported: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one night and he started reciting al-Baqara. I thought that he would bow at the end of one hundred verses, but he proceeded on; I then thought that he would perhaps recite the whole (surah) in a rak'ah, but he proceeded and I thought he would perhaps bow on completing (this surah). He then started al-Nisa', and recited it; he then started Al-i-'Imran and recited leisurely. And when he recited the verses which referred to the Glory of Allah, he glorified (by saying Subhan Allah-Glory to my Lord the Great), and when he recited the verses which tell (how the Lord) is to be begged, he (the Holy Prophet) would then beg (from Him), and when he recited the verses dealing with protection from the Lord, he sought (His) protection and would then bow and say: Glory be to my Mighty Lord; his bowing lasted about the same length of time as his standing (and then on returning to the standing posture after ruku') he would say: Allah listened to him who praised Him, and he would then stand about the same length of time as he had spent in bowing. He would then prostrate himself and say: Glory be to my Lord most High, and his prostration lasted nearly the same length of time as his standing. In the hadith transmitted by Jarir the words are:" He (the Holy Prophet) would say:" Allah listened to him who praised Him, our Lord, to Thee i the praise." [Muslim: 772]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua in Sujood
benefits.description: This dua in sujood brings you closer to Allah, filling your sajdah with praise and making your salah more loved by Allah every time you say subhana rabbiyal ala in prayer.
points: Subhana rabbiyal ala in sujood brings more Barakah and peace in every sajdah.
This sujood dua helps a Muslim show true respect and praise to Allah in salah.
Saying dua in sujood makes your Amal and Iman stronger with every prayer step.
Using this masnoon dua in sujood brings more reward and closeness to Allah.
What to say in sujood is taught by sunnah, keeping your salah pure and accepted.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua in Sujood
when_to_recite.description: This dua in sujood, Subhana Rabbiyal Ala, is said to honor Allah in the lowest place of salah, showing true respect and asking for Barakah and forgiveness in every sajdah of your Muslim prayer.
points: During every sajdah in salah, recite dua in sujood to praise Allah the Most High.
In tahajjud prayer, say subhana rabbiyal ala in sujood for more Barakah and closeness.
When making extra sujood after fard namaz, use sujood dua for more acceptance.
While asking for forgiveness, add dua for sujood in your sajdah for Allah’s mercy.
In sunnah or nafl prayers, remember what to say in sujood for more reward and Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua in Sujood
how_to_perform.description: This dua in sujood is said while your head is on the ground, showing true respect to Allah. It is a simple zikr Allah that brings Barakah and makes your namaz full of blessings and Iman.
steps: Lower your head to the ground and softly say subhana rabbiyal ala in your sujood.
Let your heart feel close to Allah as you repeat this sujood dua three times in prayer.
Remember to keep your body still and focus on the meaning of this dua for sujood.
When praying alone or in jamaat, always use this masnoon dua in every sujood.
Try to make this Muslim prayer a habit in all your salah to get more Barakah and peace.

duas.title: Dua for Sajdah (Sajda Dua)
duas.introduction: Say at least three times:
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A'laa wa bihamdihi
duas.translation: Glory and praise be to my most high Lord.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، - أَوْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ - عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ قَوْمِهِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، بِمَعْنَاهُ زَادَ قَالَ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَهَذِهِ الزِّيَادَةُ نَخَافُ أَنْ لاَ تَكُونَ مَحْفُوظَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ انْفَرَدَ أَهْلُ مِصْرَ بِإِسْنَادِ هَذَيْنِ الْحَدِيثَيْنِ حَدِيثِ الرَّبِيعِ وَحَدِيثِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Uqbah ibn Amir: The above (No 868) tradition has also been reported through a different chain of narrators by Uqbah ibn Amir to the same effect. This version adds: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bowed, he said: "Glory and praise be to my mighty Lord" three times, and when he prostrated himself, he said: "Glory and praise be to my most high Lord" three times. Abu Dawud said: We are afraid the addition of the word "praise" is not guarded. [Hasan Sanad (Shu'aib Al-Arnaut). Abu Dawud: 870]

benefits.title: Benefits of Sajda Dua
benefits.description: Feel the closeness to Allah and raise your Iman by saying sajda dua in every sujood, as this short prayer brings blessings and peace to the heart of every Muslim.
points: Subhana rabbiyal ala in sujood brings Barakah and makes Salah more accepted.
Sujood dua helps a Muslim get closer to Allah and feel His mercy in namaz.
Prostration in Islam with this masnoon dua wipes away small sins and mistakes.
Saying this dua for sujood fills the heart with peace and keeps Amal strong.
Sajda dua teaches Muslims the right way of zikr Allah during every prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sajda Dua
when_to_recite.description: This sajda dua, Subhana Rabbiyal Ala wa bihamdihi, is recited in prostration to praise Allah with both words and heart, asking for Barakah and forgiveness in every sajdah of your namaz and Amal.
points: In every sajdah of salah, recite sajda dua to praise Allah and seek His Barakah.
During sajdah tilawat, use subhana rabbiyal ala for extra reward and closeness to Allah.
When making dua in sujood, add this sujood dua for more acceptance and mercy.
In tahajjud prayer, say dua for sujood in every sajdah for forgiveness and Iman.
While learning namaz ka tarika, remember sajda dua for correct Amal and blessings.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Sajda Dua
how_to_perform.description: Saying the sajda dua in prostration is a way to praise Allah with your heart and words. This sajda dua brings Barakah and makes your namaz full of blessings, helping you feel close to Allah in every prayer.
steps: Place your forehead on the ground and say subhana rabbiyal ala wa bihamdihi in sajda.
Let your tongue move slow and clear as you recite this dua for sujood in every sajdah.
Try to keep your mind on Allah’s praise while saying this sajda dua during your salah.
When you do sajdah tilawat or extra prostration, use this masnoon dua for more reward.
Make this Muslim prayer a part of your namaz ka tarika to get more Barakah and peace.

duas.title: Dua for Sujood (Allahumma Maghfir Lee)
duas.introduction: Abu Hurairah (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say in prostration:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِيْ كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَّتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lee dhanbee kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa 'awwalahu wa 'aakhirahu wa 'alaa-niyyatahu wa sirrahu
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, great and small, the first and the last, those that are apparent and those that are hidden.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say while prostrating himself: O Lord, forgive me all my sins, small and great, first and last, open and secret. [Muslim: 483]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Sujood
benefits.description: Ask Allah for full forgiveness in every sujood with this powerful dua, letting your heart find peace and hope while you pray for mercy and a clean record of deeds.
points: Allahummaghfirli zambi in sujood helps wipe away all types of sins for Muslims.
Dua for forgiveness of all sins brings hope and makes the heart soft in Salah.
Sujood dua teaches Muslims to trust Allah’s mercy and keep Iman strong always.
What to say in sujood with this masnoon dua brings Barakah in namaz and Amal.
Dua for forgiveness lets a Muslim start fresh and feel Allah’s kindness daily.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Sujood
when_to_recite.description: This dua for sujood, Allahumma maghfir lee, is recited in sajdah to ask Allah for forgiveness of every sin, big or small, hidden or open, bringing Barakah and mercy in your namaz and daily Amal.
points: In every sajdah of salah, recite dua for sujood to seek forgiveness from Allah.
During tahajjud prayer, use this sujood dua for forgiveness of all sins and Barakah.
When feeling regret for mistakes, add dua in sujood for Allah’s mercy and a clean heart.
After fard salah, make dua for forgiveness of all sins while in sajdah for more Iman.
While teaching what to say in sujood, remind others about allahummaghfirli zambi for Amal.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Sujood
how_to_perform.description: This dua for sujood is a strong way to ask Allah for forgiveness of all sins, big or small. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and helps your heart feel clean in every namaz and salah.
steps: Go into sujood and with a soft voice, say allahummaghfirli zambi in your prayer.
Ask Allah to forgive every sin, both hidden and open, while you are in sujood.
Let your heart feel sorry for mistakes as you recite this dua for forgiveness of all sins.
Use this forgiveness dua in every salah, making it a habit for more Barakah and peace.
When you feel heavy with sins, repeat this dua for forgiveness in sujood for Allah’s mercy.

duas.title: Dua After Ruku (Supplication Upon Rising From Bowing)
duas.introduction: Ayesha (RA) said, I did not find Rasulullah (ﷺ) in bed one night. (In the dark) I searched for him. Then my hand touched the sole of his foot. He was then in prostration and his legs were erect. He was saying:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِيْ ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu biridhaaka min sakhatik, wa bimu'aafaatika min 'uqoobatik wa 'a'oodhu bika minka, laa 'uhsee thanaa'an 'alayka, 'Anta kamaa 'athnayta 'alaa nafsik
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek protection in Your pleasure from Your anger, and I seek protection in Your forgiveness from Your punishment. I seek protection in You from You. I cannot count Your praises. You are as You have praised Yourself.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ فَقَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً مِنَ الْفِرَاشِ فَالْتَمَسْتُهُ فَوَقَعَتْ يَدِي عَلَى بَطْنِ قَدَمَيْهِ وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَهُمَا مَنْصُوبَتَانِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: A'isha reported: One night I missed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from the bed, and when I sought him my hand touched the soles of his feet while he was in the state of prostration; they (feet) were raised and he was saying:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thy pleasure from Thy anger, and in Thy forgiveness from Thy punishment, and I seek refuge in Thee from Thee (Thy anger). I cannot reckon Thy praise. Thou art as Thou hast lauded Thyself." [Muslim:486, Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3566]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Ruku
benefits.description: Find peace and hope by saying this dua after ruku, as it brings Allah’s mercy, keeps the heart humble, and helps every Muslim stay safe from anger and punishment.
points: Allahumma inni in ruku dua brings Allah’s pleasure and keeps away His anger.
Dua after ruku helps a Muslim get protection from Allah’s punishment in Salah.
Praising Allah with this masnoon dua fills the heart with Barakah and Iman.
Dua for protection after ruku teaches Muslims to trust Allah’s mercy always.
Ruku dua in namaz reminds Muslims of Allah’s greatness and keeps Amal strong.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Ruku
when_to_recite.description: This dua after ruku is a strong masnoon dua for protection, asking Allah for His pleasure and forgiveness, and praising Him in salah, bringing Barakah and Iman to your namaz and every Muslim prayer.
points: After rising from ruku in salah, recite the dua after ruku for Allah’s pleasure.
When you want Allah’s forgiveness, use the dua after ruku in your fard salah.
During tahajjud, make the dua after ruku to seek protection and Barakah.
In every rakah after ruku, say the ruku dua to praise Allah and remember His mercy.
While teaching kids namaz, help them learn the dua after ruku for strong Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua After Ruku
how_to_perform.description: This dua after ruku is a strong way to ask Allah for His protection and mercy after bowing. It fills your salah with Barakah and helps you remember Allah’s greatness and forgiveness in every prayer.
steps: Stand up straight after ruku and quietly say this dua after ruku with full hope in Allah.
Ask for Allah’s pleasure and forgiveness while reciting this ruku dua in your namaz.
Let your heart feel the meaning as you seek protection from Allah’s anger and punishment.
When praying in jamaat, follow the imam and softly say this dua praising Allah after ruku.
Try to use this masnoon dua in every salah to fill your prayer with more Barakah and Iman.

duas.title: Dua When Raising From Ruku (Dua Noor)
duas.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said this prayer in salat or in prostration:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِيْ نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِيْ نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِيْ نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِيْنِيْ نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِيْ نُورًا، وَأَمَامِيْ نُورًا، وَخَلْفِي نُورًا، وَفَوْقِيْ نُورًا، وَتَحْتِيْ نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا (وَاجْعَلْنِيْ نُورًا)، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، (وَفِي عَصَبِيْ نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِيْ نُورًا، وَفِي شَعْرِيْ نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِيْ نُورًا)، اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِيْ نُورًا
duas.transliteration: Allahum-maj'al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi sami' nuran, wa fi basari nuran, wa`an yamini nuran, wa`an shimaali nuran, wa amaami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, wa fawqi nuran, wa ta’hti nuran, waj`alli nuran (waj`alni nuran), waj`al fi nafsi nuran, (wa fi asabi nuran, wa fi lahmi nuran, wa fi dami nuran, wa fi sha’ri nuran, wa fi bashari nuran), Allaahumma a’tini nuran
duas.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, and in my ears light and in my sight light, and to my right light, and to my left light, and before me light and behind me light, and above me light, and below me light. O Allah, Make for me light, and make me a light, and place in my soul light, and place light in my nerves, and in my flesh light and in my blood light and in my hair light and in my skin light. O Allah, grant me light.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَى حَاجَتَهُ، غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ نَامَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَتَى الْقِرْبَةَ فَأَطْلَقَ شِنَاقَهَا، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا بَيْنَ وُضُوءَيْنِ لَمْ يُكْثِرْ، وَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ، فَصَلَّى، فَقُمْتُ فَتَمَطَّيْتُ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَرَى أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَتَّقِيهِ، فَتَوَضَّأْتُ، فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي فَأَدَارَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَتَتَامَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ـ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ نَفَخَ ـ فَآذَنَهُ بِلاَلٌ بِالصَّلاَةِ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا، وَفَوْقِي نُورًا، وَتَحْتِي نُورًا، وَأَمَامِي نُورًا، وَخَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا ‏" ‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ وَسَبْعٌ فِي التَّابُوتِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ وَلَدِ الْعَبَّاسِ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ، فَذَكَرَ عَصَبِي وَلَحْمِي وَدَمِي وَشَعَرِي وَبَشَرِي، وَذَكَرَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: One night I slept at the house of Maimuna. The Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, answered the call of nature, washed his face and hands, and then slept. He got up (late at night), went to a water skin, opened the mouth thereof and performed ablution not using much water, yet he washed all the parts properly and then offered the prayer. I got up and straightened my back in order that the Prophet (ﷺ) might not feel that I was watching him, and then I performed the ablution, and when he got up to offer the prayer, I stood on his left. He caught hold of my ear and brought me over to his right side. He offered thirteen rak`at in all and then lay down and slept till he started blowing out his breath as he used to do when he slept. In the meantime Bilal informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of the approaching time for the (Fajr) prayer, and the Prophet offered the Fajr (Morning) prayer without performing new ablution. He used to say in his invocation, Allahumma ij`al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran, wa fi sam`i nuran, wa`an yamini nuran, wa`an yasari nuran, wa fawqi nuran, wa tahti nuran, wa amami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, waj`al li nuran." Kuraib (a sub narrator) said, "I have forgotten seven other words, (which the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned in this invocation). I met a man from the offspring of Al-`Abbas and he narrated those seven things to me, mentioning, '(Let there be light in) my nerves, my flesh, my blood, my hair and my body,' and he also mentioned two other things." [Sahih Bukhari: 6316, Sahih Muslim: 763]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Ruku (Dua Noor)
benefits.description: Ask Allah for noor in every part of life with this dua after ruku, letting your heart and actions shine bright with His light and guidance in every step you take.
points: Dua for light fills the heart and face with noor and brings peace in Amal.
Noor dua after ruku helps a Muslim get Allah’s guidance in every Muslim prayer.
Powerful dua for noor on face makes a Muslim’s actions shine with Barakah.
Dua e noor from Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim brings success in daily life.
Dua for guidance keeps a Muslim safe from darkness and wrong ways always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Ruku (Dua Noor)
when_to_recite.description: This dua after ruku, known as dua e noor, is a powerful prayer for light and guidance, asking Allah to fill your heart, body, and life with noor, Barakah, and success in every Muslim prayer and amal.
points: After rising from ruku in salah, recite the dua after ruku for noor and guidance.
When you want Allah’s light in your heart, use the dua for noor on face in namaz.
During tahajjud, make dua e noor to ask for Barakah and light in your daily amal.
In Fajr prayer, say the dua for light to start your day with Allah’s noor and mercy.
While feeling lost, turn to Allah with this dua for guidance and success in every step.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Ruku (Dua Noor)
how_to_perform.description: This dua after ruku is a beautiful Muslim prayer asking Allah for noor in every part of your life. It is a powerful dua for light and guidance, and many Muslims use it for Barakah and success in their daily namaz.
steps: Stand up from ruku and before going to sujood, quietly recite this dua for light.
With your hands on your chest, ask Allah for noor in your heart and on your face.
When you feel lost, use this dua for guidance and pray for noor in your life.
After finishing your salah, repeat this dua e noor to get more Barakah and protection.
In your daily Muslim prayers, make this dua for noor on face and for success in Amal.

duas.title: Dua in Sajdah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma Rabbanaa wa bihamdika Allahum-maghfir lee
duas.translation:
Glory is to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise is Yours. O Allah, forgive me. [1]

Narrated from Aisha (RA), she said that according to the instructions of the Qur'an, [2] the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this dua more and more in bowing down and prostration - (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَسُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in his bowing and prostrations, "Subhanaka l-lahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika; Allahumma ghfir li.' (Exalted [from unbecoming attributes] Are you O Allah our Lord, and by Your praise [do I exalt you]. O Allah! Forgive me). [[1] Bukhari: 794 [2] Sura Nasr 110:3]

benefits.title: Benefits of Sajda Dua
benefits.description: Ask Allah for forgiveness and praise Him in sajda dua, letting your heart feel peace and your Amal grow strong with every sujood in Muslim prayer.
points: Subhanakallahumma rabbana wabihamdika allahummaghfirli brings Allah’s mercy.
Sajda dua helps a Muslim get forgiveness for mistakes in every Islamic prayer.
Powerful dua for forgiveness in sujood makes the heart soft and Iman strong.
Sura Nasr teaches Muslims to praise Allah and seek forgiveness in namaz.
Allahummaghfirli in sajda dua keeps a Muslim’s Amal clean and Barakah growing.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sajda Dua
when_to_recite.description: This sajda dua is a simple and powerful dua for forgiveness, asking Allah for mercy and praising Him in sujood, bringing Barakah and peace to your Muslim prayer and every namaz.
points: In every sajdah during salah, recite the sajda dua for Allah’s forgiveness.
When feeling heavy with sins, use the sajda dua in sujood for mercy and Barakah.
After reading Sura Nasr, make the sajda dua to thank Allah and ask for forgiveness.
During tahajjud, say subhanakallahumma rabbana wabihamdika allahummaghfirli in sajdah.
While teaching kids how to pray salah, help them learn the sajda dua for strong Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Sajda Dua
how_to_perform.description: This sajda dua is a simple Muslim prayer for forgiveness that you say while in sujood. It is a powerful dua for forgiveness and is found in both Bukhari and Sura Nasr, making it a strong part of Muslim daily prayers.
steps: Lower your head to the ground in sajda and softly say subhanakallahumma rabbana wabihamdika allahummaghfirli.
While in sujood, ask Allah for forgiveness with a clean heart and full hope.
If you make a mistake in salah, use this sajda dua to seek Allah’s mercy and forgiveness.
After reading Sura Nasr in salah, add this dua in sujood for more Barakah and peace.
In every namaz, remember to use this powerful dua for forgiveness to keep your Amal pure.

duas.title: Dua in Sujood (Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul Mala Ikati War Ruh)
duas.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say while bowing down and prostration:
duas.arabic: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
duas.transliteration: Subboohun, Quddoosun, Rabbul-malaa'ikati warrooh
duas.translation: Glory (to You), Most Holy (are You), Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَسُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ ‘
hadith.translation: Aishah said that the prophet (ﷺ) used to say when bowing and prostrating, “All-Glorious, All-Holy, Lord of the angels and spirit. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 872]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua in Sujood (Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul Mala Ikati War Ruh)
benefits.description: This dua in sujood brings a Muslim closer to Allah, filling the heart with peace and reminding us of His greatness and mercy during the most humble part of salah.
points: Allah’s mercy comes close when a Muslim says subbuhun quddusun in sujood.
Sujood dua helps the heart feel more khushu and love for Rabbul Alamin.
This masnoon dua in sujood makes salah more strong and full of Barakah.
Zikr Allah with this dua in sujood brings peace and keeps Iman safe from shaitan.
Using this dua for sujood shows respect to Allah, the Lord of angels and Jibreel.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua In Sujood
when_to_recite.description: This dua in sujood, subbuhun quddusun, is a short way to praise Allah, Rabbul alamin, showing love and respect in every Muslim prayer and bringing Barakah to your namaz and Amal.
points: In every sujood of salah, recite the dua in sujood to praise Allah’s greatness.
When you want to feel close to Rabbul alamin, use the sujood dua in your prayer.
During tahajjud, make subbuhun quddusun dua in sujood for more Barakah and Iman.
After a hard day, say the dua for sujood to find peace and remember Allah’s mercy.
While teaching kids Muslim prayer, help them learn the dua in sujood for strong faith.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua in Sujood (Subbuhun Quddusun)
how_to_perform.description: This dua in sujood is a short Muslim prayer that praises Allah as the Lord of all angels and Jibreel. It is a masnoon dua from Abu Dawud and brings Barakah and peace to your salah.
steps: Go into sujood and quietly say subbuhun quddusun rabbul mala ikati war ruh.
In your sajda, remember Allah’s greatness and praise Him as Rabbul alamin.
When you feel close to Allah, use this dua for sujood to show your Iman and love.
After finishing your salah, repeat this sujood dua for more Barakah in your daily Amal.
During long prayers, add this Islamic dua in sujood to make your namaz more strong.

duas.title: Dua in Sujood (Allaahumma Laka Sajadtu wa Laka Aslamtu)
duas.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to prostrate and say:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، فَأَحْسَنَ صُوْرَتَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma laka sajadtu wa laka 'aslamtu, wa bika 'aamantu sajada wajhiya lilladhee khalaqahu, wa sawwarahu fa'ahsana su-ratahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu, tabaarakAllahu 'ahsanul-khaaliqeen
duas.translation: O Allah, to You I prostrate myselfm, to You I have submitted, and in You I believe. My face is prostrated to the One Who created it, fashioned it, and gave it hearing and sight. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - هُوَ ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي الْمَاجِشُونُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا سَجَدَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ فَأَحْسَنَ صُورَتَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from 'Ali that: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated he would say: "Allahumma laka sajadtu wa laka aslamtu wa bika amantu sajada wajhi lilladhi khalaqahu wa sawwarahu fa ahsana suratahu wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu, tabarak Allahu ahsanul-khaliqin ( O Allah, to You I have prostrated and to You I have submitted, and in You I have believed. My face has prostrated to the One Who created it and shaped it and shaped it well, and brought forth its hearing and sight. Blessed be Allah the best of Creators.)" [Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 1126]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Sujood (Allaahumma Laka Sajadtu wa Laka Aslamtu)
benefits.description: This dua for sujood helps a Muslim show full trust in Allah, making every prostration in salah more meaningful and filling the heart with thankfulness for His gifts and mercy.
points: Allahumma in sujood shows a Muslim’s full Amal and trust in Allah’s plan.
Tabarakallah in this sujood dua brings Barakah and keeps the heart soft in salah.
Prostration with this masnoon dua reminds Muslims of Allah’s power as the best creator.
Sujood dua helps Muslims thank Allah for hearing, seeing, and all His big gifts.
Using this dua for sujood makes Iman strong and keeps the mind away from pride.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Sujood
when_to_recite.description: This dua for sujood, starting with Allahumma and ending with tabarakallah, is a strong way to show your Iman, thank Allah for His gifts, and bring Barakah to every Muslim prayer and prostration.
points: In every sujood of salah, recite the dua for sujood to thank Allah for His blessings.
When you feel close to Allah, use the sujood dua to show your Iman and trust.
During tahajjud, make this dua for sujood to ask for Barakah and more Amal.
After a hard day, say tabarakallah in sujood to remember Allah as the best creator.
While teaching kids prostration, help them learn the dua for sujood for strong faith.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Sujood (Allaahumma Laka Sajadtu)
how_to_perform.description: This dua for sujood is a Muslim prayer showing full submission to Allah, praising Him as the Best of creators. It is a masnoon dua from Nasai and brings Barakah and Iman in every prostration.
steps: Enter sujood and with a soft voice, say Allahumma laka sajadtu wa laka aslamtu.
In your sajda, remember tabarakallah and thank Allah for making you and giving you hearing.
When you feel weak, use this sujood dua to show your full trust and belief in Allah.
After every namaz, repeat this dua for sujood to keep your Amal and Iman strong.
During long salah, add this prostration dua to praise Allah as ahsanul khaliqeen.

duas.title: Dua for Sujood
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
duas.transliteration: Subhaana dhil-jabarooti, wal-malakooti, wal-kibriyaa'i, wal-'adhamah
duas.translation:
Glory is to You, Master of power, of dominion, of majesty and greatness.

Narrated by Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i (RA): I stood up to pray along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ); he got up and recited Surat al-Baqarah (Surah 2). When he came to a verse which spoke of mercy, he stopped and made supplication, and when he came to verse which spoke of punishment, he stopped and sought refuge in Allah, then he bowed and paused as long as he stood (reciting Surah al-Baqarah) Then he prostrated and paused as long as he bowed down. In prostration he said- (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ قُمْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً فَقَامَ فَقَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ لاَ يَمُرُّ بِآيَةِ رَحْمَةٍ إِلاَّ وَقَفَ فَسَأَلَ وَلاَ يَمُرُّ بِآيَةِ عَذَابٍ إِلاَّ وَقَفَ فَتَعَوَّذَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ رَكَعَ بِقَدْرِ قِيَامِهِ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ بِقَدْرِ قِيَامِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ فِي سُجُودِهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ - ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَرَأَ بِآلِ عِمْرَانَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ سُورَةً سُورَةً ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i: I stood up to pray along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ); he got up and recited Surat al-Baqarah (Surah 2). When he came to a verse which spoke of mercy, he stopped and made supplication, and when he came to verse which spoke of punishment, he stopped and sought refuge in Allah, then he bowed and paused as long as he stood (reciting Surah al-Baqarah), and said while bowing, "Glory be to the Possessor of greatness, the Kingdom, grandeur and majesty." :Then he prostrated himself and paused as long as he stood up and recited Surat Aal Imran (Surah 3) and then recited many surahs one after another. [Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 873]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Sujood
benefits.description: This dua for sujood reminds Muslims of Allah’s greatness and power, making every prostration in salah more deep and helping hearts feel close to the Master of all things.
points: Saying this dua in sujood helps Muslims remember Allah’s full power and control.
Sujood dua brings more khushu in salah and keeps the heart away from pride.
Prostration in Islam with this dua makes a Muslim feel Allah’s greatness and mercy.
What to say in sujood like this dua helps Muslims praise Allah’s kingdom and might.
Duas in sujood with these words keep Iman strong and Amal pure in every prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Sujood
when_to_recite.description: This dua for sujood is said in the lowest place before Allah, showing your need and praising His power, dominion, and greatness, making your sujood full of Barakah and Iman in every salah.
points: During every prostration in Islam, use this dua for sujood to praise Allah’s greatness.
After finishing your fard salah, add this sujood dua in your extra prostration for more Barakah.
When you feel your heart heavy, whisper duas in sujood asking for help and mercy.
In tahajjud prayer, make dua in sujood for closeness to Allah and strong Iman.
While learning how to make dua in sujood, teach kids this masnoon dua for their namaz.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Sujood
how_to_perform.description: This dua for sujood is a Muslim prayer that praises Allah as the Master of all power and greatness. It is a masnoon dua from Abu Dawud and brings Barakah and respect in every prostration in namaz.
steps: Go into sujood and quietly say subhaana dhil-jabarooti wal-malakooti wal-kibriyaa’i wal-‘adhamah.
In your sajda, think about Allah’s power and His greatness over all things.
When you feel small or weak, use this dua in sujood to remember Allah’s strength.
After every salah, repeat this sujood dua to keep your heart full of Iman and Barakah.
During your namaz, add this prostration dua to praise Allah’s majesty and kingship.

duas.title: Dua between two Sujood
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee, Rabbighfir lee
duas.translation:
O My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.

Huzaifa (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the above mentioned dua while sitting in the middle of two prostrations.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، مَوْلَى الأَنْصَارِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ بَنِي عَبْسٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ - ثَلاَثًا - ذُو الْمَلَكُوتِ وَالْجَبَرُوتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اسْتَفْتَحَ فَقَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَكَانَ رُكُوعُهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ قِيَامِهِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَكَانَ قِيَامُهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ رُكُوعِهِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لِرَبِّيَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَكَانَ سُجُودُهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ قِيَامِهِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِهِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ وَكَانَ يَقْعُدُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ نَحْوًا مِنْ سُجُودِهِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَقَرَأَ فِيهِنَّ الْبَقَرَةَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ وَالنِّسَاءَ وَالْمَائِدَةَ أَوِ الأَنْعَامَ شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Hudhayfah: Hudhayfah saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) praying at night. He said: Allah is most great" three times, "Possessor of kingdom, grandeur, greatness and majesty." He then began (his prayer) and recited Surah al-Baqarah; then he bowed and he paused in bowing as long as he stood up; he said while bowing, "Glory be to my mighty Lord," "Glory be to my mighty Lord" ; then he raised his head, after bowing: then he stood up and he paused as long as he paused in bowing and said, "Praise be to my Lord" ; then he prostrated and paused in prostration as long as he paused in the standing position; he said while prostrating: "Glory be to my most high Lord"; then he raised his head after prostration, and sat as long as he prostrated, and said while sitting: "O my Lord forgive me." He offered four rak'ahs of prayer and recited in them Surah al-Baqarah, Aal Imran, an-Nisa, al-Ma'idah, or al-An'am. The narrator Shu'bah doubted. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 874]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua between Two Sujood
benefits.description: This dua between two sujood helps a muslim ask Allah for forgiveness, making salah more soft and filling the heart with hope for mercy and a clean record of deeds.
points: Rabbighfirli dua brings Allah’s forgiveness close and wipes away small sins.
Dua for forgiveness in islam helps muslims keep their Amal clean in every salah.
Saying this prayer for forgiveness makes the heart soft and full of hope in Allah.
Dua between two sujood teaches muslims to ask Allah for mercy again and again.
Using this istighfar dua keeps Iman strong and helps a muslim stay away from bad deeds.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Between Two Sujood
when_to_recite.description: This dua between two sujood is a simple call for forgiveness, asking Allah to wipe away your mistakes and fill your heart with Barakah and hope every time you bow in salah.
points: In every salah, recite dua between two sujood after your first prostration for forgiveness.
When feeling regret for sins, use rabbighfirli dua between two sujood in namaz.
During tahajjud, make dua for forgiveness in islam between two sujood for more mercy.
If you want to teach kids prayer for forgiveness, show them this dua in sujood step by step.
While making extra nawafil, add this istighfar dua between two sujood for more Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua between two Sujood
how_to_perform.description: This dua between two sujood is a simple prayer for forgiveness that every Muslim says in Salah. It brings Barakah and helps you ask Allah to forgive your sins with a clean heart during namaz.
steps: After your first sujood in Salah, sit up straight and say rabbighfirli with full hope.
When you sit between the two sujood, repeat this dua for forgiveness softly two times.
If you forget, remember to say this forgiveness dua before going to the next sujood.
In every rakah, use this dua for forgiveness of sins to keep your Amal clean and pure.
While teaching kids namaz, help them learn this dua in sujood for their daily prayer.

duas.title: Dua between Sujood (Allahummaghfirli Warhamni Wahdini Warzuqni)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lee, warhamnee, wa 'aafinee, wahdinee, warzuqnee
duas.translation:
O Allah! Pardon me, have mercy on me, guide me, and grant me sustenance.

The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this dua while sitting between two prostrations.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ، عَنْ كَامِلٍ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاجْبُرْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ibn Abbas narrated: "Between the two prostrations, the Prophet would say: (Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wajburni, wahdini, warzuqni). 'O Allah! Pardon me, have mercy on me, help me, guide me, and grant me sustenance.'" [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 284, Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 850]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua between Two Sujood (Allahummaghfirli Warhamni Wahdini Warzuqni)
benefits.description: This dua between two sujood helps a muslim ask Allah for forgiveness, mercy, health, guidance, and rizq, making every salah more full of hope and Barakah from Allah.
points: Allahummaghfirli dua brings Allah’s maghfirat and covers the heart with His mercy.
Dua for guidance in sujood helps muslims stay on the right path in daily Amal.
Allahummaghfirli warhamni in salah asks Allah for health and keeps the body strong.
Rizq ki dua in this prayer brings halal rizq and Barakah in a muslim’s life.
Using this dua after namaz fills the heart with hope for Allah’s help and kindness.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Between Two Sujood
when_to_recite.description: This dua between two sujood asks Allah for forgiveness, mercy, health, guidance, and rizq, making your salah full of Barakah and hope for every Muslim who wants Allah’s help in every part of life.
points: In every rakah, use dua between two sujood to ask Allah for maghfirat and rizq.
When you feel weak or sick, recite allahummaghfirli warhamni dua for health and mercy.
After finishing fard salah, make dua for guidance and rizq with this masnoon dua.
During tahajjud, whisper this dua in sujood for forgiveness and more Barakah in rizq.
While teaching kids dua after prayer, show them this dua for guidance and rizq in namaz.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua between two Sujood
how_to_perform.description: This dua between two sujood is a beautiful way to ask Allah for forgiveness, mercy, health, guidance, and rizq. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and helps every Muslim keep their heart close to Allah in Salah.
steps: After your first sujood in namaz, sit up and recite allahummaghfirli warhamni with full hope.
When you pause between the two sujood, say this dua for forgiveness and rizq slowly.
If you want more Barakah, repeat this dua between sujood in every rakah of your prayer.
While teaching children Salah, help them learn this dua for guidance and maghfirat.
Before going to the next sujood, finish this dua for sujood to complete your masnun duas.

duas.title: Dua For Sajdah in Quran (Hadith)
duas.introduction: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (RA) The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that when, the son of Adam recites the Ayat of Sajdah (prostration) and then falls down in prostration, the Satan goes into seclusion and weeps and says: Alas, and in the narration of Abu Kuraib the words are: Woe unto me, the son of Adam was commanded to prostrate, and he prostrated and Paradise was entitled to him and I was commanded to prostrate, but I refused and am doomed to Hell.

duas.title: Dua For Sajdah in Quran
duas.introduction: Prophet (ﷺ) recited the verse of prostration and went to sujood and make this dua:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ
duas.transliteration: Allahum-maktub lee bihaa ‘indaka ‘ajran, wada', ‘annee bihaa wizran, waj’alhaa lee ‘indaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalhaa minnee kamaa taqabbaltahaa min ’abdika Daawood
duas.translation: O Allah, write it as a reward for me, and release me from a sin for it, and make it a treasure for me in Paradise. Accept it from me as You accepted it from your servant Dawud.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُنَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ يَا حَسَنُ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُنِي اللَّيْلَةَ وَأَنَا نَائِمٌ كَأَنِّي أُصَلِّي خَلْفَ شَجَرَةٍ فَسَجَدْتُ فَسَجَدَتِ الشَّجَرَةُ لِسُجُودِي فَسَمِعْتُهَا وَهِيَ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ لِي جَدُّكَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَرَأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَجْدَةً ثُمَّ سَجَدَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَمِعْتُهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا أَخْبَرَهُ الرَّجُلُ عَنْ قَوْلِ الشَّجَرَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid said: Ibn Juraij said to me: O Hasan! Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid informed me that Ibn Abbas said: "A man came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I had a dream at night while I was sleeping in which I was praying behind a tree, when I prostrated the tree prostrated along with me. Then I heard it saying: (Allahummaktuh li biha indaka ajran, wad a anni biha wizran, waj'alha li biha indaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalha minni kama taqabbaltaha min abdiki Dawud.)" (O Allah! Record for me, a reward with You for it, remove a sin for me by it, and store it away for me with You, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your worshipper Dawud). Al-Hasan said: "Ibn Juraij said to me: 'Your grandfather said to me: 'Ibn Abbas said: 'So the Prophet recited (an Ayah of) prostration then prostrated.'" (He said) "So Ibn Abbas said: 'I listened to him, and he was saying the same as the man informed that the tree had said.'" [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 579]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Sujood in Quran
benefits.description: This dua for sujood after ayat sajadah in Quran brings reward, removes sins, and helps a Muslim gain closeness to Allah, making every sajdah in tilawat e quran more meaningful and accepted.
points: Allah gives reward for every sajdah in quran recitation with this dua for sujood.
Sins are taken away when a muslim makes this sajda tilawat dua with true Iman.
This dua for acceptance helps a believer’s amal get accepted like Dawud Alaihis Salam.
Sujud tilawah with this quranic dua becomes a treasure for the akhirah and Jannah.
Barakah comes in tilawat quran when muslims use this masnoon dua in sajdah in quran.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Sajdah in Quran
when_to_recite.description: This dua for sujood during sajdah in quran is a way to ask Allah for reward, forgiveness, and acceptance, making your tilawat e quran full of Barakah and hope for Jannah with every sajda tilawat.
points: After reading an ayat sajadah in quran recitation, recite this sajda tilawat dua for reward.
When you hear someone recite quran sharif with sajdah, make this dua for acceptance.
During tilawat quran at home, use this dua for sujood to ask Allah for forgiveness.
If you teach kids quran tilawat, show them this dua in sujood after every sajdah in quran.
While doing sujud tilawah in salah, whisper this quran dua for Barakah and mercy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Sajdah in Quran
how_to_perform.description: This dua for sujood is said when you reach a sajdah ayah during quran recitation. It asks Allah for reward, forgiveness, and to accept your sajda just like He accepted from Dawud (AS).
steps: When you come to an ayat sajadah in quran tilawat, stop and make sajda tilawat right away.
In your sajda, recite this sajda dua softly and ask Allah to accept your quran recitation.
After saying the dua for acceptance, pray for your sins to be forgiven and for Barakah.
If you are with family, help them learn this sujood dua so everyone gets reward from quran.
Before rising from sajda, finish your dua for sujood and thank Allah for the chance to do Amal.

duas.title: Sajdah Dua for night recitation
duas.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the verses of prostration at night, he would go in prostration and say:
duas.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lilladhee khalaqahu, wa shaqqa sam'a-hu wa basarahu bi hawlihi wa quwwatih
duas.translation: I have prostrated my face to the One Who created it, and gave it hearing and sight by His might and His power.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِ الْقُرْآنِ بِاللَّيْلِ ‏ "‏ سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Aisha narrated: "When the Messenger of Allah would prostrate (for recitation of) the Qur'an, he would say: (Sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu bihawlihi wa quwwatihi.) (I have prostrated my face to the One Who created it, and made its hearing and vision, though His ability and power.)" [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 580]

benefits.title: Benefits of Sajdah Dua for Night Recitation
benefits.description: This sajdah dua for sujood in tahajjud prayer helps a Muslim remember Allah’s power, brings forgiveness, and makes night prayer more special with true Iman and Barakah in every prostration.
points: Allah’s might is remembered when muslims use this dua for sujood in tahajjud.
Prostration in islam with this masnoon dua brings Barakah and closeness to Allah.
Tahajjud prayer becomes a way for muslims to seek forgiveness and mercy at night.
This powerful dua in sujood helps a believer thank Allah for hearing and sight.
Night prayer with this dua in english or arabic brings success in both worlds.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sajdah Dua for Night Recitation
when_to_recite.description: This sajdah dua for night recitation is said in tahajjud prayer, showing thanks to Allah for creating you and giving you hearing and sight, filling your night prayer with Barakah and strong Iman.
points: In tahajjud prayer, use this dua for sujood while making prostration in islam.
After finishing your night prayer, whisper this sujood dua for Allah’s power and mercy.
When you wake up for night salah, recite this dua in sujood to thank Allah for His gifts.
During long qiyam in tahajjud, make this dua for forgiveness and success in your amal.
If you teach kids tahajjud dua, show them this namaz ki dua for their night salah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Sajdah Dua for night recitation
how_to_perform.description: This dua for sujood is recited during tahajjud or night prayer, showing thanks to Allah for creating us and giving us hearing and sight. It is a simple masnoon dua that brings Barakah and keeps your Iman strong in night prayer.
steps: After going into sujood in tahajjud prayer, say this dua for sujood with full heart.
When you feel close to Allah in night prayer, recite this sujood dua and think of His power.
If you wake up for tahajjud, use this dua in sujood to thank Allah for His gifts and mercy.
While teaching kids about night prayer, help them learn this dua for sujood in simple words.
Before rising from prostration, finish your dua for sujood and ask Allah for forgiveness.

duas.title: Dua after Reciting the Verses of Prostration
duas.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lilladhee khalaqahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu bi hawlihi wa quwwatihi. FatabaarakAllahu 'ahsanul-khaaliqeen
duas.translation: I have prostrated my face to the One Who created it, and gave it hearing and sight by His might and His power. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِ الْقُرْآنِ بِاللَّيْلِ ‏ "‏ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Aishah narrated: “When the Messenger of Allah would prostrate (for recitation of) the Qur’an, he would say: ‘I have prostrated my face to the One Who created it, and made its hearing and vision, through His ability and power (Sajada wajhī lilladhī khalaqahū wa shaqqa sam`ahū wa baṣarahū bi ḥawlihī wa quwwatih).’” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3425, Sura Al Muminun 23:14]

benefits.title: Benefits of Sujood Dua after Reciting Verses of Prostration
benefits.description: This sujood dua after sajdah tilawat in quran recitation praises Allah as the best creator, brings Barakah, and helps a Muslim remember His power and mercy in every sajda after reading quran.
points: Allah’s greatness is praised with this sujood dua from surah al muminun in quran.
Sajda tilawat with this islamic prayer brings Barakah and forgiveness for muslims.
Muslims show thanks for hearing and sight by using this dua after reading quran.
Sajde ki dua helps a believer remember Allah’s power and mercy in every prostration.
Quran tilawat with this masnoon dua makes amal strong and brings reward from Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sujood Dua
when_to_recite.description: This sujood dua is recited after reading verses of prostration in the Quran, showing thanks to Allah for His power, Barakah, and the gift of hearing and sight, as taught in surah al muminun.
points: After coming across a sajdah tilawat during quran recitation, muslims recite this sujood dua.
When you finish reading a verse of prostration in surah al muminun, use this dua for sujood.
During islamic prayer, if you reach a sajda tilawat, make this dua for forgiveness and Barakah.
After reading quran at home and finding a sajde ki dua, say this powerful dua in sujood.
While teaching quran tilawat to kids, help them learn this dua after reading quran verses of sajdah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Reciting the Verses of Prostration
how_to_perform.description: This sujood dua is recited after reading a sajdah ayah in quran recitation, praising Allah as the best of creators and thanking Him for His gifts. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and keeps your heart soft in prayer.
steps: When you reach a sajdah tilawat in surah al muminun or any quran tilawat, stop and make sujood.
In your prostration, recite this sujood dua and remember Allah’s power and mercy.
After saying the dua in sujood, praise Allah as the best of creators with full Iman.
If you are with family, help them learn this dua after reading quran for more reward.
Before rising from sajda, finish your sujood dua and ask Allah for forgiveness and Barakah.

duas.title: Tashahhud Dua (Attahiyat Lillahi Wa Salawatu)
duas.arabic: اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ، وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ
duas.transliteration: Attahiyyaatu lillaahi wassalawaatu, wattayyibaatu, assalaamu 'alayka 'ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuhu, assalaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen. 'Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluhu
duas.translation:
All greetings of humility are for Allah, and all prayers and goodness. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger.

Tashahood was narrated by various companions (with different wordings). Ibn Mas'ud (RA) said, We used to pray behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to say: "As-Salaamu 'Al-Allah. Peace be upon Allah. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah himself is As-Salam (Name of Allah), so you should say: (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَقِيقُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَقُولُ السَّلاَمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ السَّلاَمُ وَلَكِنْ قُولُوا التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated `Abdullah: We used to pray behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to say: "As-Salamu 'Al-Allah. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah himself is As-Salam (Name of Allah), so you should say: 'at-Tahiyatu lil-lahi was-sala-watu wattaiyibatu, as-salamu `alaika aiyyuha-n-nabiyyu wa rahmatu-l-lahi wa barakatuhu, as-salamu `alaina wa `ala `ibadi-l-lahi as-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha il-lallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu."' [Bukhari: 7381]

benefits.title: Benefits of Tashahhud Dua (Attahiyat Lillahi Wa Salawatu)
benefits.description: This tashahhud dua in salah brings peace, affirms faith, and connects a Muslim with Allah and His Prophet, making every attahiyat in namaz full of Barakah and acceptance.
points: Attahiyat lillahi wa salawatu affirms the oneness of Allah and true Iman.
Tashahhud in salah brings peace and Barakah to all muslims and righteous people.
Attahiyat dua connects a believer’s heart with Prophet Muhammad and his Ummah.
Tahiyat akhir in namaz helps muslims gain reward and acceptance for their salah.
Attahiyat meaning reminds every muslim to stay humble and thankful in every prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Tashahhud Dua
when_to_recite.description: The tashahhud dua is recited in every salah, bringing Barakah and peace, showing our Iman and love for the Prophet, and asking Allah for mercy in every muslim prayer.
points: In every salah after the second rakah, muslims recite the tashahhud dua in sitting.
When reaching the tahiyat akhir in namaz, use attahiyat lillahi wa salawatu for Barakah.
During tasyahud awal in four-rakah prayers, say the attahiyat dua before moving to next part.
After finishing sujood in salah, recite attahiyat full for peace and forgiveness.
While teaching kids attahiyat in english, help them learn this dua in salah for strong Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Tashahhud Dua
how_to_perform.description: The tashahhud dua is recited in every Salah during the sitting position, showing respect and love for Allah and His Messenger. This attahiyat lillahi dua is a key part of namaz, and every Muslim should know how to say it with a clean heart and full focus.
steps: Sit in the right way for tashahhud in salah, with your right hand on your right thigh and left hand on your left thigh.
When you reach the sitting after sujood, start reciting attahiyat lillahi wa salawatu with a soft voice.
Move your finger gently while saying ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah as a sign of strong Iman.
Make sure to finish the attahiyat full before moving to the next part of your namaz for Barakah.
After saying the tashahhud dua, send durood upon the Prophet as taught in islamic prayers.

duas.title: Tashahud Dua (Attahiyatul Mubarakatus Solawatut Taiyibatu)
duas.arabic: اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ الْمُبَارَكَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلَّهِ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Attahiyyaatul muba’rakaatus salawaatut, tayyibaatu lillaahi, assalaamu 'alayka 'ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuhu, assalaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen. 'Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadar Rasoolullaah.
duas.translation: All the blessed compliments and all the holy prayers are only for Allah. Peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and blessings (are on you). And peace be on us and on the good (pious) worshipers of Allah.I bear witness that there is no true God except Allah. I further testify that Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the Messenger of Allah.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، وَعَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُنَا التَّشَهُّدَ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ التَّحِيَّاتُ الْمُبَارَكَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلَّهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ رُمْحٍ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا الْقُرْآنَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ibn `Abbas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us tashahhud just as he used to teach us a Surah of the Qur'an, and he would say: All services rendered by words, acts of worship, and all good things are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah's upright servants. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. In the narration of Ibn Rumh (the words are): "As he would teach us the Qur'an." [Muslim: 403]

duas.title: Tashahhud Dua (Attahiyyaatu lillaahi ajjakiyaatu lillaahi)
duas.arabic: اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ اَلزَّاكِيَاتُ لِلَّهِ، اَلطَّيِّبَاتُ الصَّلَوَتُ لِلَّهِ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلٰى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ ورَسُولُهُ
duas.transliteration: Attahiyyaatu lillaahi ajjakiyaatu lillaahi, Attayyibaatus salawaatu lillaahi, assalaamu 'alayka 'ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuhu, assalaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen. 'Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh.
duas.translation: All the blessed compliments, all the good deeds and all the holy prayers are only for Allah. Peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and blessings (are on you). And peace be on us and on the good (pious) worshipers of Allah. I bear witness that there is no true God except Allah. I further testify that Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the Messenger of Allah.

subcategories.title: Prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ) after tashahhud

duas.title: Durood Sharif (Durood Ibrahim)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Muhammadin, kamaa sallayta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Muhammadin, kamaa baarakta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed
duas.translation:
O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad (ﷺ) and on the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your favor on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad (ﷺ) and the family of Muhammad as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.

Narrated by Ka`b bin Ujrah (RA): We asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How should one (ask Allah to) send blessings on you, the members of the family, for Allah has taught us how to salute you (in the prayer)?' He (ﷺ) said, 'Say: (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، وَمُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قُرَّةَ، مُسْلِمُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِيسَى، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ لَقِيَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ فَقَالَ أَلاَ أُهْدِي لَكَ هَدِيَّةً سَمِعْتُهَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ بَلَى، فَأَهْدِهَا لِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَأَلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ عَلَّمَنَا كَيْفَ نُسَلِّمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila: Ka`b bin Ujrah met me and said, "Shall I not give you a present I got from the Prophet?" `Abdur- Rahman said, "Yes, give it to me." I said, "We asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How should one (ask Allah to) send blessings on you, the members of the family, for Allah has taught us how to salute you (in the prayer)?' He said, 'Say: O Allah! Send Your Mercy on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your Mercy on Abraham and on the family of Abraham, for You are the Most Praise-worthy, the Most Glorious. O Allah! Send Your Blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent your Blessings on Abraham and on the family of Abraham, for You are the Most Praise-worthy, the Most Glorious.' " [Bukhari: 3370]

duas.title: Dua after Tashahhud (Darood Sharif)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إبْرَاهِيْمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَجِيْدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'azwaajihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kamaa sallayta 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema. Wa baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'azwaajihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kamaa baarakta 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema. 'Innaka Hameedun Majeed
duas.translation:
O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad (ﷺ) and upon his wives and progeny as You have bestowed Your favor upon the family of Ibrahim. And bless Muhammad (ﷺ) and his wives and progeny as You have blessed the family of Ibrahim, You are full of praise, Most Glorious.

Narrated Abu Hamid (RA) Saidi: They asked, “O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)! How can we recite Durood for you?” Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, you say - (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Humaid As-Sa`idi: The people asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! How shall we (ask Allah to) send blessings on you?" Allah's Apostle replied, "Say: O Allah! Send Your Mercy on Muhammad and on his wives and on his off spring, as You sent Your Mercy on Abraham's family; and send Your Blessings on Muhammad and on his offspring, as You sent Your Blessings on Abraham's family, for You are the Most Praiseworthy, the Most Glorious." [Bukhari: 3369]

subcategories.title: Duas after the last tashahhud & before salam

duas.title: Dua Masura #1 (Allahumma Allif Baina Qulubina)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّوْرِ وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِيْنَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِيْنَ بِهَا قَابِلِيْهَا وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma allif bayna quloobinaa wa aslih dhaata bayninaa wahdinaa subulas salaam, wa najjinaa minaz zulumaati ilan noor, wa jannibnal fawaa-hisha maa zahara minhaa wa maa batan, wa baarik lanaa fi asmaa’inaa wa absaarinaa wa quloobinaa wa azwaajinaa wa dhurri yaatinaa wa tub alaynaa innaka antat tawwaabur raheem waj’alnaa shaakireena lini’matika muth-neena bihaa qaabileehaa wa atimmahaa 'alaynaa
duas.translation:
O Allah, join our hearts, mend our social relationship, guide us to the path of peace, bring us from darkness to light, save us from obscenities, outward or inward, and bless our ears, our eyes, our hearts, our wives, our children, and relent toward us; Thou art the Relenting, the Merciful. And make us grateful for Thy blessing and make us praise it while accepting it and give it to us in full.

Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us this dua to recite after Tashahhud.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا تَمِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْتَصِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ يُوسُفَ - عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا لاَ نَدْرِي مَا نَقُولُ إِذَا جَلَسْنَا فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ عَلِمَ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ شَرِيكٌ وَحَدَّثَنَا جَامِعٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ شَدَّادٍ - عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بِمِثْلِهِ قَالَ وَكَانَ يُعَلِّمُنَا كَلِمَاتٍ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يُعَلِّمُنَاهُنَّ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا التَّشَهُّدَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلاَمِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا قَابِلِيهَا وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: We did not know what we should say when we sat during prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was taught (by Allah). He then narrated the tradition to the same effect. Sharik reported from Jami', from AbuWa'il on the authority of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud something similar. He said: He used to teach us also some other words, but he did not teach them as he taught us the tashahhud: O Allah, join our hearts, mend our social relationship, guide us to the path of peace, bring us from darkness to light, save us from obscenities, outward or inward, and bless our ears, our eyes, our hearts, our wives, our children, and relent toward us; Thou art the Relenting, the Merciful. And make us grateful for Thy blessing and make us praise it while accepting it and give it to us in full. [Daif (Albani). Abu Dawud: 969]
