duas.title: Dua e Masura #2 (Dua For Protection From Hellfire)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabi jahannam, wa min 'adhaabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaati, wa min sharri fitnatil-maseehid-dajjaal
duas.translation:
O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the trial of life and death and from the evil of the trial of Masih al-Dajjal.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you utters tashahhud (in prayer) he must seek refuge in Allah from four (trials) and should thus say : (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، - حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَعَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَشَهَّدَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: When any one of you utters tashahhud (in prayer) he must seek refuge with Allah from four (trials) and should thus say:" O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the trial of life and death and from the evil of the trial of Masih al-Dajjal" (Antichrist). [Muslim: 588]

Using this dua e masura brings Allah’s mercy and safety in every muslim prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua e Masura

points: After every fard salah, read dua e masura for protection from hellfire and evil.
In your daily morning azkar, add this dua masura to seek Allah’s hifazat for the day.
Before going to bed, recite dua for protection from dajjal and grave punishment.
When feeling scared of fitna, use this protection dua to ask Allah for safety and peace.
During times of big trials, make dua e masura in english for strong Iman and Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua e Masura for Protection
how_to_perform.description: This dua e masura is a strong protection dua that asks Allah to save you from Jahannam, the grave, the fitna of life and death, and the evil of Dajjal. Every Muslim should use this dua for safety and peace in daily life.
steps: After tashahhud in salah, quietly recite this dua for protection from evil and Jahannam.
When you feel scared or worried, say this dua for protection from dajjal and fitna with full trust.

Teach your family this masnoon dua so everyone can ask Allah for safety and Barakah together.

duas.title: Dua Masura #3 (Allahummaghfirli Ma Qaddamtu)
duas.introduction: Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to say these words at the end of the prayer between Tashahhud and Salam:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lee maa qaddamtu, wa maa 'akhkhartu, wa maa 'asrartu, wa maa 'a'lantu, wa maa 'asraftu, wa maa 'Anta 'a'lamu bihi minnee. 'Antal-Muqaddimu, wa 'Antal-Mu'akhkhiru laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta
duas.translation:
O Allah, forgive me what I have sent before me and what I have left behind me, what I have concealed and what I have done openly, what I have done in excess, and what You are better aware of than I. You are the One Who sends forth and You are the One Who delays. There is none worthy of worship but You.

After tashahood, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) supplicate this dua at the end, before saying salaam.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ الْمَاجِشُونُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مِنْ آخِرِ مَا يَقُولُ بَيْنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night for prayer he would say: I turn my face in complete devotion to One Who is the Originator of the heaven and the earth and I am not of the polytheists. Verily my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds; There is no partner with Him and this is what I have been commanded (to profess and believe) and I am of the believers. O Allah, Thou art the King, there is no god but Thee, Thou art my Lord, and I am Thy bondman. I wronged myself and make a confession of my Sin. Forgive all my sins, for no one forgives the sins but Thee, and guide me in the best of conduct for none but Thee guideth anyone (in) good conduct. Remove sins from me, for none else but Thou can remove sins from me. Here I am at Thy service, and Grace is to Thee and the whole of good is in Thine hand, and one cannot get nearneststo Thee through evil. My (power as well as existence) is due to Thee (Thine grace) and I turn to Thee (for supplication). Thou art blessed and Thou art exalted. I seek forgiveness from Thee and turn to Thee in repentance: and when he would bow, he would say: O Allah, it is for Thee that I bowed. I affirm my faith in Thee and I submit to Thee, and submit humbly before Thee my hearing, my eyesight, my marrow, my bone, my sinew; and when he would raise his head, he would say: O Allah, our Lord, praise is due to Thee, (the praise) with which is filled the heavens and the earth, and with which is filled that (space) which exists between them, and filled with anything that Thou desireth afterward. And when he prostrated himself, he (the Holy Prophet) would say: O Allah, it is to Thee that I prostrate myself and it is in Thee that I affirm my faith, and I submit to Thee. My face is submitted before One Who created it, and shaped it, and opened his faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the best of Creators; and he would then say between Tashahhud and the pronouncing of salutation: Forgive me of the earlier and later open and secret (sins) and that where I made transgression and that Thou knowest better than I. Thou art the First and the Last. There is no god, but Thee. [Muslim: 771]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua e Masura (Allahummaghfirli Ma Qaddamtu)
benefits.description: This dua e masura for forgiveness helps Muslims ask Allah to clean all sins, hidden or open, and brings hope for maghfirat and mercy in every Muslim’s Amal and daily Salah.

In the quiet moments before going to bed, use this dua for forgiveness of sins.

During times of istighfar, include this dua masura to seek Allah’s mercy and Barakah.
On Fridays, after jummah salah, recite this forgiveness dua for a clean heart and Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua e Masura for Forgiveness

duas.title: Dua e Masura #4 (Allahumma Inni Zalamtu Nafsi)
duas.introduction: Narrated by Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA): I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to teach me a dua so that I may invoke Allah with it in my prayer. He told me to say:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ ظُلْمًا كَثِيْرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِيْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee dhalamtu nafsee dhulman katheeran, wa laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba 'illaa 'Anta, faghfir lee maghfiratan min 'indika warhamnee 'innaka 'Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem
duas.translation: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself and no one forgives sins but You. So, grant me forgiveness and have mercy on me. Surely, you are Forgiving, Merciful.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً أَدْعُو بِهِ فِي صَلاَتِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Bakr As-Siddiq: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to teach me an invocation so that I may invoke Allah with it in my prayer. He told me to say, "Allahumma inni zalumtu nafsi zulman kathiran, Wala yaghfiru dh-dhunuba illa anta, fa ghfir li maghfiratan min `indika, wa r-hamni, innaka anta l-ghafuru r-rahim (O Allah! I have done great injustice to myself and none except You forgives sins, so bestow on me a forgiveness from You, and Have Mercy on me, You are the Forgiver, the Merciful). [Bukhari: 834]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua e Masura (Allahumma Inni Zalamtu Nafsi)
benefits.description: This dua e masura in namaz helps Muslims admit their mistakes and ask Allah for His maghfirat and Rahmah, making hearts soft and bringing hope for forgiveness in every Salah.
points: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi brings Allah’s maghfirat for big and small sins.
Dua after tashahhud helps Muslims get Allah’s Rahmah when they feel weak inside.
This masnoon dua teaches Muslims to turn to Allah alone for real forgiveness.

steps: Make your niyyah for tauba and quietly say allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi with a soft heart.

duas.title: Dua Mashura #5 (Allahumma Bi Ilmika Al Ghaib)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الْغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ أَحْيِنِيْ مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِيْ إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيْمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ اَللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِيْنَةِ الْإِيْمَانِ وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِيْنَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bi'ilmikal-ghayba wa qudratika 'alal-khalq, 'ahyinee maa 'alimtal-hayaata khayran lee wa tawaffanee 'idhaa 'alimtal-wafaata khayran lee, Allaahumma wa 'as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati, wa 'as'aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-ridhaa wal-ghadhabi, wa 'as'alukal-qasda fil-faqri walghinaa, wa 'as'aluka na'eeman laa yanfadu, wa 'as'aluka qurrata 'aynin laa tanqati'u, wa 'as'alukar-ridhaa ba'dal-qadhaa, wa 'as'aluka bardal-'ayshi ba'dal-mawti, wa 'as'aluka ladh-dhatan-nadhari 'ilaa wajhika wash-shawqa 'ilaa liqaa'ika fee ghayri darraa'a mudirratin wa laa fitnatin mudillatin, Allaahumma zayyinnaa bizeenatil-'eemaani waj'alnaa hudaatan muhtadeen
duas.translation:
O Allah, by Your Knowledge of the unseen and by Your Power over creation, let me live if You know that life is good for me, and let me die if You know that death is good for me. O Allah, I ask You to grant me fear of You in private and in public. I ask you for the word of truth in times of contentment and anger. I ask You for moderation in wealth and in poverty. I ask you for blessings never ceasing and the coolness of my eye (i .e . pleasure) that never ends. I ask You for pleasure after Your Judgment and I ask You for a life of coolness after death. I ask You for the delight of gazing upon Your Face and the joy of meeting You without any harm and misleading trials befalling me. O Allah, dress us with the beauty of Faith, and make us guides who are upon (correct) guidance.

It was narrated from Ata bn As-Sa'ib (R) that: Ammar bin Yasir (RA) led us in prayer and he made it brief. Some of the people said to him: 'You made the prayer short.He said: 'Nevertheless I still recited supplications that I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).' Saying this, he taught them the above dua.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عَرَبِيٍّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ صَلاَةً فَأَوْجَزَ فِيهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ لَقَدْ خَفَّفْتَ أَوْ أَوْجَزْتَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَمَّا عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ فِيهَا بِدَعَوَاتٍ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا قَامَ تَبِعَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ هُوَ أَبِي غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ كَنَى عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الدُّعَاءِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَأَخْبَرَ بِهِ الْقَوْمَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الْغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي اللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لاَ يَنْفَدُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَاءَ بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلاَ فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَّا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ata bn As-Sa'ib narrated that his father said: "Ammar bin Yasir led us in prayer and he made it brief. Some of the people said to him: 'You made the prayer sort (or brief).' He said: 'Nevertheless I still recited supplications that I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).' When he got up and left, a man -- he was my father but he did not name himself -- followed him and asked him about that supplication, then he came and told the people: "Allāhumma bi `ilmikal-ghaiba wa qudratika 'alal-khalqi aḥyinī mā `alimtal-ḥayāta khairan lī, wa tawaffanī idhā `alimtal-wafāta khairan lī. Allāhumma wa 'as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaibi wash-shahādati wa 'as'aluka kalimatal-ḥaqqi fir-riḍā'i wal ghaḍab, wa as'alukal-qaṣda fil faqri wal-ghina, wa 'as'aluka na`īman lā yanfadu wa 'as'aluka qurrata `ainin lā tanqaṭi`u wa as'alukar-riḍā'i ba`dal-qaḍā'i wa 'as'aluka bardal `aishi ba`dal-mawti, wa 'as'aluka ladhdhatan-naẓari ilā wajhika wash-shawqa ilā liqā'ika fī ghairi ḍarrā'a muḍirratin wa lā fitnatin muḍillatin, Allāhumma zayyinnā bizīnatil-īmāni waj`alna hudātan muhtadīn (O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know that living is good for me and cause me to die when You know that death is better for me. O Allah, cause me to fear You in secret and in public. I ask You to make me true in speech in times of pleasure and of anger. I ask You to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty. And I ask You for everlasting delight and joy that will never cease. I ask You to make me pleased with that which You have decreed and for an easy life after death. I askYou for the sweetness of looking upon Your face and a longing to meet You in a manner that does not entail a calamity that will bring about harm or a trial that will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us among those who guide and are rightly guided." [Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 1305]

duas.title: Dua Masurah #6 (Allahumma Inni As Aluka Min Khairi)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi, 'aajilihi wa aajilihi, maa 'alimtu minhu wa maa lam a'lam. Wa A‛oodhu bika minash-sharri kullihi, 'aajilihi wa aajilihi, maa 'alimtu minhu wa maa lam a'lam. Allaahumma inni as'aluka min khayri maa sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka, wa A‛oodhu bika min sharri maa 'aadha bihi 'abduka wa nabiyyuka. Allaahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa maa qarraba ilayhaa min qawlin aw 'amal, wa A‛oodhu bika minan-naari wa maa qarraba ilayhaa min qawlin aw 'amal, wa as'aluka an taj'al kulla qadaa'in qadaytahu li khayra
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your slave and Prophet (ﷺ) has asked You for, and I seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your slave and Prophet (ﷺ) sought refuge. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and I seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And I ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning me good.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَبْرُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ عَلَّمَهَا هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from 'Aishah that : the Messenger of Allah (saas) taught her this supplication: "Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma la a'lam. Wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma la a'lam. Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'adha bihi 'abduka wa nabiyyuka. Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannatah wa ma qarrab ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa a'udhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa as'aluka an taj'al kulla qada'in qadaytahuli khayran (O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your slave and Prophet has asked You for, and I seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your slave and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and I seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And I ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning me good)." [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 3846]

duas.title: Dua For Protection From Punishment Of Grave, Hell And Dajjal
duas.introduction: Protection from punishment of the grave, trials of life, death & Dajjal, from sin & debt:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْـيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabr, wa 'a'oodhu bika min fitnatil-maseehid-dajjaal, wa 'a'oodhu bika min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaat. Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram
duas.translation:
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.

Narrated by `Aisha (RA) (the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say this dua in the prayer. She said to him, "Why do you so frequently seek refuge with Allah from being in debt?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "A person who in debt tells lies whenever he speaks, and breaks promises whenever he makes (them)."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْعُو فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَمَاتِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ قَائِلٌ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تَسْتَعِيذُ مِنَ الْمَغْرَمِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا غَرِمَ حَدَّثَ فَكَذَبَ، وَوَعَدَ فَأَخْلَفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَعِيذُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ
hadith.translation: Narrated `Aisha: (the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah in the prayer saying "Allahumma inni a`udhu bika min `adhabi l-qabr, wa a`udhu bika min fitnati l-masihi d-dajjal, wa a`udhu bika min fitnati l-mahya wa fitnati l-mamat. Allahumma inni a`udhu bika mina l-ma'thami wa l-maghram. (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave, from the afflictions of the imposter- Messiah, and from the afflictions of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from sins and from debt)." Somebody said to him, "Why do you so frequently seek refuge with Allah from being in debt?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "A person in debt tells lies whenever he speaks, and breaks promises whenever he makes (them)." `Aisha also narrated: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his prayer seeking refuge with Allah from the afflictions of Ad-Dajjal. [Bukhari: 832]

In your daily zikr Allah, add this dua after salah to ask Allah for safety from all trials.
Before going to bed, softly read this dua masura to protect your Iman and heart from harm.
During hard times, remember this dua e mashura to seek Allah’s help against every fitnah.

duas.title: Dua at the end of Salah (Allahumma Inni A Uzu Bika)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيْحِ الدَّجَّالِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَمِنَ الْمَغْرَمِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma inni a`udhu bika min `adhaabi jahannam, wa a`udhu bika min `adhaabil-qabr, wa a`udhu bika min fitnatil-masihid-dajjaal, wa a`udhu bika min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaat, Allaahumma inni a`udhu bika minal-ma'thami wa minal-maghram
duas.translation:
O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of Hell, and I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the grave, and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of the Masih al-Dajjal (Antichrist) and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of life and death. O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from sin and debt.

Ibn ‘Abbas (RA) said that the Holy Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach them (the Companions) this Dua in the same way he used to teach them Surah of the Quran. He used to say: (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَلِيًّا، - رضى الله عنه - يَخْطُبُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَكْذِبُوا عَلَىَّ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَكْذِبْ عَلَىَّ يَلِجِ النَّارَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abū Bakr ibn Abī Shaybah narrated to us that Ghundar narrated to us, on authority of Shu’bah; and Muhammad bin ul-Muthannā and Ibn Bashār both narrated to us, they said: Muhammad bin Ja’far narrated to us, Shu’bah narrated to us, on authority of Mansūr, on authority of Rab’iy ibn Hirāsh, that he heard Alī, may Allah be pleased with him, giving a Khutbah and he said that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah upon him, said: ‘Do not lie upon me; indeed whoever lies upon me will enter the Fire’. [Muslim: 1/412]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua at the End of Salah (Allahumma Inni A Uzu Bika)
benefits.description: This dua e masura helps a Muslim find Allah’s protection from every big trial, keeping the heart safe from Jahannam, Dajjal, and the burden of sins and debt after every Salah.
points: Allah saves a Muslim from Jahannam’s azaab with this dua after salah.
A person gets protection from Dajjal’s fitna by asking with this dua in salah.
This Islamic dua keeps the grave’s punishment away and brings Barakah in life.
Dua for debt and sins helps a Muslim stay free from heavy burden and worry.
Using dua e mashura, Allah keeps Iman strong and Amal safe from every fitna.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua E Masura
when_to_recite.description: This dua e masura is a strong call for help, asking Allah to save us from Jahannam, the grave, Dajjal, and the pain of debt and sin, filling our hearts with hope and Barakah after every salah.
points: After tashahhud in every fard salah, Muslims use this dua for protection from Jahannam.
Before making salam in prayer, believers recite dua after salah for safety from Dajjal.
When feeling scared of grave punishment, Muslims turn to this dua for protection from Dajjal.
At the end of namaz, Muslims read dua e masura for forgiveness of sins and debt.
In times of worry about karz, believers use karz se nijat ki dua for peace and Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua e Masura after Salah
how_to_perform.description: This dua e masura is a strong Muslim prayer for protection from Jahannam, Dajjal, grave, and debt. It is a masnoon dua that Prophet Muhammad (SAW) taught us to read after tashahhud in salah for safety and Barakah.
steps: After you finish tashahhud in namaz, quietly recite this dua e masura before ending salah.
When you feel scared of Dajjal or Jahannam, use this dua for protection in your prayer.
If you are worried about debt, add this dua for debt in your salah to ask Allah for help.
For forgiveness of sins, make sure to read this dua masura with full heart in every fard salah.
At the end of every salah, remember to say this masnun dua to keep your Iman and Amal safe.

duas.title: Dua Masoora #7 (Allahumma A Inni Ala Zikrika)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'a'innee 'alaa dhikrika, wa shukrika, wahusni 'ibaadatik
duas.translation:
O Allah, help me to remember You, to give You thanks, and to perform Your worship in the best manner.

Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caught his hand and said: By Allah, I love you, Mu'adh. By Allah, I love you. I give some instruction to you. Never leave to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer: (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيُّ، عَنِ الصُّنَابِحِيِّ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّكَ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أُوصِيكَ يَا مُعَاذُ لاَ تَدَعَنَّ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَوْصَى بِذَلِكَ مُعَاذٌ الصُّنَابِحِيَّ وَأَوْصَى بِهِ الصُّنَابِحِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Mu'adh b. Jabal reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caught his hand and said: By Allah, I love you, Mu'adh. I give some instruction to you. Never leave to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer: "O Allah, help me in remembering You, in giving You thanks, and worshipping You well." Mu'adh willed this supplication to the narrator al-Sunabihi and al-Sunabihi to 'Abu Abd al-Rahman. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1522]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Masoora #7 (Allahumma A Inni Ala Zikrika)
benefits.description: This dua e masura helps a Muslim keep Allah close in every Amal, making the heart full of shukr, strong in zikrullah, and always ready for good ibadah after every prayer.
points: Allah gives a Muslim power for zikrullah and keeps the heart soft with this dua.
A person finds it easy to thank Allah by making this dua after salah every day.
This Islamic dua helps a Muslim do Amal and ibadah in the best way for Allah.
Dua masura brings Barakah in life and keeps shukr strong in every part of day.
Asking with Allahumma A Inni Ala Zikrika, Allah makes zikir and prayer easy.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua E Masura
when_to_recite.description: This dua e masura is a simple call to Allah, asking for help to remember Him, thank Him, and do Amal in the best way, bringing Barakah and peace to every Muslim after prayer and in daily life.
points: After every fard salah, Muslims read this dua after salah for Allah’s help in zikrullah.
When finishing namaz, believers use dua after prayer to thank Allah for His Barakah.
Before leaving prayer mat, Muslims recite Allahumma A Inni Ala Zikrika for strong Iman.
In quiet moments after salah, believers use this dua masura for better Amal and worship.
When feeling weak in zikir Allah, Muslims turn to this dua masoora for help and guidance.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua e Masura after Salah
how_to_perform.description: This dua e masura is a simple Muslim prayer asking Allah for help in zikrullah, thanking Allah, and doing ibadah in the best way. It is a masnoon dua that should be read after every prayer to keep your heart close to Allah and get Barakah in Amal.
steps: After you finish your namaz, softly recite Allahumma A Inni Ala Zikrika as a dua after salah.
When you want to thank Allah, use this dua masura to show your shukr and get more blessings.
If you wish to remember Allah more, read this zikrullah dua after every fard prayer with Iman.
For better ibadah, make this dua after prayer to ask Allah for help in worship and Amal.
At the end of your salah, say this masnun dua to keep your zikr Allah and shukr strong always.

duas.title: Dua Masoorah #8 (Allahumma Inni A Uzu Bika Minal)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika minal-bukhli, wa 'a'oodhu bika minal-jubni, wa 'a'oodhu bika min 'an nuradda 'ilaa 'ardhalil-'umuri, wa 'a'oodhu bika min fitnatid-dunyaa wa 'adhaabil-qabr
duas.translation:
O Allah! I seek refuge with You from cowardice, and miserliness, and seek refuge with You from reaching a degraded helpless old age, and seek refuge with You from the afflictions of the world and from the punishment in the grave.

Narrated by Saad Ibn Abi Waqqas (RA): Saad (RA) used to teach these words to his sons in the same way that a teacher teaches handwriting to children. And he used to say that towards the end of the prayer, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would seek refuge (in Allah) in these matters: (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ مُصْعَبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ تَعَوَّذُوا بِكَلِمَاتٍ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَعَوَّذُ بِهِنَّ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Sa`d: Seek refuge with Allah by saying the words which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say while seeking refuge with Allah, "0 Allah! I seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from miserliness, and seek refuge with You from reaching a degraded geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from the afflictions of the world and from the punishment in the grave." [Bukhari: 6374]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Masoorah #8 (Allahumma Inni A Uzu Bika Minal)
benefits.description: This dua e masura helps a Muslim stay safe from the bad things of dunya, asking Allah for Barakah, courage, and protection from grave’s azaab and every fitna in life.
points: Allah keeps a Muslim away from bukhil and gives Barakah with this protection dua.
A person gets courage and stays safe from cowardice by making this dua masura.
This Islamic dua protects from old age weakness and brings ease in every Amal.
Dua for grave punishment helps a Muslim stay safe from qabar ka azab and fear.
Asking with audzubillah, Allah keeps the heart strong against dunya’s fitna.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua E Masura
when_to_recite.description: This dua e masura is a strong shield for Muslims, asking Allah to save us from miserliness, cowardice, old age weakness, fitnah of dunya, and grave punishment, bringing Barakah and peace in every Amal and day.
points: After every fard salah, Muslims use this dua for protection from grave punishment.
When feeling scared of dunya fitnah, believers turn to this protection dua for hifazat.
Before leaving prayer mat, Muslims recite dua masura for Barakah and safety from qabar ka azab.
In times of weakness or fear, believers use audzubillah for help against cowardice and old age.
When thinking about azab e qabar, Muslims read dua e masura for peace and Allah’s mercy.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua e Masura for Protection
how_to_perform.description: This dua e masura is a strong protection dua from miserliness, cowardice, old age weakness, fitna of dunya, and grave punishment. It is a masnoon dua that every Muslim should read for hifazat and Barakah in life and akhirah.
steps: After your namaz, quietly recite this dua e masura for protection from grave punishment.
When you feel scared of dunya fitna, use this protection dua to ask Allah for hifazat.
If you worry about old age weakness, read this dua masura to stay safe from helplessness.
For safety from miserliness and cowardice, make this dua after salah with full Iman.
At the end of your prayer, say this masnun dua to keep away azab e qabar and get Barakah.

duas.title: Dua For Jannah (Allahumma Inni As Aluka Al Jannah)
duas.introduction: Narrated by Abu Huraira (RA): He said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to a person: what do you say in prayer? He replied: I first recite tashahhud (supplication recited in sitting position), and then I say:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-jannata wa 'a'oodhu bika minan-naar
duas.translation:
O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

I can't recite dua as beautifully as you do, not even as Mu'adh! "Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Our dua also carries meaning close to it!"

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَبْرُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ عَلَّمَهَا هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from 'Aishah that: the Messenger of Allah (saas) taught her this supplication: "Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma la a'lam. Wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma la a'lam. Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'adha bihi 'abduka wa nabiyyuka. Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannatah wa ma qarrab ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa a'udhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa as'aluka an taj'al kulla qada'in qadaytahuli khayran (O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your slave and Prophet has asked You for, and I seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your slave and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and I seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And I ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning me good)." Sunan Ibn Majah 3846 [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah 3846]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua For Jannah (Allahumma Inni As Aluka Al Jannah)
benefits.description: This dua for jannah helps a Muslim ask Allah for the best place in akhirah, keeping the heart full of hope, Barakah, and safety from Jahannam in every part of life.
points: Allah gives a Muslim hope for Jannah Firdaus with this simple dua for jannah.
A person finds safety from Jahannam by asking with allahumma inni as aluka.
This Islamic dua brings Barakah and keeps the heart strong in Amal and Iman.
Dua for jannah helps a Muslim remember akhirah and stay away from bad deeds.
Asking with allahumma inni as aluka al jannah, Allah brings peace in the heart.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Jannah
when_to_recite.description: This dua for jannah is a simple call to Allah, asking for Jannah Firdaus and safety from Jahannam, filling the heart with hope and Iman every time a Muslim remembers the hereafter.
points: After every fard salah, Muslims use allahumma inni as aluka al jannah for Jannah Firdaus.
When thinking about akhirah, believers turn to dua for jannah to ask Allah for mercy.
Before going to bed, Muslims recite this dua for jannah for peace and Barakah in sleep.
In times of hardship, believers use allahumma inni as aluka for hope and strength from Allah.
When feeling scared of Jahannam, Muslims read dua for jannah for protection and comfort.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Jannah
how_to_perform.description: This dua for jannah is a short and easy Muslim prayer asking Allah for Jannah Firdaus and protection from Jahannam. Every Muslim should read this masnoon dua daily to keep hope for Jannah and stay safe from the Fire.
steps: After you finish your namaz, softly say Allahumma inni as aluka al jannah with full heart.
When you think about akhirah, use this dua for jannah to ask Allah for His mercy and reward.
If you feel scared of Jahannam, read this dua in salah to seek protection from the Fire.
For your family and friends, make this dua for jannah firdaus to ask Allah for them too.
At the end of your prayer, remember to say this masnun dua to keep your Iman strong always.

duas.title: Dua Masura #9 (Allahumma Inni As Aluka Ya Allah Bi'Annaka)
duas.introduction: Narrated by Mizan Ibn Arda (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the mosque. Then a person is reciting Tashahhud towards the end of the prayer. He says:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا أَللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka yaaAllahu bi'annakal-Waahidul-'Ahadus-Samadul-ladhee, lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'Ahad, 'an taghfira lee dhunoobee 'innaka 'Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem
duas.translation:
O Allah, I ask You. O Allah, You are the One, the Only, Self-Sufficient Master, Who was not begotten and begets not and none is equal to Him. Forgive me my sins, surely you are Forgiving, Merciful.

After hearing his supplication, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said three times, "He has been forgiven."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو بُرَيْدٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ مِحْجَنَ بْنَ الأَدْرَعِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ إِذَا رَجُلٌ قَدْ قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ وَهُوَ يَتَشَهَّدُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قَدْ غُفِرَ لَهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Hanzalah bin 'Ali narrated that: Mihjan bin Al-Adra' narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the masjid and there was a man who had finished his prayer and he was reciting the tashahhud. He said: "Allahumma inni as'aluka ya Allah! Bi-annakal-Wahidul-Ahad us-Samad, alladhi lam yalid wa lam yowled, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfirali dhunubi, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim (O Allah, I ask of You, O Allah, as You are the One, the Only, the Self-Sufficient Master, Who begets not nor was He begotten, and there is None equal or comparable to Him, forgive me my sins, for You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.)" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "He has been forgiven," three times. [Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 1301]

Dua for forgiveness helps a Muslim remember Allah is Al Ghafoor and Ar Raheem.
Asking with ya Allah, Allahumma inni as aluka, Allah keeps Amal and Iman strong.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Masura
when_to_recite.description: This dua masura is a strong call to Allah, the One and Only, asking for forgiveness and mercy, using His names al ahad, as samad, al ghafoor, and ar raheem, bringing hope to every Muslim heart.

When feeling heavy with sins, turn to Allah with dua e masura for forgiveness and mercy.
During the last part of the night, raise your hands and recite this forgiveness dua for maghfirat.

Before going to bed, make dua e masoora with a soft heart, seeking Allah’s mercy and maghfirat.

At the end of your prayer, say this masnun dua to keep your heart clean and Amal strong.

duas.title: Dua Masura #10
duas.introduction: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik (RA) said: I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and a man was standing and praying. When he bowed, prostrated and recited the tashahhud, he supplicated, and in his supplication he said:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as’aluka bi anna lakal-hamda laa ilaaha illaa anta al-mannaanu, badee‛-us-samawaati wal-ardi yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikraam, yaa hayyu yaa qayyoomu, inne as’aluka
duas.translation:
O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all. I am asking you

The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Do you know what he has supplicated with?' They said: "Allah (SWT) and His Messenger know best." He (ﷺ) said: 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, he called upon Allah by His greatest Name, which, if He is called by it, He responds, and if He is asked by it, He gives.'"

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ أَخِي، أَنَسٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسًا - يَعْنِي - وَرَجُلٌ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فَلَمَّا رَكَعَ وَسَجَدَ وَتَشَهَّدَ دَعَا فَقَالَ فِي دُعَائِهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بَدِيعُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏"‏ تَدْرُونَ بِمَا دَعَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ دَعَا اللَّهَ بِاسْمِهِ الْعَظِيمِ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ وَإِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said: "I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and a man was standing and praying. When he bowed, prostrated and recited the tashahhud, he supplicated, and in his supplication he said: "Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna lakal-hamd, lailaha illa ant, al-mannanu badi'us-samawati wal-ard, ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram! Ya hayyu ya qayyum! Inni as'aluka. (O Allah, indeed I ask You since all praise is due to You, there is none worthy of worship but You, the Bestower, the Creator of the heavens and earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever-living, O-Eternal, I ask of You.)' The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Do you know what he has supplicated with?' They said: "Allah (SWT) and His Messenger know best." He said: 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, he called upon Allah by His greatest Name, which, if He is called by it, He responds, and if He is asked by it, He gives.'" [Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 1300]

In times of hardship, remember ya dhal jalali wal ikram and ask for ease with this dua e masura.
Before starting any big work, begin with allahumma and this dua masura for Barakah and success.
During your daily zikr allah, use this dua e mashura to keep your Iman strong and heart soft.

duas.title: Dua e Masura #11 (Allahumma Inni As Aluka Bi Annaka Antallah Full Dua)
duas.introduction: Buraidah ibn husaib (RA) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a man supplicating, and he was saying:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي اَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka bi'annee 'ash-hadu 'annaka 'AntAllahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Antal-'Ahadus-Samadul-ladhee lam yalid wa lam yoolad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'Ahad
duas.translation:
O Allah, I ask You, by the fact that I bear witness that You are Allah. There is none worthy of worship but You, the Only ilah, Independent of creation, Who was not begotten and begets not, and none is equal to Him.

Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, ‘By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, he has asked Allah by His Greatest Name, the one which if He is called upon by it, He responds, and when He is asked by it, He gives.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعَ رَجُلاً يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ سَأَلْتَ اللَّهَ بِالاِسْمِ الَّذِي إِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى وَإِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Buraydah ibn al-Hasib: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard a man saying: O Allah, I ask Thee, I bear witness that there is no god but Thou, the One, He to Whom men repair, Who has not begotten, and has not been begotten, and to Whom no one is equal, and he said: You have supplicated Allah using His Greatest Name, when asked with this name He gives, and when supplicated by this name he answers. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1493]

Before going to bed, softly say this dua masura to keep your heart and Amal strong.

duas.title: Dua E Masurah #12
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka bi'anna lakal-hamdu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta wahdaka laa shareeka laka, Al-Mannaanu, yaa Badee'as-samawaati wal'ardhi yaa dhal-Jalaali wal-'Ikraam, yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu 'innee 'as'alukal-jannata wa 'a'oodhu bika minan-naar
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You, as You are the Owner of praise, there is none worthy of worship but You alone, You have no partner. You are the Giver of all good. O Creator of the heavens and the earth, Owner of majesty and honor. O Living and Everlasting One, I ask you for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the fire.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعَ رَجُلاً يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ سَأَلْتَ اللَّهَ بِالاِسْمِ الَّذِي إِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى وَإِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Buraydah ibn al-Hasib: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard a man saying: O Allah, I ask Thee, I bear witness that there is no god but Thou, the One, He to Whom men repair, Who has not begotten, and has not been begotten, and to Whom no one is equal, and he said: You have supplicated Allah using His Greatest Name, when asked with this name He gives, and when supplicated by this name he answers. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1493-1495]

Before going to bed, softly say this dua e masura in english or Arabic to keep your heart safe.

duas.title: Dua e Mashura
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَرَمِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee A‛oodhu bika minal kasali, wa A‛oodhu bika minal jubni, wa A‛oodhu bika minal harami, wa A‛oodhu bika minal bukhl.
duas.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness, and seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from miserliness.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَعَوَّذُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَرَمِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to seek refuge with Allah saying, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness, and seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from miserliness." [Bukhari: 6371]

duas.title: Dua in Salah (Allahu Akbar Kabira Walhamdulillah Kaseera)
duas.introduction: Abdullah Ibn 'Umar (RA) reported: While we were praying with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one among the people said:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيْرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar Kabiran, walhamdu lillaahi kathiran, wa Subhaanallahi bukratan wa'asila
duas.translation:
Allah is the Greatest, Most Great. Praise is to Allah, abundantly. Glory is to Allah, at the break of day and at its end.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who uttered such and such a word? A person among the people (who have recited these words) said: Me! Ya Messenger of Allah!. He (ﷺ) said: it's utterance surprised me because for this dua, the doors of heaven were opened. Ibn 'Umar (RA) said: I have not abandoned them (to recite this dua) since I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying this.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ نُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنِ الْقَائِلُ كَلِمَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَجِبْتُ لَهَا فُتِحَتْ لَهَا أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَمَا تَرَكْتُهُنَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ ‏.
hadith.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported: While we said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one among the people said: Allah is truly Great, praise be to Allah in abundance. Glory be to Allah in the morning and the evening. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon, him) said: Who uttered such and such a word? A person among the people said: It is I, Messenger of Allah (who have recited these words). He (the Holy Prophet) said: It (its utterance) surprised me, for the doors of heaven were opened for It. Ibn 'Umar said: I have not abandoned them (these words) since I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying this. [Muslim: 601]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Salah (Allahu Akbar Kabira Walhamdulillah Kaseera)
benefits.description: This dua for salah fills the heart with Allah’s greatness and praise, making every muslim’s namaz start with Barakah and peace, and helps keep the mind focused on Allah from start to end.
points: Allahu akbar kabira in dua istiftah lifts the heart with Allah’s greatness in salah.
Saying walhamdulillah kathira brings endless shukr and Barakah in every namaz.
Subhanallah bukratan wa asila in dua e sana keeps the tongue busy with zikr allah.
This dua before salah helps muslims start namaz with pure Iman and clean niyyah.
Using this masnoon dua for salah brings more khushu and peace in every muslim prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Salah
when_to_recite.description: This dua for salah, known as allahu akbar kabira walhamdulillah kathira, fills your prayer with praise, Barakah, and brings your heart closer to Allah at every start and end of the day.
points: At the start of salah, recite dua istiftah like allahu akbar kabira before surah Fatiha.
When you stand for fajr, use this dua before salah to fill your heart with praise for Allah.
In every sunnah prayer, begin with dua e sana to bring Barakah and focus in your namaz.
Before namaz, say allahu akbar kabira walhamdulillah kathira for a clean start in salah.
During your daily zikr allah, remember this dua for salah to keep your Iman strong all day.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Salah
how_to_perform.description: This dua for salah, known as allahu akbar kabira walhamdulillah kathira, is a special dua istiftah said at the start of namaz. It fills your prayer with Barakah and helps you remember Allah from morning till night.
steps: Begin your salah by saying dua e sana or dua istiftah after takbir to praise Allah.
Right after saying allahu akbar, softly recite allahu akbar kabira with full heart.
When you stand for prayer, use this dua before salah to start your namaz with zikr allah.
In every salah, say allahu akbar kabira walhamdulillah kathira to get more khushu.
Before namaz, teach kids this dua for salah so they learn to love Islamic prayers.

duas.title: Dua for sneezing in Salah
duas.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ مُبَارَكًا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضَى
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubaarakan fih, mubarakan 'alayhi, kama yuhibbu rabbuna wa yarda.
duas.translation: Praise be to Allah, much good and blessed praise as our Lord loves and is pleased with.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ آمِينَ وَقَالَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ فِي السَّمَاءِ آمِينَ فَوَافَقَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الأُخْرَى غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If any one of you says: 'Amin' and the angels in Heaven say Amin, and the one coincides with the other, his previous sins will be forgiven." [Hassan (Albani). An-Nasai: 930]

duas.title: Dua After Fajr Prayer (Allahumma Inni As Aluka Ilman)
duas.introduction: Umm Salamah (RA) said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say these words after the salutation, at the end of the Fajr prayer."
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as’aluka ‛ilman naafi‛an, warizqan tayyiban, wa ‛amalan mutaqabbalaa
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ مَوْلًى، لأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ حِينَ يُسَلِّمُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from Umm Salamah that when the Prophet (ﷺ) performed the Subh (morning prayer), while he said the Salam, he would say: ‘Allahumma inni as’aluka ‘ilman nafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan (O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, goodly provision and acceptable deeds).’” [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 925]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Fajr Prayer (Allahumma Inni As Aluka Ilman)
benefits.description: This dua after fajr prayer brings a muslim closer to Allah’s mercy, asking for good knowledge, pure rizq, and accepted Amal, making every morning start with hope and Barakah from fajr namaz.
points: Allahumma inni as aluka ilman in fajr dua brings useful knowledge for muslims.
Rizq becomes halal and tayyib when this dua after fajr is made with clean heart.
Amal gets accepted by Allah when muslims use this dua after fajr salah daily.
Fajr prayer with this dua brings Barakah in morning and helps in every good work.
This dua after fajr namaz keeps the day safe and brings Allah’s help in all matters.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Fajr Prayer
when_to_recite.description: This dua after fajr prayer is a strong way to start your day, asking Allah for knowledge, pure rizq, and good Amal, bringing Barakah and help in every step after the fajr prayer is done.
points: After finishing fajr prayer, ask Allah with this dua after fajr prayer for knowledge.
When the sun rises and you feel hope, use the dua after fajr for rizq and Barakah.
Before leaving home in the morning, recite Allahumma Inni As Aluka Ilman for success.
At fajr prayer time, right after salam, make this dua for everything you need in your day.
If you want your morning Amal to be accepted, use this dua after fajr salah for pure deeds.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Fajr Prayer
how_to_perform.description: This dua after fajr prayer is a strong morning dua asking Allah for good knowledge, pure rizq, and Amal that He accepts. It is a muslim prayer that brings Barakah and helps you start your day with Iman and hope.
steps: Right after fajr prayer, stay seated and recite Allahumma Inni As Aluka Ilman with full heart.
When you finish your fajr namaz, raise your hands and ask for knowledge and halal rizq.
In the early morning, say this dua after fajr salah to get Barakah in your day and Amal.
If you want success, repeat this dua after fajr prayer daily and trust Allah for everything.
Teach your family this dua after fajr so they remember to ask for good deeds and rizq.

duas.title: Dua After Fajr and Maghrib #1
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allahu, wa'hdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-'hamdu, yu'hyee wa yumeetu, wa huwa ‛alaa kulli shay’in qadeer
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, who is alone and does not have any partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is omnipotent over all things.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ الْجُلاَحِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ شَبِيبٍ السَّبَئِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏.‏ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ عَلَى إِثْرِ الْمَغْرِبِ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَسْلَحَةً يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ وَكَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهَا عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ مُوجِبَاتٍ وَمَحَا عَنْهُ عَشْرَ سَيِّئَاتٍ مُوبِقَاتٍ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ بِعَدْلِ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ لَيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ‏.‏ وَلاَ نَعْرِفُ لِعُمَارَةَ بْنِ شَبِيبٍ سَمَاعًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ `
hadith.translation: Umarah bin Shabib As-Saba’i narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever says: none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Alone, without partner, to Him belongs all that exists, and to Him belongs the praise, He gives life and causes death, and He is powerful over all things, (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wa huwa `alā kulli shai’in qadīr)’ ten times at the end of Al-Maghrib - Allah shall send for him protectors to guard him from Shaitan until he reaches morning, and Allah writes for him ten good deeds, Mujibat, and He wipes from him ten of the destructive evil deeds, and it shall be for him the equal of freeing ten believing slaves.” [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3534]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Fajr and Maghrib #1
benefits.description: This dua after fajr prayer and maghrib reminds every muslim of Allah’s oneness, power, and mercy, making the heart strong with shahada and filling the day and night with Barakah and peace.
points: La ilaha illallahu in this dua after fajr prayer keeps Iman strong and pure.
Zikr of Allah with this dua after maghrib brings peace and calm to the muslim heart.
Saying shahada in morning dhikr and evening dhikr brings Barakah in daily Amal.
Allah’s power and mercy are remembered with this dua after fajr and maghrib salah.
This masnoon dua after maghrib prayer protects from shirk and keeps Tawheed safe.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Fajr and Maghrib
when_to_recite.description: This dua after fajr prayer and maghrib is a strong dhikr, reminding us of Allah’s power, His praise, and the truth of la ilaha illallah, bringing Barakah and Iman in the morning and evening.
points: After fajr prayer, remember Allah with this dua after fajr prayer for strong Iman.
At maghrib prayer time, recite the dua after maghrib to thank Allah for His mercy.
When you finish fajr namaz, use this dhikr for la ilaha illallahu to start your day right.
After maghrib salah, make this zikr of Allah for Barakah and peace in your evening.
In the quiet after fajr or maghrib, say this shahada for more Amal and closeness to Allah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Fajr Prayer
how_to_perform.description: This dua after fajr prayer and maghrib is a strong zikr of Allah that brings Barakah and keeps your Iman fresh every day. Reciting la ilaha illallahu after fajr namaz and maghrib salah is a sunnah way to start and end your day with the shahada and praise for Allah.
steps: After finishing fajr namaz, sit quietly and recite la ilaha illallahu with full heart.
At maghrib time, say this dua after maghrib prayer before moving from your prayer spot.
Make sure your mind is on Allah and repeat this morning dhikr slowly and with meaning.
For evening dhikr, recite this maghrib dua as part of your daily zikr after maghrib namaz.
Teach your kids to say this first kalima after salah so they learn the zikr of Allah from young.

duas.title: Dua After Fajr and Maghrib #2 (Allahumma Ajirni Minan Naar)
duas.introduction: Say the dua 7 Times:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Ajirni minan-naar
duas.translation:
O Allah, protect me from Hell.

Harith ibn Muslim (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: When you finish the maghrib prayer, say: 'O Allah, protect me from Hell" seven times; for if you say that and die that night, Allah will protect you from jahannam; and when you finish the fajr prayer, say it in a similar way, for if you die that day, Allah will protect you from jahannam. Most of the muhaddithin have considered this hadith to be acceptable.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Fajr and Maghrib #2 (Allahumma Ajirni Minan Naar)
benefits.description: This dua after maghrib prayer and fajr asks Allah for protection from Jahannam, making every muslim’s morning and evening full of hope, safety, and Allah’s mercy in daily life.
points: Allahumma ajirni minan naar in maghrib dua keeps muslim safe from Jahannam.
This dua after fajr prayer brings Allah’s help and shields from fire of Jahannam.
Asking Allah for protection in morning dua and evening dua brings peace to heart.
Using this masnoon dua after maghrib salah gives hope for Jannah and Allah’s mercy.
Daily zikr with this dua after fajr namaz keeps Iman strong and Amal safe from harm.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Fajr and Maghrib
when_to_recite.description: This dua after maghrib prayer and fajr is a simple call for Allah’s help, asking for safety from Jahannam, and brings hope and Barakah in the early morning and quiet evening.
points: After maghrib prayer, ask Allah with this dua after maghrib prayer for protection.
At fajr prayer time, use Allahumma Ajirni Minan Naar for safety from Jahannam.
When you finish maghrib salah, make this dua after maghrib namaz for Jannah.
After fajr namaz, recite this dua for after fajr prayer to keep away from the fire.
In the calm of morning or evening, say this daily dua for Allah’s mercy and Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Maghrib Prayer
how_to_perform.description: This dua after maghrib prayer is a simple way to ask Allah for safety from Jahannam. Every Muslim should try to say this daily after maghrib and fajr prayer, as it brings Barakah and keeps your heart close to Allah.
steps: After you finish your maghrib salah, quietly say Allahumma Ajirni Minan Naar with full hope.
In the early morning, right after fajr prayer, repeat this dua after fajr to seek Allah’s mercy.
When you sit for zikr allah after maghrib namaz, make this dua for protection from Jahannam.
If you want to teach your kids, help them say this maghrib prayer dua every evening with you.
Before leaving your prayer mat, ask Allah with this daily dua to keep you safe from the fire.

duas.title: Dua After Salah (Astaghfirullah)
duas.introduction: Say three times:
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaah
duas.translation: I ask Allah for forgiveness.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، - اسْمُهُ شَدَّادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا انْصَرَفَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ اسْتَغْفَرَ ثَلاَثًا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ فَقُلْتُ لِلأَوْزَاعِيِّ كَيْفَ الاِسْتِغْفَارُ قَالَ تَقُولُ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Thauban reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer. He begged forgiveness three times and said: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee; Blessed art Thou, O Possessor of Glory and Honour. Walid reported: I said to Auza'i: How is the seeking of forgiveness? He replied: You should say: I beg forgiveness from Allah, I beg forgiveness from Allah." [Sahih Muslim: 591]

duas.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.

duas.title: Dua After Salam
duas.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this dua after every compulsory prayer:
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِىَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allahu wa'hdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-'hamdu wa huwa ‛alaa kulli shay’in qadeer, Allaahumma laa maani‛a li maa a‛tayta, wa laa mu‛tiya li maa mana‛ta wa laa yanfa‛u dhal-jaddi minkal-jaddu
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and and He is Able to do all things. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ أَمْلَى عَلَىَّ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ فِي كِتَابٍ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏" ‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بِهَذَا، وَعَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ عَنْ وَرَّادٍ بِهَذَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ الْجَدُّ غِنًى‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Warrad: (the clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Once Al-Mughira dictated to me in a letter addressed to Muawiya that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say after every compulsory prayer, "La ilaha illa l-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu, wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani`a lima a`taita, wa la mu`tiya lima mana`ta, wa la yanfa`u dhal-jaddi minka l-jadd. [There is no Deity but Allah, Alone, no Partner to Him. His is the Kingdom and all praise, and Omnipotent is he. O Allah! Nobody can hold back what you gave, nobody can give what You held back, and no struggler's effort can benefit against You]." And Al-Hasan said, "Al-jadd' means prosperity [??]." [Bukhari: 844]

duas.title: Dua After Salam in Prayer
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُوْنَ
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ‛alaa kulli shay’in qadeer, laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah, laa ilaaha ill-Allahu, wa laa na‛budu illaa iyyaahu, lahun-ni‛matu wa lahul-fadlu wa lahuth-thanaa’-ul-hasan, laa ilaaha ill-Allahu, mukhliseena lahud-deena wa law karihal-kaafiroon
duas.translation:
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and and He is Able to do all things, there is no might nor power except with Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we worship none except Him. For Him is all favor, grace, and glorious praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we are sincere in faith and devotion to Him although the disbelievers detest it.

Abdullah ibn Zubayr (RA) himself used to recite this dua after every salaam and say: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite these dua after every prayer.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ حِينَ يُسَلِّمُ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهَلِّلُ بِهِنَّ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Zubair reported: Ibn Zubair uttered at the end of every prayer after pronouncing salutation (these words):" There is no god but Allah. He is alone. There is no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and He is Potent over everything. There is no might or power except with Allah. There is no god but Allah and we do not worship but Him alone. To Him belong all bounties, to Him belongs all Grace, and to Him is worthy praise accorded. There is no god but Allah, to Whom we are sincere in devotion, even though the unbelievers should disapprove it." (The narrator said): He (the Holy Prophet) uttered it at the end of every (obligatory) prayer. [Muslim: 594]
