duas.title: Ayatul Kursi - Surah Al-Baqarah 2:255
duas.introduction: After every prescribed salat, Ayatul Kursi should be recited:
duas.arabic: اَللّٰهُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-'ardhi, man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahu 'illaa bi'idhnihi, ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay'im-min 'ilmihi 'illaa bimaa shaa'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal 'ardh, wa laa ya'ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul- 'Adheem
duas.translation:
Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever recites Ayatul Kursi immediately after each prescribed prayer, there will be nothing standing between him and his entering Paradise except death."

benefits.title: Benefits of Ayatul Kursi
benefits.description: Ayatul kursi from surah al baqarah fills the heart with Allah’s power and care, making every Muslim feel safe, blessed, and close to Allah, while bringing protection and Barakah in daily life.
points: Ayatul kursi for protection keeps Muslims safe from shaytan and all harm.
Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum in ayatul kursi grows Iman and Tawheed.
Reciting ayatul kursi after salah brings Allah’s help and Barakah in every Amal.
This ayatul kursi from al baqarah 255 protects the home and family day and night.
Ayatul kursi benefits include easy rizq and Allah’s mercy for those who read daily.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Ayatul Kursi
when_to_recite.description: Ayatul Kursi is a strong ayah from Surah Al-Baqarah that brings Barakah, safety, and peace, and Muslims recite it for protection, Iman, and to remember Allah’s power in their daily Amal.
points: After every fard salah, Muslims recite ayatul kursi for protection and Barakah.
Before going to bed, read ayat al kursi for safety from shaitan and peaceful sleep.
When leaving home, Muslims use ayatul kursi for Allah’s help and safe journey.
During times of fear or worry, recite ayatul kursi for calm and strong Iman.
After reading surah al baqarah, Muslims repeat ayatul kursi for more reward and mercy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Ayatul Kursi
how_to_perform.description: Reciting ayatul kursi brings Barakah and safety from harm, as taught in many hadith. This quranic dua is a shield for every Muslim, and reading it daily keeps your Iman and home safe by Allah’s will.
steps: Start by making fresh wudu and then recite ayatul kursi full with focus and calm.
After every fard salah, read ayat al kursi to get Allah’s help and strong protection.
Before going to bed, say ayatul kursi for protection from shaitan and bad dreams.
When leaving your house, recite surah baqarah ayat 255 to keep your family safe.
If you feel scared or weak, repeat allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum for peace in heart.

duas.title: 3 Qul Surahs (Surah Ikhlas, Surah Falaq And Surah Nas)
duas.introduction: After every prescribed salat, Surah Ikhlas One Times:
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّـهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّـهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. (1) Qul HuwAllahu 'Ahad. (2) Allahus-Samad. (3) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. (4) Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'ahad
duas.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (1) Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge. (3) He neither begets nor is born, (4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (Sura Ikhlas: 1-4)

Surah Falaq One Times:
duas.reference: [1] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1523 [2] Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5082

benefits.title: Benefits of 3 Qul Surahs
benefits.description: The three qul surahs protect a Muslim from every evil and harm, bringing Allah’s mercy and safety close to the heart when recited with Iman and trust in His words.
points: Allah’s help comes fast for the one who reads 3 qul surahs with full yaqeen.
The three quls keep shaitan and evil jinn away from a Muslim’s home and family.
Surah ikhlas and surah falaq with surah nas give strong hifazat in every amal.
Qul huwallahu ahad brings Barakah and peace to the heart of a Muslim in namaz.
Reciting 3 qul surah before going to bed keeps a Muslim safe all through the night.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite 3 Qul Surahs
when_to_recite.description: The 3 qul surahs bring strong Barakah and protection, and Muslims use them for safety, Iman, and to keep shaitan away, making these surahs a daily part of zikr and Amal for every believer.
points: After finishing salah, Muslims recite 3 qul surahs for Allah’s protection and mercy.
Before going to bed, read surah ikhlas, surah falaq, and surah nas for peaceful sleep.

While leaving home, Muslims recite 3 qul for Allah’s help and safe journey.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform 3 Qul Surahs
how_to_perform.description: Reading the 3 qul surahs daily brings strong safety and Barakah for every Muslim. These surahs are a shield from harm, and the Prophet ﷺ taught us to use them for protection and to keep our Iman safe.

While walks on road or traveling, say the 3 qul surahs for Allah’s protection and peace.

duas.title: Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar 33 Times
duas.introduction: 33 times "Subhanallah"
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: SubhaanAllah
duas.translation:
How perfect Allah is.

33 times "Alhamdulillah"

benefits.title: Benefits of Dhikr After Salah
benefits.description: Saying subhanallah alhamdulillah allahu akbar 33 times after every salah fills the heart with peace and brings Allah’s blessings to every Muslim who keeps this zikr close.
points: Subhanallah and alhamdulillah with allahu akbar bring Barakah in daily amal.
Tasbih after salah helps a Muslim get closer to Allah with every zikr Allah.
Alhamdulillah for everything makes the heart soft and full of shukr to Allah.
Tasbih fatima after namaz gives strength and removes worries from the mind.
Dhikr after salah keeps the Iman strong and brings peace in every Muslim prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dhikr After Salah
when_to_recite.description: Dhikr after salah with subhanallah, alhamdulillah, and allahu akbar 33 times brings Barakah, peace, and strong Iman, making your Amal better and filling your heart with thanks to Allah every day.
points: After every fard salah, Muslims recite subhanallah, alhamdulillah, allahu akbar 33 times.
When feeling thankful, use tasbih fatima after prayer for more Barakah and peace.
At the end of tasbeeh after namaz, repeat subhanallah meaning for pure zikr Allah.
During quiet moments after salah, say alhamdulillah for everything to thank Allah.
While sitting after prayer, Muslims use dhikr after salah for strong Iman and calm heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dhikr After Salah
how_to_perform.description: Doing dhikr after salah with subhanallah, alhamdulillah, and allahu akbar brings Barakah and peace to your heart. This tasbih is a simple way to thank Allah and keep your Iman strong every day after namaz.
steps: Right after fard salah, use your fingers or tasbih to say subhanallah 33 times.
Next, repeat alhamdulillah 33 times with a thankful heart for Allah’s gifts.
Then, say allahu akbar 33 times and feel the greatness of Allah in your heart.
After finishing, complete the dhikr by saying la ilaha illallah for more Barakah.
If you miss tasbih, count on your fingers and do this dhikr after every namaz for reward.

duas.title: Powerful dhikr after salah
duas.introduction: Say thirty-three times each:
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: SubhaanAllahi, walhamdu lillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dhikr After Salah
benefits.description: This dhikr after salah fills the heart with peace and brings Allah’s mercy close, making every Muslim feel the blessings of subhanallah alhamdulillah allahu akbar in daily life.
points: Subhanallah and alhamdulillah with allahu akbar make Iman strong after every salah.
Tasbeeh after salah brings Barakah and helps a Muslim remember Allah always.
Zikr after namaz removes sadness and gives calmness to the heart and mind.
Dhikr after prayer brings reward and keeps shaitan away from a Muslim’s amal.
Tasbeeh fatima after fard salah helps a Muslim get closer to Allah with every word.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Powerful Dhikr After Salah
when_to_recite.description: This dhikr after salah fills your heart with Iman and Barakah, bringing peace and reward as you remember Allah with subhanallah, alhamdulillah, and allahu akbar after every fard prayer.
points: After finishing every fard salah, repeat this dhikr after salah for more Barakah.
When sitting quietly after prayer, use subhanallah alhamdulillah allahu akbar for zikrullah.
Before leaving your prayer spot, recite tasbeeh after namaz to thank Allah for His gifts.
In moments of calm after tasbih prayer, say this dhikr after prayer to grow your Iman.
While teaching kids about dua after salah, help them learn this tasbeeh fatima for easy reward.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dhikr After Salah
how_to_perform.description: Doing dhikr after salah with subhanallah, alhamdulillah, and allahu akbar fills your heart with Iman and brings peace. This simple zikr after namaz is a way to thank Allah and get Barakah in your daily life.
steps: After every fard salah, quietly say subhanallah walhamdulillah wallahu akbar.
Use your right hand fingers or tasbeeh to count each dhikr after prayer for focus.
When you finish, make a small dua asking Allah for forgiveness and more Barakah.
If you are with family, do this dhikr after salah together to teach kids about zikr Allah.
Try to keep your mind on Allah’s greatness and mercy while doing this tasbeeh after namaz.

duas.title: Dua at end of Salah
duas.arabic: رَبِّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ (تَجْمَعُ) عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi qini 'adhaabaka yawma tab'athu - [tajma'u] - 'ibaadak
duas.translation:
O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day when You resurrect - or gather - Your slaves.

Bara' (RA) reported: When we prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we cherished to be on his right side so that his face would turn towards us (at the end of the prayer), and he (the narrator) said: I heard him say: (the dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْبَرَاءِ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَا خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْبَبْنَا أَنْ نَكُونَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ يُقْبِلُ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ - قَالَ - فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ رَبِّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ - أَوْ تَجْمَعُ - عِبَادَكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Bara' reported: When we prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we cherished to be on his right side so that his face would turn towards us (at the end of the prayer), and he (the narrator) said: I heard him say: O my Lord! save me from Thy torment on the Day when Thoil, wouldst raise or gather Thy servants. [Muslim: 709]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua at End of Salah
benefits.description: This dua at end of salah asks Allah for safety from His punishment and brings hope to every Muslim who wants forgiveness and mercy on the Day when all people will stand before Him.
points: Allah’s mercy comes close for the Muslim who makes dua after salah with yaqeen.
Dua after prayer helps a Muslim get saved from azaab on the Day of Qiyamah.
Asking this dua after fard prayer brings hope for forgiveness from Allah’s anger.
Dua at end of salah keeps the heart soft and full of fear for Allah’s punishment.
This Islamic prayer after namaz helps a Muslim remember the akhirah every day.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua At End of Salah
when_to_recite.description: This dua at end of salah asks Allah for safety from His punishment, bringing hope and Barakah as you finish your prayer and remember the Day of Judgment with a heart full of Iman and fear of Allah.
points: After tashahhud and before tasleem, make dua at end of salah for Allah’s mercy.
When ending your fard prayer, use this dua after salah to seek protection from punishment.
Before saying salam in namaz, recite dua after prayer for safety on the Day of Judgment.
In your last sitting of salah, ask Allah with this dua after fard prayer for forgiveness.
While teaching kids about dua after namaz, help them learn this dua for after prayer for Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua at End of Salah
how_to_perform.description: Making dua at end of salah is a way to ask Allah for safety from His punishment and to get His mercy. This masnoon dua is easy and brings Barakah to your namaz and daily life if you do it with a true heart.
steps: After tashahhud and before salam, quietly say rabbi qini 'adhaabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibaadak.
When you finish your fard prayer, raise your hands and repeat this dua after salah.
If you feel scared about the Day of Judgement, use this dua after prayer for peace.
While sitting in last tashahhud, make this dua at end of salah with full hope in Allah.
Teach your kids to say this dua after namaz so they learn to ask Allah for safety always.

duas.title: Dua at the end of Salah
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma inni A‛oodhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqri, wa 'adhaabil-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from Kufr, poverty, and from the torment of the grave.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي الشَّحَّامَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ - أَنَّهُ كَانَ سَمِعَ وَالِدَهُ، يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ فَجَعَلْتُ أَدْعُو بِهِنَّ فَقَالَ يَا بُنَىَّ أَنَّى عُلِّمْتَ هَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ قُلْتُ يَا أَبَتِ سَمِعْتُكَ تَدْعُو بِهِنَّ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلاَةِ فَأَخَذْتُهُنَّ عَنْكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَالْزَمْهُنَّ يَا بُنَىَّ فَإِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْعُو بِهِنَّ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Muslim - meaning bin Abi Bakrah - narrated that: He heard his father say following the prayer: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqri, wa 'adhabil-qabri (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from Kufr, poverty and the torment of the grave.)" I started to recite them and he said: "O my son, where did you learn these words?" I said: "O my father, I heard you saying this supplication at the end of the prayer, and I learned them from you." He said: "Continue to recite them, O my son, for the Prophet of Allah [SAW] used to say this supplication at the end of the prayer." [Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 5465]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua at the End of Salah
benefits.description: This dua at the end of salah asks Allah for protection from kufr, poverty, and the pain of the grave, giving every Muslim hope for safety and peace in this world and the next.
points: Allahumma inni auzubika keeps a Muslim safe from kufr and weak Iman after salah.
Dua after prayer helps protect from azab kubur and fear of the grave’s darkness.
Asking this dua after fard prayer brings rizq and keeps away the pain of poverty.
Dua for protection at end of salah makes the heart strong against shaitan’s tricks.
This Islamic prayer after namaz gives peace and hope for Allah’s help every day.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua At The End of Salah
when_to_recite.description: This dua at the end of salah brings you under Allah’s care, asking for safety from kufr, poverty, and azab kubur, filling your heart with Iman and hope after every prayer.
points: After tashahhud and before tasleem, ask Allah with this dua at the end of salah for protection.
When you finish your fard prayer, use this dua after salah to seek safety from kufr and poverty.
Before saying salam in namaz, recite allahumma inni auzubika for relief from grave’s torment.
In your last sitting of salah, make dua after prayer for Barakah and Allah’s mercy.
While teaching kids about dua after namaz, help them learn this dua for grave and poverty.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua at the end of Salah
how_to_perform.description: This dua at the end of salah is a strong way to ask Allah for safety from kufr, poverty, and the pain of the grave. Every Muslim should try to say this after every fard prayer to get Allah’s help and Barakah in life.
steps: After you finish your fard salah, quietly say Allahumma inni auzubika with full hope in your heart.
When you sit for tashahhud, remember to recite this dua after prayer for protection from azab kubur.
Before making any other personal dua, use this masnoon dua to ask Allah for safety from kufr and faqir.
If you pray in jamaat, softly say this dua after namaz to get Barakah for all Muslims around you.
At home or masjid, make this dua after salat a habit so your Iman and Amal stay strong always.

duas.title: Dua After Salah (Allahumma a inni ala zikrika wa shukrika)
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّى عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'a'innee 'alaa dhikrika, wa shukrika, wahusni 'ibaadatik
duas.translation:
O Allah, help me to remember You, to give You thanks, and to perform Your worship in the best manner.

Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caught his hand and said: By Allah, I love you, Mu'adh. I give some instruction to you. Never leave to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيُّ، عَنِ الصُّنَابِحِيِّ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّكَ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أُوصِيكَ يَا مُعَاذُ لاَ تَدَعَنَّ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَوْصَى بِذَلِكَ مُعَاذٌ الصُّنَابِحِيَّ وَأَوْصَى بِهِ الصُّنَابِحِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Mu'adh b. Jabal reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caught his hand and said: By Allah, I love you, Mu'adh. I give some instruction to you. Never leave to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer: "O Allah, help me in remembering You, in giving You thanks, and worshipping You well." Mu'adh willed this supplication to the narrator al-Sunabihi and al-Sunabihi to 'Abu Abd al-Rahman. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1522]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Salah
benefits.description: This dua after salah asks Allah for help in remembering Him, giving thanks, and doing ibadah in the best way, making every Muslim’s heart full of zikr and shukr after every prayer.
points: Allahumma a inni ala zikrika wa shukrika brings Barakah in every Muslim’s amal.
Dua after namaz helps a Muslim remember Allah and stay thankful in daily life.
Asking this dua after prayer makes ibadah easy and keeps the heart close to Allah.
This Islamic prayer after salah gives strength to do good deeds with pure niyyah.
Dua for thanking Allah after salat fills the heart with peace and true happiness.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Salah (Allahumma a inni ala zikrika wa shukrika)
when_to_recite.description: This dua after salah helps you ask Allah for help in remembering Him, thanking Him, and doing ibadah with Barakah, making your heart full of Iman and shukr after every prayer.
points: After finishing your fard salah, use this dua after salah to thank Allah and ask for help.
When you sit quietly after namaz, recite Allahumma a inni ala zikrika wa shukrika for Barakah.
Before leaving your prayer spot, make dua after prayer to do more zikr and shukr in your life.
In your last sitting of salah, ask Allah with this dua after salat for better ibadah and Amal.
While teaching kids about dua after namaz, help them learn this dua for thanking Allah always.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Salah
how_to_perform.description: This dua after salah is a lovely way to ask Allah for help in remembering Him, being thankful, and doing good Amal. Every Muslim should try to say this after every namaz to get more Barakah and Iman in daily life.
steps: Once you finish your namaz, raise your hands and say Allahumma a inni ala zikrika wa shukrika.
Sitting quietly after prayer, recite this dua after salah to thank Allah for His gifts.
Before leaving your prayer spot, use this masnoon dua to ask for help in doing good Amal.
In your daily zikr Allah, add this dua after salat to make your worship better and more strong.

duas.title: Dua After Namaz
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ غْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lee maa qaddamtu, wa maa 'akhkhartu, wa maa 'asrartu, wa maa 'a'lantu, wa maa 'asraftu, wa maa 'Anta 'a'lamu bihi minnee. 'Antal-Muqaddimu, wa 'Antal-Mu'akhkhiru laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta
duas.translation:
O Allah, forgive me what I have sent before me and what I have left behind me, what I have done in secret and what I have done in public, what I have done in excess, and those sins which You are better aware of than I. You are the One Who sends forth and You are the One Who delays. There is none worthy of worship but You.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after the tashahood but before the salaam [1] and in another narration, it says he used to say this dua after finishing the prayer [2]. Both narrations are authentic. Perhaps he (ﷺ) sometimes said this dua before salaam and sometimes after salaam.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ الْمَاجِشُونُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مِنْ آخِرِ مَا يَقُولُ بَيْنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night for prayer he would say: I turn my face in complete devotion to One Who is the Originator of the heaven and the earth and I am not of the polytheists. Verily my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds; There is no partner with Him and this is what I have been commanded (to profess and believe) and I am of the believers. O Allah, Thou art the King, there is no god but Thee, Thou art my Lord, and I am Thy bondman. I wronged myself and make a confession of my Sin. Forgive all my sins, for no one forgives the sins but Thee, and guide me in the best of conduct for none but Thee guideth anyone (in) good conduct. Remove sins from me, for none else but Thou can remove sins from me. Here I am at Thy service, and Grace is to Thee and the whole of good is in Thine hand, and one cannot get nearneststo Thee through evil. My (power as well as existence) is due to Thee (Thine grace) and I turn to Thee (for supplication). Thou art blessed and Thou art exalted. I seek forgiveness from Thee and turn to Thee in repentance: and when he would bow, he would say: O Allah, it is for Thee that I bowed. I affirm my faith in Thee and I submit to Thee, and submit humbly before Thee my hearing, my eyesight, my marrow, my bone, my sinew; and when he would raise his head, he would say: O Allah, our Lord, praise is due to Thee, (the praise) with which is filled the heavens and the earth, and with which is filled that (space) which exists between them, and filled with anything that Thou desireth afterward. And when he prostrated himself, he (the Holy Prophet) would say: O Allah, it is to Thee that I prostrate myself and it is in Thee that I affirm my faith, and I submit to Thee. My face is submitted before One Who created it, and shaped it, and opened his faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the best of Creators; and he would then say between Tashahhud and the pronouncing of salutation: Forgive me of the earlier and later open and secret (sins) and that where I made transgression and that Thou knowest better than I. Thou art the First and the Last. There is no god, but Thee. [[1] Muslim: 771 [2] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1509]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Namaz
benefits.description: This dua after namaz asks Allah to forgive every sin, hidden or open, and brings hope for mercy to every Muslim who wants a clean heart and Allah’s forgiveness after every salah.

Dua after salah brings Allah’s mercy for sins done in secret and in front of people.

This Islamic prayer after salah brings hope for a clean heart and a new start every day.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Namaz

duas.title: Dua at the end of Namaz
duas.introduction: Suhaib (RA) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this dua at the end of the prayer:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِيْنِيَ الَّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ عِصْمَةَ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي جَعَلْتَ فِيهَا مَعَاشِيْ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَأَعُودُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، اَللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Aslih li dinya-lladhi ja'altahu ismata amri, wa aslih li dunyaya-llati ja'alta fihaa ma'aashi, Allaahumma inni a-udhu biridaaka min sakhatika, wabi 'afwika min niqmatika, wa a-udhu bika minka, Allaahumma laa maani'a limaa a'taita wa laa mu'tia limaa mana'ta wa laa yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minka al-jaddu
duas.translation: O Allah, set straight my religious commitment that You have made a protection for me, and set straight my worldly affairs which You have made a means of my livelihood. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath, and I seek refuge in Your forgiveness from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. O Allah, None can withhold what you have given and none can give what you have withheld, and no wealth or fortune can avail the man of wealth and fortune before You.

Dua after namaz helps a Muslim get Allah’s pleasure and stay away from His anger.
Asking this dua after salah brings protection for deen and all worldly matters.
This Islamic prayer after fard namaz gives hope for Allah’s forgiveness and help.
Dua after prayer reminds a Muslim that only Allah controls all blessings and loss.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua At The End of Namaz
when_to_recite.description: This dua at the end of namaz is a strong way to ask Allah for Barakah in your deen and dunya, seeking His help and mercy after every fard prayer and making your Amal and Iman better every day.

In your daily tasbeeh after namaz, add this dua to ask Allah for protection from His anger and punishment.

duas.title: Dua After Prayer
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أُحَاوِلُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ وَبِكَ أَصَاوِلُ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bika o-'haa-wilu wa bika o-qaatilu wa bika asaa-wil
duas.translation: Ya Allah! I try by your help, fight by your help, show courage by your help and be victorious by your help.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Prayer
benefits.description: This dua after prayer asks Allah for help in every struggle, making a muslim strong and brave with His support in every part of life after every salah.

Dua after prayer brings courage and hope for victory in every good amal.
Asking this dua after salah keeps the heart firm and full of trust in Allah’s plan.
This islamic supplication after namaz helps a muslim stay brave in hard times.
Dua for victory reminds every muslim that all power and help comes from Allah.

When you finish tasbeeh after prayer, use this dua after salah for strength in Amal.

After zikr after prayer, make dua for victory and ask Allah to guide your steps.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Prayer
how_to_perform.description: This dua after prayer is a strong way to ask Allah for help in every step, for strength, and for victory. Every Muslim should try to say this after every salah to get more Barakah and courage in life.

Sitting for zikr after prayer, recite this dua for strength and ask Allah to help you in every fight.
Before you stand up from your prayer mat, use this dua after fard prayer to seek Allah’s help in all things.
In your daily tasbeeh after prayer, add this dua to ask for courage and victory from Allah always.
When praying with family, teach kids this dua after salah so they learn to trust Allah’s help every day.

duas.title: Dua After Salat (Allahummaghfirli Warhamni Wa Tub Alayya)
duas.introduction: Say Hundred times:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْم (التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ)
duas.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lee wa tub `alayya innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Rahim (in another narration: Tawwabul-Ghafur)
duas.translation:
O Allah, forgive me and turn to me. You are the Ever-Turning, the Merciful' (in another narration: the Most Forgiving)

"An Ansari Companion (RA) said: "I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say this dua 100 times after the prayer." The second narration of this hadith says: “Rasulullah (ﷺ) prays two rak'ats of Salatud-Duha. Then he recited this dua 100 times. Both descriptions are authentic. At least all the Dhaakirs should pay attention to recite this Dua 100 times after Salatud Duha.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Salat
benefits.description: This dua after salat asks Allah for forgiveness and mercy, helping every muslim find hope and a clean heart after every prayer by trusting in Allah’s kindness and His power to accept tawbah.
points: Allahummaghfirli warhamni brings Allah’s mercy and wipes away old sins after salat.
Dua after namaz helps a muslim get true tawbah and feel close to Allah’s Rahmah.
Asking this dua after prayer gives hope for forgiveness and a new start every day.
This istighfar after salah keeps the heart soft and full of trust in Allah’s kindness.

when_to_recite.description: This dua after salat is a soft call to Allah for forgiveness and mercy, helping muslims keep their Amal clean and Iman strong after every namaz, with hope for Barakah and Allah’s Rahmah in every prayer.

steps: Right after you finish your namaz, softly say Allahummaghfirli warhamni wa tub alayya.
With your hands raised, ask Allah for forgiveness using this dua after prayer.

After every fard salah, make this zikr after prayer to get Allah’s Rahmah and Barakah.

duas.title: Dua for After Namaz
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوْبِي وَخَطَايَايَ كُلَّهَا اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْعِشْنِيْ وَاجْبُرْنِيْ وَاهْدِنيْ لِصَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَخْلَاقِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَهْدِيْ لِصَالِحِهَا وَلَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahummagfirli dhunubi wa khata-ya-ya kullahaa, Allaahumma an-'ishni wajburni wahdini lisaali'hil a'maali wal akhlaaqi fa-innahu laa yahdi lisaali'hi-ha wa laa yasrifu sayyiahaa illaa anta
duas.translation:
Ya Allah! Forgive all of my mistakes and my sins. Ya Allah! Inspire me and make me obedient. Guide me to do the good deeds and to the good mannars. Because none can guide to it’s good and turn away from it except you.

Abu Umama (RA) and Abu Ayyub (RA) said: "Whenever I went to your Prophet (ﷺ) in any of the obligatory and supererogatory prayers, I heard him say these two things while turning or getting up at the end of the prayer."

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for After Namaz

After salah, muslim prayer for forgiveness helps keep the heart soft and humble.
Dua after prayer guides a muslim to good deeds and best akhlaq in daily life.
Tasbeeh after namaz with this islamic dua brings Barakah and peace in Amal.

duas.title: Dua for After Salah
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِيْ وَوَسِّعْ لِي فِي دَارِيْ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي رِزْقِيْ
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir li dhanbi, wa wassi` li fi daari, wa baarik li fi rizqi
duas.translation:
O Allah, forgive me my sin, and expand for me my abode, and bless for me that which You have provided me.

Abu Musa (RA) said, "I brought the water of ablution to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). "Then he performs ablution, prays and recites this dua.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for After Salah
benefits.description: This dua for after salah helps a muslim ask Allah for forgiveness, Barakah in rizq, and a peaceful home, making every prayer a time to seek His mercy and blessings for daily life and family.
points: Allahumma in this dua after salah brings Allah’s forgiveness for every sin.
Dua for rizq in this masnoon dua asks Allah to give Barakah in all earnings.
After prayer, muslim prayer for forgiveness keeps the heart clean and soft.
Dua for after namaz helps a muslim get peace and comfort in their home.
Powerful dua for everything brings ease in rizq and success in daily Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For After Salah
when_to_recite.description: This dua for after salah is a soft call to Allah for forgiveness, Barakah in rizq, and a happy home, helping muslims keep their Amal clean and Iman strong after every namaz and in daily life.
points: After every fard salah, muslims use this dua for after salah to ask Allah for forgiveness.
When you finish tasbeeh, recite this dua after prayer for Barakah in rizq and home.
At the end of namaz, make dua for forgiveness and ask Allah to widen your house.
After zikr, muslims say this dua after salat for more blessings in their daily rizq.
Before leaving prayer spot, use this dua after namaz for a peaceful home and clean heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for After Salah
how_to_perform.description: This dua for after salah is a simple way to ask Allah for forgiveness, a bigger home, and Barakah in your rizq. It is a masnoon dua that brings peace and helps every Muslim remember Allah’s gifts after every prayer.
steps: After you end your namaz, recite this dua for after salah with a soft heart and full Iman.
Ask Allah to forgive your sins by saying Allahummaghfirli zambi in your dua after prayer.
When you wish for a better home, use this dua after namaz to ask Allah to expand your house.
For more Barakah in your rizq, make this powerful dua after every salah with hope in Allah.
If you feel your money is less, ask Allah for rizq and blessings using this islamic dua.

duas.title: Dhikr After Salah
duas.introduction: After returning the salutation, Rasulullah (ﷺ) would say once:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُ اَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
duas.translation: Allah is the greatest.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ‏{‏عَنْ عَمْرٍو،‏}‏ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَعْرِفُ انْقِضَاءَ صَلاَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالتَّكْبِيرِ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: I used to recognize the completion of the prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ) by hearing Takbir. [Bukhari: 842]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dhikr After Salah
benefits.description: Saying Allahu Akbar after salah reminds a muslim that Allah is the greatest, bringing peace to the heart and making every prayer more strong with the power of takbir and true Iman.
points: Takbir after salah lifts the heart and keeps Allah’s greatness in the mind.
Dhikr after prayer with allahu akbar brings Barakah and calm in daily Amal.
Saying allahu akbar after namaz helps a muslim remember Allah is always great.
After salah dhikr with this masnoon dua makes Iman strong and shaitan weak.
Allhu akbar in zikr after salah brings closeness to Allah and peace in the soul.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dhikr After Salah
when_to_recite.description: Dhikr after salah with allahu akbar fills your heart with peace and Barakah, reminding you that Allah is the greatest and bringing calmness after every fard namaz and prayer.
points: Right after finishing fard salah, muslims repeat allahu akbar as dhikr after salah.
When sitting quietly after namaz, use takbir to remember allah is the greatest.
After every prayer, say allahu akbar in arabic to complete your dhikr after prayer.
While waiting for sunnah salah, repeat allahu akbar meaning allah is great for more reward.
If you want to feel close to Allah, do dhikr after namaz with allahu akbar for strong Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dhikr After Salah
how_to_perform.description: Dhikr after salah like saying Allahu Akbar fills your heart with Iman and reminds you that Allah is the greatest. This simple takbir brings Barakah and keeps your mind close to Allah after every namaz.
steps: Once you finish your prayer, say Allahu Akbar softly as your first dhikr after salah.
Repeat the takbir after every fard salah to remember Allah’s greatness in your daily life.
When you feel happy or sad, use this dhikr after namaz to thank Allah for everything.
After tasleem, make this dhikr after prayer to keep your heart strong with zikr allah.
If you want more Barakah, say allahu akbar meaningfully after every salah with full hope.

duas.title: Namaz After Dua
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: SubhaanAllahi wa bihamdihi 'Adada khalqihi, wa ridhaa nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi wa midaada kalimaatihi
duas.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَوْلَى آلِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا بُكْرَةً حِينَ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ وَهِيَ فِي مَسْجِدِهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَضْحَى وَهِيَ جَالِسَةٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا زِلْتِ عَلَى الْحَالِ الَّتِي فَارَقْتُكِ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ قُلْتُ بَعْدَكِ أَرْبَعَ كَلِمَاتٍ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَوْ وُزِنَتْ بِمَا قُلْتِ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ لَوَزَنَتْهُنَّ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out from (her apartment) in the morning as she was busy in observing her dawn prayer in her place of worship. He came back in the forenoon and she was still sitting there. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her: You have been in the same seat since I left you. She said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I recited four words three times after I left you and if these are to be weighed against what you have recited since morning these would outweigh them and (these words) are:" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him according to the number of His creation and according to the pleasure of His Self and according to the weight of His Throne and according to the ink (used in recording) words (for His Praise)." [Muslim: 2726]

benefits.title: Benefits of Tasbih After Namaz
benefits.description: Saying subhanallahi wa bihamdihi after namaz fills the heart with praise for Allah, making every prayer more strong and bringing His pleasure, mercy, and blessings in daily life.
points: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi in tasbih after namaz brings Allah’s pleasure and mercy.
Zikr of Allah with this masnoon dua makes good deeds heavy on the Day of Qiyamah.
Tasbih after namaz helps a muslim get Barakah and peace in every Amal and day.
Subhanallah meaning in this dhikr after salah reminds of Allah’s greatness always.
Dua after prayer with this zikr keeps the heart clean and close to Allah’s love.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Tasbih After Namaz
when_to_recite.description: Reciting tasbih after namaz with subhanallahi wa bihamdihi brings Barakah and peace, filling your heart with the zikr of Allah and making your dua after prayer more strong and full of Iman.
points: After every fard salah, muslims say subhanallahi wa bihamdihi as tasbih after namaz.
When you finish your prayer, repeat subhanallah meaning to praise Allah’s greatness.
Sitting for dhikr after salah, use subhanallahi wa bihamdihi meaning for more reward.
Before leaving your prayer spot, do dua after namaz with this zikr of allah for Barakah.
If you want your dua after prayer to be accepted, recite tasbih after namaz with full heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Tasbih After Namaz
how_to_perform.description: Tasbih after namaz like Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi fills your heart with peace and brings you closer to Allah. This zikr of Allah is easy, full of Barakah, and helps every Muslim remember Allah’s greatness after prayer.
steps: After you finish your namaz, quietly say subhanallahi wa bihamdihi with full respect.
Count the tasbih after namaz on your fingers or beads, feeling each word in your heart.
When you want to praise Allah, use this zikr of Allah to thank Him for His big blessings.
After every salah, make this dhikr after prayer to fill your day with Allah’s mercy and Barakah.
If you feel alone, repeat subhanallahi wa bihamdihi meaningfully to keep your Iman strong.

duas.title: Dua After Fajr Salah
duas.introduction: Anas bin Malik (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever prays Fajr in congregation, then sits and remembering Allah until the sun has risen, then he prays two Rak'ah, then for him is the reward like that of a Hajj and Umrah." He said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Complete, complete, complete (Hajj and Umrah)."

duas.title: Dua After Fajr Namaz
duas.introduction: Simak ibn Harb (RA) reported: I said to Jabir bin Samura (RA): Did you sit in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ? He said: Yes, many times. He (ﷺ) used to sit at the place where he observed the Fajr or Maghrib prayer till the sun rose or when it had risen; he would stand, and they (his Companions) would talk about matters (pertaining to the days) of Jahiliyyah, and they would laugh (on these matters) while (the Prophet ﷺ) only smiled.

duas.title: Reply to specific Ayah in Salah
duas.introduction: Reply to specific ayah inside prayer, for both the imam and the followers, both the reciter and the one who is listening the recitation #1 Sheikh Albani (R) said that, this rule is general. Because of this this rule include inside or outside prayer and obligatory or voluntary prayer. Sabbi'hisma rabbikal a'la (Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High) The messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to reply this ayah by saying this, Sub’hana rabbiyal a’la (Glory is to my Lord, the Most High) [1] The messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that, who recite this ayah from sura Qiyaamah, Alaisa zaalika biqaadirin an iyu'hyaal mawta (Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?) He should reply this by saying this, Sub’hanaka fabalaa (Glory be to you! Yes! You are able to give life to the dead) [2]
duas.reference: [1] Ahmad, Abu Daud: 883, Sahih (Albani) [2] Bayhaqi, Abu Daud: 884, Sahih (Albani)

duas.title: Reply to specific Ayat in Salat
duas.introduction: Reply to specific ayah inside prayer, for both the imam and the followers, both the reciter and the one who is listening the recitation #2 The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told us to reply this ayah of Surah Rahman Fabi ayyi alaa-i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. Meaning: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? by this - laa bishaayim min ni'amika rabbanaa nukazzibu falakal 'hamd Meaning: Ya Rabb! We don't disbelief any of your favour and all praise belongs only to you." It is to mentioned that, In the end of surah tin replying by saying “baala wa ana ‘ala dhalika minash shahidiin” and in the end of sura mursalat replying by saying “Amanna billah” and in the end of surah bakarah replying by saying “Amin” - these reports are weak narration.
